  • Contribute to continuous improvement of our data modeling frameworks, performance tuning, and technical decision-making

Requirements

  • Strong SQL experience with a deep understanding of analytical modeling concepts

  • Hands-on experience with dbt (models, tests, docs, macros)

  • Experience working with cloud data warehouses such as BigQuery or ClickHouse

  • Understanding of data modeling patterns

  • Familiarity with data engineering concepts (ELT/ETL, orchestration, version control, CI/CD)

  • Experience with data quality frameworks or implementing validation logic

We are an AI-native company. Every team member is expected to leverage AI daily, and we evaluate AI fluency as part of our hiring process. Join us and help redefine what's possible.

About ClickUp

ClickUp is the everything app for work, built to help teams plan, collaborate, and execute in one place. Our customers rely on ClickUp to simplify complexity, move faster, and build better operating systems for work across teams.

The Role

We’re hiring a Senior Technical Account Manager, Strategic Services to partner with strategic customers as they implement, expand, and mature their use of ClickUp. This role sits within Professional Services and is ideal for someone who can blend customer leadership, workflow design, technical problem solving, and practical change management.

You’ll help customers move from fragmented processes to scalable ways of working in ClickUp. That means leading complex implementations, guiding adoption across multiple stakeholder groups, identifying opportunities for automation and AI, and helping customers realize measurable business value from the platform.

What You’ll Do

Lead strategic implementations and customer transformations

  • Own complex customer engagements from discovery through rollout, enablement, and ongoing optimization.

  • Diagnose current-state workflows, identify friction points, and design scalable future-state solutions in ClickUp.

  • Guide customers through governance, architecture, process design, and rollout planning across multiple teams or business units.

  • Help customers recover momentum when implementations stall, priorities shift, or stakeholder alignment breaks down.

Drive adoption, value realization, and account health

  • Partner closely with customer stakeholders to define success measures, adoption milestones, and practical next steps.

  • Translate customer goals into clear execution plans that improve adoption, stakeholder engagement, and long-term platform value.

  • Use usage signals, customer feedback, and business context to identify risks early and build recovery or acceleration plans.

  • Support strategic business reviews and customer conversations with a clear point of view on progress, opportunities, and priorities.

Design scalable solutions, automation, and AI use cases

  • Turn complex business needs into thoughtful ClickUp solutions using workflows, structure, automations, reporting, and process best practices.

  • Recommend when to standardize, when to keep flexibility, and how

title: Field Account Executive - München (w/m/d)
description:
Über uns & Die Opportunity

Bereit für die Freiheit, komplett eigenständig zu arbeiten, aber mit der Power eines globalen Tech-Pioniers im Rücken?
Lightspeed ist die führende All-in-One-Plattform für Handel und Gastronomie. Nach dem erfolgreichen Launch in allen deutschen Großstädten ist München unser finaler Stopp! Als KI-getriebenes Tech-Unternehmen bieten wir dir eines der besten SaaS-Produkte auf dem Markt.

In dieser Rolle bist du nicht einfach nur Angestellter – du bist der "Owner" deines eigenen Gebiets in München. Gemeinsam mit einem neuen, dynamischen Team von ca. 10 Personen und einem erfahrenen Manager vor Ort eroberst du den Münchner Gastronomiemarkt. Wir verzichten auf Micromanagement und setzen auf Vertrauen, Freiheit und Ergebnisse.

Deine Mission in München

Du übernimmst die volle Verantwortung für dein Vertriebsgebiet und gewinnst die Top-Locations der Stadt für Lightspeed. Dein Erfolg basiert auf einem modernen, holistischen Vertriebsansatz:

  • Digitaler Rückenwind: Wir unterstützen dich aktiv durch Performance Marketing & qualifizierte Leads.

  • Strategische Partnerschaften: Du baust dir ein lokales Netzwerk und ein starkes Empfehlungsmanagement (Referrals) auf.

  • Gezielte Kaltakquise & Walk-ins: Du bist täglich im Markt präsent, besuchst Restaurants, Cafés sowie Bars und überzeugst die Inhaber direkt vor Ort.

  • Full-Cycle-Verantwortung: Du steuerst den gesamten Prozess selbstständig – vom ersten Händedruck über die Produkt-Demo bis zum erfolgreichen Vertragsabschluss.

  • Beratender Verkauf: Du verkaufst nicht nur Software, sondern hilfst Gastronomen partnerschaftlich dabei, ihr Business erfolgreicher zu machen.

Wer du bist (Dein Profil)

  • Ein echter Hunter: Du liebst die Herausforderung der Neukundengewinnung, bist extrem selbstmotiviert und brauchst niemanden, der dir ständig über die Schulter schaut.

  • Kommunikationsstark: Du sprichst Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem Niveau (essenziell für den Vertrauensaufbau mit lokalen Inhabern) und bringst gute Englischkenntnisse mit.

  • Charismatisch & Resistent: Du besitzt ein sicheres Auftreten, starke Präsentationsfähigkeiten und hast kein Problem damit, in ein volles Restaurant zu gehen und ein Gespräch zu starten.

  • Ehrgeizig: Du willst deinen Erfolg selbst in die Hand nehmen und suchst ein Umfeld, in dem Leistung direkt belohnt wird.

  • Erfahrung: Erste Erfahrung im Vertrieb, Business Development oder in der Gastronomie ist ein Plus – dein Drive und deine Einstellung zählen für uns jedoch am meisten.</

title: Account Executive, Mid Market
description:
Who we are

Help Scout started in 2011 with a simple premise: support software should treat customers like people, not tickets. 3+ billion conversations later, more than 10,000 companies use Help Scout to grow relationships with customers of all types, from clients to patients and beyond.

Now we’re in a new chapter: not only building AI that gives teams more space to focus on the customer experience, but also reimagining how we operate in an AI-native world. That means shipping and learning faster, without compromising on craft. Great work here carries a strong opinion and sweats the details, regardless of the tools we use to drive it.

We’ve been a fully remote team since day one, with 120+ teammates now all over the world. It’s a culture where you’ll be trusted to take ownership, stay curious, and raise the quality of work around you. It comes with clear expectations and a team that will push you to do some of the best work of your career.

If that kind of challenge gives you energy, we’d love to meet you.

About the role

Today, our SMB sales motion is dialed in. The majority of new customers find us; they visit our website, start a trial, or request a walkthrough of the platform. We’ve built a process that converts these visitors into customers at an impressive rate.

Over the past year, our product has become increasingly competitive for support teams at larger companies (100-1,000 employees), but those prospects don’t always arrive on our site ready to engage. That’s where you come in.

This is a true outbound sales role, designed for a rep with world-class prospecting skills. You’ll have the opportunity to not only craft our outbound sales motion, but lead the charge competing (and winning) new upmarket customers at a higher ACV.

Please note: For this role, we are only able to hire in the United States.

In this role, you will

  • Build and own your pipeline. We expect more than 75% of your opportunities to be self-sourced through target account campaigns, account-based targeting, referrals, events. Inbound will support you; it won't fill your calendar.

  • Run full-cycle deals. You'll land the first meeting, run tailored product demos, build compelling business cases, manage commercial negotiations and seal the deal. You own the sales motion (with support from our amazing team).

  • Build a playbook. What works for you becomes the baseline of our upmarket sales motion. You're the first person running it, and will work with GTM leadership to set our strategy for the future.

  • Collaborate cross-functionally

title: Head of Market Growth
description:
The Role We Need

PadSplit is entering new markets faster than ever, and we need a leader who can build the repeatable system that turns every new launch into a thriving, self-sustaining marketplace. As our Head of Market Growth, you'll own the strategy and execution behind taking a market from launch to scale by creating exceptional experiences for hosts and members, building a powerful local vendor ecosystem, and establishing the growth flywheel that fuels long-term expansion.

The Person We Are Looking For

You're equal parts builder, operator, and strategist. You love creating order from ambiguity, know how to launch new markets from the ground up, and have a track record of building partnerships and systems that continue producing results long after you've stepped away. You're energized by ambitious growth goals, thrive in cross-functional environments, and enjoy developing teams while solving complex marketplace challenges.

  • Build Playbooks – Design and continuously improve the repeatable systems, processes, and launch playbooks that allow markets to scale beyond the initial launch phase.

  • Test & Learn – Run structured experiments, evaluate results, and continuously improve how PadSplit enters and scales new markets.

Here's What You'll Need to Be Successful

  • Market Leadership – 10+ years leading marketplace, growth, partnerships, or operations teams, including significant ownership of a business, market, or P&L.
  • Launch Experience – Proven success launching or scaling new markets for a marketplace, franchise, or multi-location business.

Tekmetric is the all-in-one, cloud-based software helping auto repair shops run smarter, grow faster, and serve customers better.

Built by a shop owner and shaped by the needs of the industry, Tekmetric brings together innovation, real-world experience, and a thriving community to help shops thrive - not just survive. From running a shop, to securing payments to engaging customers, our platform simplifies operations so shop owners can focus on what really matters: delivering exceptional service, earning trust, and growing sustainably.

Officially founded in Houston in 2017, Tekmetric has grown from a single shop’s vision to the industry’s leading solution - all by staying true to our values of transparency, integrity, innovation, and a service-first mindset.

But we’re not just building shop management software. We’re building a movement. We’re empowering repair shops to rise above the daily grind, create meaningful connections with their customers, and lead the industry forward - one interaction at a time.

Come build with us. Join the journey. Shape the future of auto repair.

Working the Tekmetric Way

At Tekmetric, we’re building a culture where winning matters - not for ego, but because when our customers win, we win together.

We move fast, stay curious, and take full ownership of our results — no excuses, no finger-pointing. If you thrive in ambiguity, take initiative, and view honest feedback as fuel for growth, you’ll feel right at home here.

We’re direct but respectful, ambitious yet grounded, and collaborative at every level. Everyone leads through impact and is encouraged to speak up, share ideas, and challenge assumptions (even your manager’s). This is a place for builders, not bystanders.

Success here takes focus, follow-through, and a willingness to roll up your sleeves — but if you’re driven by meaningful work and real results, it’s deeply rewarding. You’ll join a team that cares about the work, supports one another, and takes smart risks to achieve bold goals. Be yourself, stay mission-focused, and you’ll thrive. If that energizes you, we can’t wait to meet you.

Because we value in-person collaboration, travel is an expected part of every role. We come together several times a year for team and company-wide offsites to align on goals and strengthen relationships. Attendance at these events is expected and fully supported.

What You’ll Do

  • Develop a deep understanding of the industry we serve and market

title: Junior Content Editor
description:
About Inspira Education

Inspira Education Group is one of the fastest-growing edtech startups in the US. We started with a simple mission to democratize access to high-quality coaching so that every student in the world has an equal opportunity to access the best opportunities.

As the world’s leading network of top admissions coaches in medical, legal, business, and college studies, we’re building software and services in one place—disrupting long-entrenched application processes with products and experiences that strive to provide an equal platform for candidates from diverse backgrounds worldwide.

As one of the fastest-growing edtech firms in the world, we are backed by some of the leading venture capital firms and investors in the world, including Zeev Ventures, Quiet Capital, Craft Ventures and Jeff Fluhr (Founder of Stubhub).

The Role

We’re looking for a Junior Content Editor to help keep everything we publish accurate, clear, and polished. You’ll work alongside our senior editors, SEO team, writers, and subject-matter experts to take drafts from rough to publish-ready across our blogs, guides, and marketing content.

This is a great fit if you have a sharp eye for detail, love making sentences better, and want to grow into a more strategic editorial role. You’ll learn how content gets found and cited by search engines and AI tools, and you’ll build real skills in editorial process, style, and feedback.

Please note: This role is open to candidates based remotely in Canada.

What You’ll Do

Edit for quality

  • Catch spelling, grammar, factual, and formatting errors before content goes live.
  • Rewrite passive constructions into active voice and replace jargon with plain language.
  • Tighten wordy sentences without losing the point.
  • Check that headings are logical and accurately reflect the content beneath them.
  • Verify stats, claims, and quotes against primary sources, and flag anything unverified.

Apply our style guide

  • Apply Inspira’s house style consistently across punctuation, capitalization, formatting, and tone.
  • Flag style deviations for writers rather than silently fixing them, so they learn the rules over time.
  • Suggest updates to the style guide as you spot patterns or gaps.

  • Make sure each section leads with its main point rather than burying the answer.

title: Director, People Operations
description:
About the Job:

LaunchDarkly is looking for a Director, People Operations to lead the operating model, service delivery, and continuous improvement of People Operations and Talent Acquisition operations across the employee and candidate lifecycles.

Reporting to the Senior Director, People Operations, you will lead a connected portfolio spanning global People Operations, Talent Acquisition Operations, employee and candidate experience, compliance-related workflows, operational governance, and team capability for a growing global company. You will translate business and People priorities into clear ownership, scalable processes, strong controls, and a reliable operating rhythm.

This role will work in close partnership with the Director, People Programs, Systems & Analytics. The Director, People Operations will own operational outcomes, service delivery, process execution, and stakeholder partnership. The Director, People Programs, Systems & Analytics will own managing the strategy and roadmap for People programs, systems, analytics, AI, data governance, and change enablement. Together, these leaders will create a practical, integrated People operating model that is trusted by employees, candidates, managers, HRBPs, and business leaders.

Responsibilities:

People Operations Leadership

  • Establish the global People Operations operating model across the employee lifecycle, including onboarding, offboarding, employee data changes, employment documentation, employee support, contingent workforce processes, international operations, and related service delivery.
  • Manage the activities of the People Operations and Talent Acquisition Operations teams, creating clear expectations, effective prioritization, strong collaboration, and a culture of ownership and continuous improvement.
  • Establish service standards, escalation paths, operating rhythms, and ownership models that make it easy for employees, managers, HRBPs, and cross-functional partners to get the right support.
  • Own operational readiness and execution for policies, compliance-related workflows, employment agreements, audits, immigration and mobility processes, accommodations, background checks, and other high-risk employee lifecycle activities in partnership with Legal and relevant subject-matter experts.

Summary

The Senior Developer Success Engineer - West will be the frontline technical expert for our developer community. You will help users deploy and scale Temporal in cloud-native environments. You will also troubleshoot complex infrastructure issues, optimize performance, and develop automation solutions. This role is ideal for someone who thrives on solving distributed systems challenges and improving the developer experience.

What You'll Do

  • Be a keen learner:

    • At Temporal, you’ll work with cloud-native, highly scalable infrastructure spanning AWS, GCP, Kubernetes, and microservices. You’ll gain deep expertise in container orchestration, networking, and observability while learning from complex, real-world customer use cases.

    • Our stack includes Go, Python, and Java, providing continuous opportunities to hone your programming skills in infrastructure automation, resilience engineering, and performance tuning.

  • Be a passionate problem solver:

    • If you enjoy tackling scalability, reliability, and troubleshooting challenges in distributed systems, you’ll thrive in this role.

    • As a Senior Developer Success Engineer, you’ll work directly with developers to debug complex infrastructure issues, optimize cloud performance, and enhance reliability for Temporal users.

    • You'll develop observability solutions (Grafana, Prometheus), improve networking (load balancing, DNS, ingress/egress), and automate infrastructure operations (Terraform, IaC) to help customers run Temporal efficiently at scale.

    • Once ramped up, we expect you to independently drive technical solutions, whether debugging complex production issues or designing infrastructure best practices. Don't worry—we have seasoned engineers and mentors to support you along the way!

  • Be a great communicator:

    • As a Senior Developer Success Engineer you will engage directly with developers, engineering teams, and product teams to understand infrastructure challenges and provide solutions that enhance scalability, performance, and reliability.

    • Your insights will influence platform improvements, from enhancing observability tooling to developing self-service infrastructure solutions that simplify troubleshooting (e.g., building diagnostic tools similar to Twilio’s Network Test).

    • You’ll serve as a bridge between developers and infrastructure, ensuring that reliability, performance, and developer experience remain top priorities as Temporal scales.

title: Controls Engineer II
description:
The Controls Engineer II, Engineering Services designs and maintains the diagnostic infrastructure ICON's fleet depends on — building troubleshooting tools, guided diagnostics, telemetry-sourced health monitoring dashboards, and data-driven predictive maintenance models that move the fleet from reactive toward condition-based service. This role serves as the escalation point for complex controls failures across Field Engineering and customer teams, and is the technical authority others turn to when standard support can't resolve the issue.

This role is based at ICON’s headquarters in Austin, TX and reports to the Director of Engineering Services.

Responsibilities

  • Design feedback and escalation: Diagnose and resolve complex issues involving PLCs, HMIs, SCADA and industrial communication protocols such as Ethernet and DeviceNet.
  • Identify and report design, reliability and maintenance problems or software bugs to design and software engineering teams to facilitate root‑cause analysis and corrective action.
  • Network and integration support: Assist with issues related to control system networking, including configuring communication devices and integrating control hardware with enterprise systems. Collaborate with electrical, mechanical and IT teams to ensure seamless integration.
  • Advanced troubleshooting and support: Respond to situations where first‑line support cannot isolate or fix problems in malfunctioning control systems.
  • Field Engineering training: Develop and deliver training for the Field Engineering team on control system operation, maintenance, and configuration — building the technical notes, how-to guides, and reference materials that raise the team's capability to support the fleet independently.
  • Customer liaison: Serve as a technical liaison to customers, providing guidance on operation, maintenance, and configuration of control systems; deliver remote training sessions and produce technical notes and how-to guides that improve customer understanding.
  • Regulatory compliance: Ensure that control systems comply with safety and regulatory standards (e.g., OSHA, NFPA, IEC) and advise customers on best practices for safe operation.
  • Documentation and knowledge management: Update knowledge base articles, create troubleshooting documentation and share insights with global support teams to build organisational knowledge.
  • Continuous learning: Stay current on emerging control technologies, PLC/HMI software and industry trends to incorporate the latest advancements into support practices.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, control systems engineering or a related technical discipline.
  • 3+ years of experience in industrial automation or control systems support.
  • Strong working knowledge of PLCs, HMIs, SCADA systems and control network proto

title: Technical Program Manager
description:
About the role

We're looking for someone who owns delivery - not tracks it, not reports it, owns it.

You'll be responsible for a specific area: games, features, or platform work. From the first conversation about a requirement through to production - you're on the hook for the whole thing.

This isn’t a coordination-only role. We need someone with previous hands-on software engineering, DevOps, release engineering, or similar technical experience who can actively improve and automate the way software is built, tested, and released.

You set the timeline, track it, and communicate changes before people start asking questions. If there's a blocker, you've already seen it. If a release isn't ready, you say so - clearly and early.

You'll look at how work flows through your area and fix what's broken. Not just follow whatever process exists. You'll design something that actually works, iterate on it, and make it better over time.

A key part of the role will be identifying manual steps, bottlenecks, and failure points in development and release workflows, and then building practical automation to remove them. This may include improving CI/CD pipelines, automating release checks, connecting tools through APIs, and developing scripts or lightweight internal solutions.

Quality is yours too. Not QA's problem alone, not the tech lead's problem. You own release readiness: is it tested, is it documented, does anyone know the operational risk. If the answer is no, it doesn't ship.

You'll work closely with product, engineering, QA, and client-facing teams, keep them aligned, and report directly to the VP of Delivery.

What we expect from you

First 30 days

  • Understand how delivery actually works in your area - not how it should work, how it actually works

  • Map where work gets stuck, what the recurring blockers are, and who the key people are

  • Meet everyone who matters: product owners, tech leads, QA, release managers, client teams

  • Write up what you found and share it with the VP of Delivery

First 60 days

  • Take ownership of delivery tracking for your area

  • Pick the biggest workflow problem you found and start fixing it

  • Show you can catch a blocker before it causes a delay - at least twice

First 90 days

  • Own and communicate a delivery forecast that stakeholders actually trust

  • Ship at least one release with no last-minute surprises - quality gates passed, documentation done, everyone aligned

  • Present your view on how delivery should work in your area going forward

What we're looking for

description:
Über uns

Seit über 25 Jahren stehen wir von Terra Consulting GmbH für unabhängige und innovative Ingenieurdienstleistungen in den Bereichen Verkehr/Infrastruktur, Umwelt, Lagerstätten, Geotechnik, Flächenrecycling, Gebäudeschadstoffe und Altlasten für die Privatwirtschaft und für öffentliche Auftraggeber. Einen Schwerpunkt dabei bilden Projekte der Energiewende. An unseren Standorten in Dortmund und Bonn arbeiten wir mit über 30 Mitarbeitern.

Unser Bonner Büro bietet ein breites Spektrum an umwelt- und naturschutzfachlichen Planungsleistungen an, u.a. die Analyse und Bewertung umweltrelevanter Eingriffe sowie die Erstellung von Anträgen und Fachgutachten.

Unsere Überzeugungen spiegeln sich in unseren Leistungen wider. Wir legen großen Wert auf einen kooperativen Führungsstil, der auf gegenseitigem Respekt und ein offenes Ohr für neue Ideen basiert. Bei uns stehen die individuellen Fähigkeiten, Erfahrungen und Perspektiven unserer Mitarbeiter im Vordergrund – unabhängig von Geschlecht, Herkunft, Behinderung, Weltanschauung, sexueller Orientierung oder Alter. Als Team setzen wir auf ein faires und wertschätzendes Miteinander und offene Kommunikation untereinander, aber auch gegenüber unseren Kunden.

Unsere Hauptauftraggeber sind neben den Lagerstättenbetreibern die Energieversorgungsunternehmen und die Straßen- und Eisenbahninfrastrukturunternehmen. Bei der Terra Consulting GmbH nimmst du aktiv an der Energiewende und dem Infrastrukturausbau teil.

About the role

title: Talent Acquisition Specialist
description:
We are looking for a Talent Acquisition Specialist to build the team behind our launch vehicles and propulsion systems. This is a hands-on, primarily onsite role focused on high-quality technical recruitment at pace.

You will partner closely with engineering and business leaders to attract exceptional talent across propulsion, mechanical engineering, systems engineering, electronics, software, manufacturing, operations, and corporate functions. You will be expected to move quickly without lowering the hiring bar, while delivering an outstanding candidate experience from first contact through to offer.

Working as part of a high-performing TA function capable of supporting hyper-growth while protecting and strengthening the quality and density of talent across the company.

Fluent German is essential. A key part of the role will be developing relationships with German institutions, rocketry teams, suppliers, and technical communities.

About us

We’re a Germany-based rocketry startup currently in stealth mode, scaling up rapidly to meet the demand for high-performance, reliable, and scalable solid propulsion technologies for space and defense applications.

We are already launching suborbital and ballistic rockets on a regular basis, generating significant revenue and applying our knowledge toward the development of an orbital rocket.

We are working hard to build something truly spectacular.

To thrive here you will need to be comfortable working at pace, with the autonomy to make decisions and execute on them quickly. If you’re excited by hard technical challenges and want a role where you will make a real difference each day to the future of the company, we may be the place for you.

Atira builds the commercial brain for industrials. Our agents 10x the sales engineers of today by offering the complete toolbox of tasks needed in complex environments. Why Product is the only role that sees the whole thing

"If I had asked people what they wanted, they would have said faster horses.” - Henry Ford

Our FDEs go deeper into a single customer than anyone else at Atira. What nobody can see from inside one account is the shape that all the accounts share. You hold the version of the problem that is bigger than any single customer's description of it, and you break it into steps small enough to ship every month.

Then you defend it. Every deployment produces requests: A few are the next platform feature, most are a customer-specific detour that should never be touched. You are the person who cares the most about consolidating solutions and has the technical depth to do something about it, which means you decide what comes in and what does not.

As Atira scales we build industry-specific pods: FDE, AE, BDR and Product Marketer, led by a GTM Engineer. Pods go deep. Product goes wide. Everything a pod learns has to end up in one platform, and you are the reason it does. Make sure we do not chase faster horses.

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours
Experience Level: Mid-Level to Senior
Department: Digital Marketing / Growth Marketing

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring an experienced SEO & Digital Marketing Specialist to develop, execute, and optimize digital marketing strategies that increase organic traffic, improve search rankings, generate qualified leads, and drive measurable business growth.

You’ll take ownership of organic search performance, paid advertising, website optimization, and lead generation while exploring emerging opportunities in AI-powered search optimization (AEO/GEO).

  • Optimize meta titles, descriptions, headings, internal linking, URLs, and structured data.
  • Execute ethical link-building strategies and monitor search algorithm updates.
  • Optimize content for traditional search engines and AI-powered search experiences (AEO/GEO).

title: Bid & Project Manager – EU & NATO (H/F)
description:
About Alta Ares


Alta Ares is an air defense Neoprime. We build AI-guided interceptors to counter drones and cruise missiles, along with the software platform that powers them.

Our customers are NATO-aligned militaries and defense institutions, and our systems are regularly deployed during live exercises and operational demonstrations across Europe, the Middle East, and Asia.

Your sales director owns the customer relationship and the commercial strategy; you own the offer and its delivery.

This is not a one-programme job. You will run several bids and projects at once: a NATO bid, an EU grant proposal, and an RFI can land in the same week, and none of them can slip.

Wat ga je doen?

Dat bepaal je voornamelijk zelf! Afhankelijk van je opleiding en interesses stellen we een takenpakket samen dat aansluit bij de uitdagingen, doelstellingen en projecten die spelen binnen ons team. Is AI je beste vriend? Mooi, daar kunnen we nog veel in ontwikkelingen. Interesse in de Socials? Fijn, we kunnen je creativiteit goed gebruiken. Vlotte pen? Ook prima! Jouw teksten krijgen bij ons het podium dat ze verdienen.

Kortom, afhankelijk van jouw input, ideeën en talenten kijken we samen wat je gaat doen, zoals:

  • Vormgeving;

  • Webinarproducties;

  • Website-optimalisatie en -onderhoud;

  • E-mail marketing; 

  • Social media; 

  • Deep dive in de analytics;

  • Meedenken in plannen rondom AI.

Vanaf dag één nemen we je bij de hand en laten je zien hoe de praktijk werkt. Maar na verloop van tijd kun jij het (bijna) helemaal zelf en vertel je ons hoe het beter kan.

Met wie werk je samen?
Natuurlijk sta je er niet alleen voor. Wij zijn onlangs gegroeid tot een team van zeven enthousiaste marketeers met ieder een eigen specialisme. Genoeg mogelijkheden dus om samen te groeien en van elkaar te leren.

title: Meewerkstage: Communicatie
description:
Wat ga je doen?

Hoe zorg je ervoor dat 800+ collega’s wereldwijd weten wat er binnen Voortman speelt én zich betrokken voelen bij de organisatie? Met verschillende vestigingen, landen, afdelingen en groepen collega’s is dat een mooie communicatie-uitdaging. Want niet iedere doelgroep bereik je op dezelfde manier en niet ieder verhaal vertel je via hetzelfde kanaal.

Als stagiair Communicatie draai je volop mee binnen ons communicatieteam. Je staat midden in de organisatie en spreekt collega’s van allerlei afdelingen: van productie en engineering tot service en sales. Je ontdekt wat er speelt, haalt verhalen en ontwikkelingen op en denkt mee over hoe we die op een interessante en relevante manier onder de aandacht brengen bij onze verschillende doelgroepen. Daarbij werk je met allerlei vormen van communicatie en content. De ene keer schrijf je een artikel of werk je mee aan een magazine, de andere keer denk je mee over een video of ondersteun je bij de communicatie rondom een grote interne bijeenkomst voor honderden collega’s. Je kijkt steeds naar wat je wilt vertellen, wie je wilt bereiken en welke vorm daar het beste bij past.

Concreet ga je onder andere:

  • verhalen en ontwikkelingen ophalen bij collega’s uit verschillende delen van de organisatie;

  • helpen bij het plannen, voorbereiden en publiceren van content (tekst, video, offline materialen);

  • ondersteunen bij de organisatie en communicatie rondom grote interne bijeenkomsten;

  • nieuwe formats en creatieve manieren bedenken om verhalen binnen Voortman te vertellen;

  • kijken hoe we sterke interne content slim kunnen doorvertalen naar externe middelen voor bijvoorbeeld employer branding;

Je doet dit natuurlijk niet alleen. Je werkt nauw samen met het communicatieteam en onze collega’s van Market

title: Stage: Optimalisatie van planningsrapportages
description:
Wat ga je doen?

Binnen onze organisatie speelt planning een belangrijke rol in het realiseren van projecten, het optimaal benutten van capaciteit en het bewaken van voortgang. Tijdens deze stage onderzoek je hoe de rapportagefunctionaliteiten van ons huidige planningspakket beter kunnen worden ingezet om de kwaliteit van besluitvorming en de betrouwbaarheid van de planning te verbeteren.

Je brengt in kaart welke rapportages en dashboards momenteel beschikbaar zijn, hoe deze worden gebruikt en waar de informatiebehoefte van verschillende gebruikersgroepen ligt. Daarbij werk je nauw samen met planners, projectmanagers, productie en management. Door interviews, analyses en praktijkonderzoek ontdek je waar kansen liggen om rapportages te verbeteren, te standaardiseren en te automatiseren.

Op basis van jouw bevindingen formuleer je concrete aanbevelingen waarmee gebruikers sneller kunnen sturen op capaciteit, productieprestaties en projectvoortgang. Je levert daarmee een directe bijdrage aan een efficiëntere planning en betere managementinformatie.


Wij vragen

  • Een HBO- of WO-opleiding in de richting van Bedrijfskunde, Technische Bedrijfskunde, Business IT & Management, Informatica, Data Analytics of een vergelijkbare studie;

  • Interesse in data-analyse, rapportages, KPI's en procesverbetering;

  • Een analytische en gestructureerde werkwijze;

Wij bieden

  • Een vergoeding: €600,- per maand;

  • Reiskostenvergoeding: zodat jij geen onnodige kosten maakt;

  • Apparatuur en materialen: bijvoorbeeld een laptop, speciaal gereedschap of software;

title: KI WEG- Verwalter (m/f/d)
description:
Über Buena

Buena baut die Technologie, auf der die Immobilienbranche läuft. Wir machen jeden Teil der Immobilienwirtschaft so nahtlos und transparent wie möglich, vom Finden über das Finanzieren bis zum Verwalten. Dafür übernehmen wir Hausverwaltungen in ganz Deutschland und bauen sie zu Technologieunternehmen um. Mit über 90.000 verwalteten Einheiten und mehr als 30 übernommenen Hausverwaltungen sind wir in den letzten drei Jahren zu Deutschlands zweitgrößtem Immobilienverwalter geworden.

Über die Rolle

Du bist echter WEG-Profi, kennst den Alltag in der Verwaltung und weißt, wie du Ordnung reinbringst, wenn Abläufe stocken, Aufgaben liegen bleiben oder Prozesse unklar sind. Genau dort setzt du bei Buena an: Jeden Monat übernehmen wir neue Hausverwaltungen in ganz Deutschland, und du überführst sie direkt vor Ort in den modernen Buena-Betrieb. Dein Wohnort in Deutschland ist zweitrangig – wichtig ist deine hohe Reisebereitschaft und deine WEG-Expertise. Dein Erfolg zeigt sich in funktionierenden Abläufen, reibungslosem WEG-Tagesgeschäft und lokalen Teams, die mit der Buena-Software spürbar besser arbeiten als vorher.

Verantwortlichkeiten

  • Du tauchst tief in das WEG-Tagesgeschäft unserer neu übernommenen Verwaltungen ein, identifizierst Engpässe frühzeitig und baust bestehende Rückstände gezielt ab.

  • Du begleitest und steuerst die operative Umstellung auf unsere Buena-Software direkt vor Ort bei den Teams.

  • Du schulst die Teams praxisnah an unserer Software und befähigst sie, Versammlungen, Beschlüsse und das Tagesgeschäft digital abzuwickeln.

  • Du bringst deine tiefen WEG-Erfahrungen aus den Einsätzen zurück in unser Product-Team, um unsere Software stetig zu verbessern.

title: Logistics Executive
description:
About Andercore

Andercore is the AI-native supplier of industrial materials and goods for energy and infrastructure. We execute trade and distribution end-to-end, on our own account, at the speed of compute - and we are becoming the supplier of record for the entire industry.

Industrial procurement is a €900B market in Europe alone and the largest manual market on earth. 95% of customers have no direct access to global supply chains. Materials pass through four or five intermediaries before they reach a site, and 40% of the margin evaporates on the way. For decades, the operating system of this industry was people: people to source, negotiate, finance, ship, and sell.

We built the alternative from scratch. We are the supplier. We buy from global sources and sell to European customers on our own account. Our AI runs the full trade: sourcing, quality, pricing, sales, logistics, credit, and financing. One request. A firm quote in minutes. Delivered on time. For the customer, it feels like buying from their preferred local supplier. No warehouses. No fleet. No inventory risk. Every trade is pre-sold before it is bought.

We are also the credit counterparty. Customers are scored and insured in minutes and get up to 60 days of payment terms priced into the quote itself. The working capital behind every trade is bank-funded, not equity-funded.

Where we are today:

  • Strong triple-digit-million euro turnover run rate, the majority of it from repeat customers

  • Seven European markets live, sourced from suppliers across Asia and beyond

  • 80+ people across Berlin (HQ), London, and Shanghai

  • $90M raised in equity and debt, including

title: Growth Consultant | Deutsch C2
description:
Growth Consultant (m/w/d), Account Management für 30 bis 40 B2B Tech Kunden in Berlin

Die meisten Account-Management-Jobs heißen Beratung und bestehen am Ende aus Reporting-Decks und Ticket-Pingpong. Hier ist es umgekehrt: Die Umsetzung macht das Team, du berätst.

Unser Kunde ist eine AI-first GTM Agentur aus Berlin Mitte. Seit 2024 auf über 5 Mio. EUR ARR und 30+ Leute gewachsen, mit 200+ B2B Tech Kunden, von der Mobility-App über einen Schweizer Telko-Konzern bis zum Bildungsverlag. Zuletzt kam in einem einzigen Monat über 1 Mio. EUR neuer ARR dazu.

Jeder dieser Kunden braucht jemanden, der ihn hält und ausbaut. Genau dafür ist dieser Seat da.

Das Paket: 50 bis 70k EUR Fix plus 12,5% Provision auf Upsell und Retention, Berlin Mitte, 3 Tage Office und 2 Tage remote.

Tasks

  • Du führst dein eigenes Portfolio aus ca. 30 bis 40 Accounts und sitzt alle zwei Wochen mit Geschäftsführern und Entscheidern im Termin.

  • Deine Kunden sind B2B Software- und Tech-Firmen, die über Google, LinkedIn, Meta und signalbasiertes Outbound ihre Pipeline aufbauen. Insgesamt laufen jeden Monat sechsstellige Budgets in Paid Search und Paid Social über die Agentur.

  • Der typische Moment: Ein Geschäftsführer, der viel Geld in Ads und Outbound steckt, fragt dich, warum seine Leads teurer geworden sind und ob er das Budget kürzen soll. Du hast die Antwort und den nächsten Schritt.

  • Beratung statt Operatives: Kampagnen bauen die GTM- und Performance-Marketing-Teams. Du entscheidest mit dem Kunden, was als Nächstes gebaut wird.

  • Upsell und Retention sind dein Hebel: neuer Kanal, mehr Budget, Verlängerung. Dein Spielfeld ist das bestehende Portfolio.

  • Du liest die Zahlen deiner Accounts (Leads, Cost per Lead, Pipeline) und siehst ein Abwanderungsrisiko, bevor der Kunde es ausspricht.

Requirements

  • Ein paar Jahre B2B mit echter, eigener Kunden

title: Graphic Designer
description:
About HOPn UG

Headquartered in Puchheim, Germany, HOPn UG develops smart, scalable solutions across AI automation, software development, digital education, event management, and business consulting. Founded in 2023, our innovation company connects technology, education, and entrepreneurship to empower universities, startups, and enterprises.

Your first months as a Graphic Designer

You will design engaging graphics, support our branding initiatives, and create visual assets that translate complex technological concepts into clear, compelling media for our global audience.

  • A portfolio demonstrating skill in graphic design and visual communication

  • An eye for detail, typography, layout, and modern design principles

  • Familiarity with industry-standard design tools

Your first months at HOPn UG

You will have shipped visual assets across multiple digital channels, collaborated directly with our international team on real client and internal projects, and deepened your practical design experience within an innovation-focused company. We encourage you to apply even if you do not meet every single requirement.

Als Technical Support Engineer ben je een belangrijk aanspreekpunt voor technische vragen over onze warmtepompen. Je combineert technisch inzicht met klantcontact en werkt nauw samen met onze service-, product- en engineeringteams.

description:
Description

QuantumDiamonds is a novel equipment vendor from Germany which builds magnetic field imaging systems based on quantum sensors. Our Data Science & Machine Learning team in Pre-Development owns the chain from raw quantum sensor data to the current map an engineer can act on: the statistical evaluation of the sensor signal, the simulation and training data pipelines, the reconstruction of fields and currents, with the machine learning pipeline for three-dimensional current in production today, and the validation of every map against simulation and reference measurements.

We are looking for a Data Scientist to own one question for the team: can we trust this map, and if not, where in the chain did it go wrong? Every measurement, in our lab or at a customer, gets a verdict and a reason. You build the checks that produce it, keep the catalogue of known artifacts and reference measurements behind it, and make it automatic for the routine cases so that your judgement goes to the hard ones. When a check fails, you trace it to its source in the chain, fix it when it sits in the evaluation, and drive the fix with the owning engineer when it does not. Our Applications engineers, who run the customer projects, rely on your verdict for what reaches the customer. A senior data scientist on the team backs you on the hard calls at the start; the aim is that you become the owner of this question.

This is a hands-on analysis role, not a research position: the data is real, the chain is in daily use, and every improvement you make shows up in the next measurement. Your background does not need to be in quantum sensing or semiconductors: if you have learned to tell signal from noise, calibration errors and artifacts in another demanding measurement system, we want to hear from you.

QuantumDiamonds is building commercial quantum sensing tools for semiconductor inspection and failure analysis. As our Quantum Sensing Engineer (NV Centers), you will join the Hardware Pre-Development Team and take technical ownership of the sensing core of our widefield Quantum Diamond Microscope (QDM).

At the heart of your role is one question: how do we get more performance out of the NV sensing system?

You will work across the complete sensing chain — from the diamond sensor and laser excitation through microwave spin control and bias magnetics to fluorescence collection and camera readout. When sensitivity, resolution, speed, or stability falls short, you will investigate the system end to end, identify the limiting mechanism, and turn your findings into measurable improvements.

The diamond sensor itself is an important part of that challenge. Together with internal experts and external partners, you will help drive the development of our NV diamond material — connecting epitaxy, irradiation, annealing, surface preparation, and optical coatings to the performance we ultimately achieve at the system level.

Heute haben wir sechs Studios, bis Ende 2027 werden es rund 20, in mehreren Städten. Jede Eröffnung bringt einen Business Case, ein Budget, eine Finanzierung und neue Zahlen im Monatsabschluss. Weil du direkt mit Carl arbeitest, siehst du all das aus erster Hand.

Du startest im Tagesgeschäft: Zahlungsverkehr, Monatsabschluss, Liquidität, Planung. Sobald das sauber läuft, übernimmst du mehr, bis hin zu FP&A, Business Cases für neue Studios und Finanzierung.

Du arbeitest eng mit unserem Steuerbüro, unserem Admin-Team, dem Expansion-Team und den City Managern zusammen.

Aufgaben

Finance Operations
Du verantwortest den Zahlungsverkehr inklusive Gehaltslauf, Leasing und Kautionen. Die Vorkontierung macht unser Admin-Team nach klaren Regeln. Du kennst die Logik dahinter, prüfst Stichproben, klärst neue Fälle und entwickelst die Regeln in Moss weiter.

Monatsabschluss & Reporting
Du bereitest den Monatsabschluss mit unserem Steuerbüro vor, grenzt Umsätze von Partnern wie Urban Sports Club und Trainerkosten ab und prüfst die BWA. Daraus erstellst du in Helu ein monatliches Reporting pro Studio und gleichst Plan und Ist ab.

description:

  • Level: Regular oder Senior

  • Ort: Köln-Ehrenfeld und Homeoffice

  • Start: ab sofort

Bei uns gehört dir ein Projekt

Du arbeitest immer in einem Projektteam mit anderen Engineers und Consultants. Gemeinsam klärt ihr mit Fachbereich und IT-Leitung unserer Kund:innen, was sie brauchen. Die Architektur verantwortest du, und das System bauen und betreiben wir zusammen.

So läuft ein Projekt bei uns

Ein typisches Projekt hat drei Phasen, und du begleitest alle als technisch verantwortliche Person im Projektteam.

  1. Discovery Sprint mit dem Fachbereich: Wir legen fest, welches Problem wir lösen und woran wir den Erfolg messen.

  2. Pilotphase mit klaren Go/No-Go-Kriterien: Ihr baut eine erste Version, die Nutzer:innen im Fachbereich testen.

  3. Ausbau und Betrieb: Trägt der Pilot, bringt ihr das System in den Alltag und haltet es mit Monitoring stabil.

Deine Aufgaben

Bei aktuellen Projekten dreht es sich viel um das Training von eigenen VLMs und um das, was jedes Unternehmen umtreibt: den Einsatz von Agentic AI im gesamten Unternehmenskosmos.

  • Du konzipierst LLM-Anwendungen mit RAG, strukturierter Extraktion und Agentic Workflows und entscheidest die Architektur.

  • Backend-Services und APIs entwickelst du in Python, meist mit FastAPI.

  • Auf Azure, meist mit Azure OpenAI und AI Foundry, bringst du die Systeme in Betrieb und betreust sie dort.

  • Mit Tests, Evaluation und Monitoring sicherst du die Qualität von Anfang an.

title: SaaS Content Marketing manager
description:
ilert is an AI-first incident management software company helping companies respond to incidents faster and increase the availability of digital services. Our mission is to keep the world running at all times. We’ve done the hardest part already: built something people love. Now it’s time to take this to the next level and that’s where you come in.

Why this role is more than “just content”:

You’ll drive our storytelling to the next level: shaping how technical audiences and business leaders perceive AI-first incident management. That means creating guides that actually help, blog posts that spark trust, and content that educates.

Tasks

  • Own the content engine: craft and deliver a pulse-raising strategy that lifts brand awareness, powers lead gen, and helps customers master incident management.
  • Be the editor-in-chief of our story: lead the editorial calendar, tie content to launches, campaigns, and the initiatives that matter.
  • Tell technical stories that resonate: produce blog posts, deep-dive guides, and case studies finely tuned for developers, SREs, and IT leaders.
  • Collaborate with the best: work side-by-side with engineers for how-tos and deep technical chops, and partner with our CEO for thought leadership.
  • Own discoverability: shape SEO, GEO, and content distribution strategy.
  • Measure with intention: track what works, analyze engagement, and sharpen strategy with insights; not gut feelings.
  • Stay hyper-aware: monitor trends, competitive shifts, and industry moments to keep ilert ahead of the narrative curve.

Requirements

  • A translator of tech: content marketing experience in B2B SaaS or developer ecosystems, with the ability to make incident response approachable for both engineers and execs.
  • An editor with vision: you write tight, persuasive copy and know how to stretch a concept across formats; blogs, guides, emails.

Expansion: growing with our existing clients into new business units, countries, and use cases, with a pipeline target you share with Customer Success and Account Management. About the role (Munich, onsite):

You take over our marketing team and own pipeline growth, for net new logos and across our existing enterprise client base. Retorio roughly triples in size every year, sells to large enterprises, and already generates around 40% of its pipeline organically. Your mandate is to build a scalable lead generation engine that works in Europe, our home market where we want to be the clear number one, and in the US, where we have opened an office in New York.

You do this with deliberately modest ad budgets and a small team (today one events specialist and one lead generation specialist) that will grow over time. To support that pipeline, you also establish Retorio as the credible, science-based voice in an increasingly competitive AI sales coaching category, and you give the brand an external appearance that is professional enough for enterprise buyers and distinct enough to stand out. You report directly to the founder/Co-CEO.

title: Client Success Manager - Academia (m/f/x)
description:

title: Elektronik-Ingenieur
description:
About pplwise
pplwise is a recruiting consultancy for fast-growing technology companies across Europe. Through Recruiting as a Service and Executive Search, we fill key roles for our clients, from start-ups to publicly listed companies. We are filling this position for our client Filics.

About our client: Filics
Filics is reinventing intralogistics with autonomous mobile robots (AMRs) that change how material moves. Its double-runner system makes Filics the first and only AMR that can drive through load carriers such as Euro pallets. This breaks with forklift logic and sets a new standard for efficiency. Filics is a small, hands-on team that solves hard problems with engineering excellence. Leadership goes to those who take initiative and consistently deliver. As Senior Electrical Engineer (m/f/d) at Filics, you will design the electronics at the core of the next generation of robots.

About the role
This is an on-site/hybrid role in Munich, close to engineering and assembly.

Filics doesn’t just use off-the-shelf components. It builds its own custom IP. The robots run on advanced boards that cover a wide range of electrical engineering. On one end is high power, such as battery and motor controllers. On the other end are high-speed interfaces like PCIe, USB and MIPI CSI. The real challenge is making all these subsystems work together as one system. Many of these problems have no textbook solution. Solving them takes solid experience, a deep understanding of the physics and a creative mind.

The EE team is small, and the robot is far from finished. You’ll own your boards end to end: requirements, system design, schematic, layout, design review, sourcing, manufacturing, testing and validation. You’ll keep owning them for as long as they’re in prod

We're hiring a Senior FP&A Manager to sit at the centre of how Moss plans, tracks and steers growth. Working with senior management and functional leaders, you’ll connect strategic and operational decisions to the company’s financial objectives, in a business that combines B2B SaaS and payments economics.

You’ll report to the Director of FP&A and join an agile Finance team. The role gives direct exposure to commercial planning, board and investor reporting, and the data layer behind both.

  • Own go-to-market and revenue planning end to end across revenue streams, markets, channels and customer segments, turning plans into bottom-up targets with the Commercial team

  • Partner with business stakeholders to assess functional performance, weigh risks and opportunities, and shape initiatives that move key metrics

  • Build and maintain financial models for target setting, budgeting, long-term planning and rolling forecasts, and run the planning processes with stakeholders across the company

title: Robot Learning Engineer
description:
Why this role is exciting

Rohlik is the leading Central European e-grocer. More than a million customers buy their groceries from us through Rohlik.cz, Knuspr.de, Kifli.hu, Gurkerl.at and Sezamo.ro, choosing from over 17,000 items, delivered within a couple of hours in 15-minute windows.

We are building the autonomous grocer. Maia, our AI assistant, already talks to customers and builds their orders; agents are moving into our buying and logistics; vision models are learning to watch quality. The next frontier is physical: robots taking over more and more of the work in our fulfilment centres, until fresh food moves from producers to households at a cost nobody else can match.

We are setting out to record how our own people handle groceries and to turn those recordings into a training corpus for manipulation policies. Our warehouses already log what happened on every pick and every quality check, so the recordings can carry labels most datasets never get. Making that hold is part of the job.

You decide what makes an hour of footage trainable — before we bank hundreds of them.

title: Technical Product Lead - AI Stockbroking
description:
About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

 

The Role

BJAK is building a AI Stockbroking Superapp for Southeast Asia across payments, remittance, insurance, wealth, and trading.

 

These products move real money. Reliability, regulatory requirements, and third-party financial rails are fundamental to the product - not considerations around the edges.

 

The Technical Product Lead owns a product vertical end-to-end, from strategy and outcomes through technical design, delivery, and launch.

title: Head of Technology (m/w/d)
description:
We find your position.

ISA Telematics baut Systeme, die Menschen, Fahrzeuge und Güter im Blick behalten, wenn es darauf ankommt: Notruf, Ortung, Alarmierung.

Das Besondere daran ist der Umfang. Die ganze Kette läuft durch eine Hand, von der Firmware auf dem Gerät über Funkprotokoll und Server bis zur Leitstelle. Kein Modul, kein Ausschnitt: das komplette System.

Und die Probleme sind echt. GPS, das im Stahlbau aussteigt. Mobilfunk, der abbricht, wenn er gebraucht wird. Geräte, die jahrelang im Feld stehen und trotzdem aktualisierbar bleiben müssen. Ein Alarm, der nicht meistens ankommt, sondern immer.

Unsere Kunden: Industrie, Energieversorger, Bahn und Logistik, Kliniken, Polizei- und Sicherheitsorganisationen im DACH-Raum. Das Produkt ist eingeführt, zertifiziert und profitabel, du baust also mit echten Nutzern und laufenden Umsätzen im Rücken.

Nach vorn ist viel Platz: weitere Branchen, neue Produkte auf der bestehenden Plattform, internationale Märkte, ein stärkeres App-Geschäft. Was zuerst gebaut wird, entscheidest du mit, gemeinsam mit einem erfahrenen Entwickler, der das System seit Jahren betreut.

Aufgaben

Deine Rolle

  • Volle Verantwortung für Produkt und Technik: Architektur, Roadmap, Code
  • Rund zwölf Monate übergibt dir der Entwickler das System persönlich, anschließend leitest du den Bereich Product & Technology
  • Du entscheidest, was bleibt, was modernisiert wird und was neu entsteht
  • Neue Produkte und Anwendungsfälle auf der bestehenden Plattform mitgestalten
  • Kundenprojekte von der Aufwandsschätzung bis zum Go-live, inklusive Geräte- und Ortungsanbindung (TCP/UDP, XML)
  • Normkonforme Weiterentwicklung (DGUV, DIN VDE V 0825, CE) und Störungsanalyse im laufenden Betrieb

Qualifikation

Das bringst Du mit

  • Java: drei Jahre professionelle Entwicklung
  • SQL

title: Partner-Manager:in Lernprogramme
description:
Worum es geht

Mit Coachweave macht die Teachlume GmbH aus dem Wissen von Coaches, Trainer:innen und Berater:innen digitale Lernprogramme, die Menschen über Wochen begleiten. Produziert wird mit einer eigenen KI-Kette: Strukturvorschläge, Kurse, Bilder, Stimmen, Übersetzungen. Was die KI nicht kann: verstehen, was ein Coach wirklich braucht, beurteilen, ob ein Programm wirkt, und es so bauen, dass es sich trägt. Dafür suchen wir dich. Die Nachfrage wächst gerade schneller, als unser Gründer allein Gespräche führen kann.


Was du machst

  • Du führst Erstgespräche mit Coaches und findest heraus, was sie wirklich brauchen. Wenn es nicht passt, sagst du es freundlich.

  • Du hältst die Pipeline in Bewegung: viele Partner parallel, jeder mit klarem nächsten Schritt.

  • Du prüfst, was unsere KI aus Gesprächen und Material erstellt (Strukturvorschläge, PDFs, Kurse), gibst ihr präzises Feedback und gibst frei, wenn es gut ist.

  • Du besprichst die Ergebnisse mit den Partnern und entwickelst die Programme mit ihnen weiter.

  • Du denkst Programme wirtschaftlich: Preis, Einstieg, Abo, Upgrade, und was Lernende dranhält.

  • Nach dem Start schaust du, was funktioniert, und machst daraus die nächste Staffel.


Was du mitbringst

  • Mehrere Jahre Erfahrung in Beratung oder Partner- und Kundenbetreuung mit eigener Verantwortung, gern in Coaching, Weiterbildung, EdTech oder SaaS.

  • Du arbeitest strukturiert mit vielen Beteiligten gleichzeitig und lässt nichts liegen.

  • Du rechnest gern nach, ob ein Modell trägt.

  • Du weißt, wie Menschen lernen und dranbleiben; Erfahrung in L&D ist ein Plus, den Rest lernst du bei uns.

  • Du erkennst, wenn ein Text oder Konzept nicht trägt, und kannst genau sagen, warum. Mit KI-Werkzeugen arbeitest du selbstverständlich.

title: Chief Science Officer
description:
Chief Science Officer @ Sereact 🦾

Chief Science Officer (m/f/d) · Zurich or Stuttgart, Boston possible · Reports to the CEO · Full-time

Who we are

Sereact builds the robot brain for physical work. Cortex, our vision-language-action foundation model, is hardware-agnostic: the same model runs single-arm and dual-arm systems, mobile manipulators and humanoids that pick, sort and handle returns in live production across Europe and the US. Customers include Zalando, IKEA, BMW, Rohlik and DHL.

Founded in 2021 in Stuttgart, with an R&D hub in Zurich and a US office in Boston. We have raised more than $145 million, most recently a $116 million Series B led by Headline, with Zalando as a strategic investor. We work in small, senior teams with a flat structure; execution counts more than titles.

Why this role, why now

Our robots produce data no lab can stage. Our fleet has recorded more than 500 million manipulation interactions in live warehouse operations; Cortex 2.0 was trained on a curated 10 million of them and added a world model that plans before it acts (arXiv 2604.20246). Cortex 2.5 learns a new task from a few demonstrations instead of a training run. Deployments are growing from single robots to fleets, and the research team is growing with them.

We now want one scientific leader who owns the research behind Cortex end to end and turns what our fleet experiences every day into the next step change in what robots can do.

The Real-World Learning Loop is your system

title: Digital Retention Manager (m/w/d)
description: Summary   Als Digital Retention Manager (m/w/d) entwickelst du unsere Retention Strategie im Digital Sales weiter. Du erkennst Kundenrisiken frühzeitig, reduzierst Churn und stärkst mit datengetriebenen Maßnahmen Renewal Rate, Customer Lifetime Value und Kundenzufriedenheit. So trägst du zu nachhaltigem Wachstum bei ESET bei.   Job Description   Die Position ist hybrid an unseren Standorten Jena oder München angesiedelt. Abhängig von deinem Standort arbeitest du durchschnittlich zwei Tage pro Woche vor Ort im jeweiligen Office. Das bringst Du mit     Du hast mehrjährige Erfahrung im Bereich Retention, Account Management, Lifecycle Management, CRM oder in einer vergleichbaren kundenorientierten Rolle, idealerweise im Software-, SaaS-, IT- oder Cyber-Security-Umfeld.   Du verstehst kommerzielle Kennzahlen wie Renewal Rate, Churn, Customer Lifetime Value, Net Revenue Retention und Upsell-Potenziale und kannst daraus konkrete Maßnahmen ableiten.   Du arbeitest datenbasiert, erkennst Muster in Kundensegmenten und leitest daraus zielgerichtete Retention- und Lifecycle-Kampagnen ab.   Du bist kommunikationsstark und arbeitest souverän mit unterschiedlichen internen und internationalen Ansprechpartnern zusammen. Dabei kommunizierst du sicher in Deutsch und Englisch.   Du bringst Erfahrung mit CRM-, Reporting- oder Marketing-Automation-Tools mit, idealerweise Salesforce, Power BI oder vergleichbaren Systemen. An enormous subject became a journey you could follow, built around a simple change in perspective. Images, language, movement, and sound brought the idea to life together.

title: Homeoffice Kundensupport (m/w/d) in Vollzeit
description:
Über Simplyright

Wir bei Simplyright helfen unseren Kunden dabei, ihr Recht schnell und unkompliziert durchzusetzen. Unser Fokus liegt unter anderem darauf, unzulässige Kontogebühren von Banken zurückzufordern oder zu viel gezahlte Beiträge während des Lockdowns von Fitnessstudios zurückzuholen. In den ersten Monaten wirst du dich intensiv in unsere Abläufe im Backoffice einarbeiten, Kundenakten eigenständig bearbeiten und den direkten Kontakt zu unseren Mandanten übernehmen. Du lernst unsere internen Systeme kennen und unterstützt das Team tatkräftig bei der Durchsetzung von Kundenansprüchen.

Vergütung und Benefits

Für diese Position bieten wir ein Gehalt im Rahmen von EUR 2,500–2,800 per month. Du profitierst von flexiblem Homeoffice und kannst komplett remote arbeiten. Zudem unterstützen wir dich mit bezahlten Krankheitstagen und zusätzlichen Urlaubstagen.

You decide what ships on day one, and you own the trade-off between fraud caught and friction added.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE): United Kingdom
description:
Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE)

Remote / 20% Travel

 

About forgd

forgd is the consultancy partnering exclusively with Anthropic to help enterprises build AI-native businesses. We start with engineering — helping organizations move from individual developers using Claude Code to entire teams shipping together with AI-native workflows — and expand into agentic solution delivery and broader business transformation.

Our conviction is that engineers are uniquely positioned to lead this transformation. The strongest mental model for designing, deploying, and governing AI agents in production lives in software engineering. The teams that change how their organization builds software are the same teams equipped to shepherd the rest of the business into this new world.

We embed and co-build with customer teams. Cycles are short, delivery is iterative and accountable to clear outcome goals.

 

About the Role

As an FDE, you embed with enterprise customers and own the technical work across the full customer journey — initial demos, short proof-of-value engagements, and multi-week implementations. The work moves customers from interesting prototypes to production capability.

Most engagements start in engineering. You'll work with customer engineering teams adopting Claude Code and redesigning their SDLC — code review, requirements, testing, documentation, and governance. From there, the work expands: co-building agentic applications and modernizing legacy systems on the Claude developer platform, and partnering with business stakeholders to deploy agents into core operations like sales, customer service, and finance.

description: Vous souhaitez évoluer dans un environnement avec une vraie mission d’utilité publique et intégrer une équipe dynamique ? Rejoignez-nous ! L’ AGS  est un fond de solidarité interentreprises, financé par une cotisation patronale, qui assure la protection des salariés en cas de défaillance de leur entreprise. Depuis notre création en 1974, nous  nous mobilisons au quotidien pour soutenir et accompagner les entreprises en difficulté et leurs salariés .  Année après année,  notre mission reste inébranlable : avancer les créances salariales des employés des entreprises en procédure collective . Véritable amortisseur social ne se limitant pas au versement des salaires,  notre action vise aussi à assurer la continuité économique des entreprises en difficulté et à préserver l’emploi .  L’AGS est le régime le plus protecteur au monde, en termes de montants avancés, de couverture des créances salariales et de délais de paiement. Plus qu’un mécanisme de protection, un soutien inconditionnel. Une dynamique collective déployée chaque jour au cœur des territoires avec nos parties prenantes.      Ce que vous allez vivre chez nous    Donner du sens à votre expertise en contribuant à une mission d’utilité publique qui protège les salariés et préserve l’emploi.  Être acteur du changement en pilotant des projets concrets pour faire évoluer nos services et améliorer l’expérience de nos usagers.  Avoir un impact à l’échelle nationale en fédérant nos équipes autour d’une relation usager toujours plus simple, efficace et adaptée aux besoins du terrain.       Votre mission :       Développer l’offre de service de l’AGS    Identifier les besoins des salariés bénéficiaires, entreprises, mandataires judiciaires, dirigeants et partenaires afin d’adapter les services proposés  Structurer les parcours usagers et améliorer la lisibilité des informations mises à disposition  Proposer des évolutions de services, de processus ou de supports pour renforcer la qualité et l’efficacité de la relation usager  Piloter les évolutions de services et de processus au sein des Centres  Veiller à la cohérence entre les parcours usagers, les processus métiers associés et les supports opérationnels mis à disposition du réseau       Piloter la satisfaction usager et la gestion des réclamations    Structurer une démarche nationale de satisfaction usagers et de traitement homogène des réclamations  Définir les modalités de recueil, d’analyse et de restitution des retours usagers  Identifier les irritants, signaux faibles et ruptures de parcours afin de proposer des plans d’action  Assurer un retour d’expérience régulier auprès du réseau et de la Direction nationale.  Exploiter les retours usagers et les réclamations comme leviers d’amélioration continue des processus métier et des parcours associés       Sécuriser le déploiement

title: Onboarding Manager (m/w/d) – Customer Onboarding für Praxissoftware
description: Berlin | Hybrid   Du erklärst gern, behältst bei mehreren Projekten den Überblick und packst bei technischen Fragen mit an? Dann begleite Arztpraxen beim Wechsel auf eine neue Software – vom ersten Planungsgespräch bis zum erfolgreichen Go-live.     DOMUS Consult sucht für einen Anbieter cloudbasierter Praxisverwaltungssoftware im Raum Berlin einen  Onboarding Manager (m/w/d) . Im Customer Onboarding verbindest du Projektmanagement, Technik und persönlichen Kundenkontakt. Dein Ziel: Software Onboarding für Arztpraxen so gestalten, dass Praxisteams gut vorbereitet mit ihrem neuen System arbeiten können.      Du machst aus einem Softwarewechsel einen guten Start    Du steuerst das gesamte Onboarding von der Vertragsunterschrift bis zum Go-live und der anschließenden Übergabe an den Kundenservice.  Du lernst die Abläufe und Anforderungen der Praxen kennen und konfigurierst das Praxisverwaltungssystem entsprechend.  Du koordinierst die Datenmigration gemeinsam mit dem internen Datenmigrationsteam.  Du schulst Ärztinnen, Ärzte, Medizinische Fachangestellte und das Praxismanagement – verständlich und passend zum jeweiligen Wissensstand.  Du bringst alle Beteiligten zusammen: Praxisteams, Labore, externe IT-Dienstleister und Anbieter der Telematikinfrastruktur.  Du bleibst die zentrale Ansprechperson für deine Praxen und gibst Feedback sowie eigene Verbesserungsideen an Produktmanagement und Entwicklung weiter.       Du kannst erklären, organisieren und mitdenken   Du bringst  mindestens ein Jahr Erfahrung im Projektmanagement oder mindestens drei Jahre im Customer Service beziehungsweise Customer Success im IT- oder Softwareumfeld  mit.  Außerdem passt die Rolle zu dir, wenn du:   sicher vor Gruppen auftrittst und Freude daran hast, anderen etwas verständlich zu erklären;  ein gutes technisches Verständnis mitbringst und bei Hardware- und Netzwerkthemen praktisch mit anpackst;  mehrere Projekte strukturiert organisierst und auch bei Hindernissen nach Lösungen suchst;  klar und freundlich kommunizierst, gern im Team arbeitest und Verantwortung für deine Ziele übernimmst;  den Gesundheitsmarkt kennenlernen möchtest und situativ flexibel bist;  verhandlungssicher Deutsch auf Niveau C1/C2 sprichst und gute Englischkenntnisse hast.    Zusätzlich hilfreich:  Erfahrung mit Praxisverwaltungssystemen oder Praxisabläufen, etwa als MFA, Kenntnisse der Telematikinfrastruktur, Erfahrung als Trainer oder Schulungsleitung sowie Salesforce- oder vergleichbare CRM-Kenntnisse. Das sind Pluspunkte, keine Voraussetzungen.      Damit du selbst gut ankommst   Dich erwartet eine strukturierte Einarbeitung in das Produkt, den Praxisalltag und die Telematikinfrastruktur. Du arbeitest im Support- und Onboarding-Team eng mit der Teamleitung zusammen und kannst auf kollegiale Unterstützung zählen.  Zum Angebot gehören ein Büroarbeitsplatz in Berlin mit teilweiser Homeoffice-Möglichkeit, kurze Entscheidungswege und Gestaltungsspielraum bei der Weiterentwicklung des Onboardings

title: Customer Renewal Manager
description: Our Company   At Teradata, we believe that people thrive when empowered with better information.  Teradata Autonomous Knowledge Platform activates enterprise intelligence by unifying data, knowledge and business context to achieve tangible outcomes.  With Teradata, organizations can provide agents with full context for impact when it matters.  Our solution lets businesses connect and scale on premises, in the cloud, or through a hybrid approach.  Teradata delivers real business value with AI. As part of Teradata’s Go-To-Market (GTM) organization, this position will serve as the primary role responsible for sustaining/renewing customers and growing our ARR baseline.  The CRM will partner closely with the Account team including Customer Experience and Finance to ensure effective account collaboration and cancels and erosions prevention.   The CRM will be responsible for managing several customers to business objectives including recurring revenue retention and growth, on-time renewal execution, expansions, and outlook accuracy.  The CRM will work with the account team on account planning to identify customer needs/risks and opportunities both in preparation for upcoming renewals as well as mid-term adjustments and Cloud opportunities.  The CRM is responsible for being the expert in Teradata’s renewal/sustainment strategy and works directly with the customer to negotiate standard and custom renewals including terms, SLAs and penalties. description: Role Overview:      We are seeking an experienced Brokerage Technology & Solutions Manager with strong end-to-end knowledge of the Forex/CFD brokerage ecosystem. title: Technical Account Manager
description:
About Us:

Spreedly is the Intelligent Payments Platform for businesses that want to own their payments strategy. Founded in 2007 and headquartered in Durham, NC, we give merchants, platforms, and fintechs a single API to connect to 150+ payment gateways and 40+ payment methods across 100+ countries, along with the intelligence to decide where every transaction should go. We're vendor-agnostic by design. Our customers choose their providers, keep their payment data portable, and never have to rebuild their stack to adopt something new.

Payments are getting more complex, not less. Every new market, payment method, fraud tool, and now every AI agent checking out on a shopper's behalf adds another integration and another decision. Spreedly turns that complexity into an advantage. Our PCI Level 1 vault keeps cards and network tokens portable across providers. Smart routing and retries recover revenue lost to avoidable declines. Fraud and 3DS tools plug in with a single API call. And our payments intelligence turns transaction data into decisions merchants can act on. As agentic commerce moves from experiment to real sales channel, we're building the infrastructure that lets merchants accept agent-initiated payments through the providers they already trust.

For the people who work here, that means hard technical problems at real scale, billions of dollars in annual transactions, at a moment when the rules of commerce are being rewritten. If you want ownership and work that shows up directly in your customers' revenue, you'll fit right in.

About the Role:

As a Technical Account Manager, you will be a key player in our pre-sales and customer solutioning efforts. You will partner closely with Account Executives, Product, and Engineering to scope technical solutions that align with customer needs and drive Spreedly's growth. This is a customer-facing, consultative role focused on understanding prospect pain points and designing solutions that connect Spreedly's platform capabilities to business outcomes.

You will also influence revenue growth, shorten time-to-close, and accelerate value realization for our customers. As Spreedly scales, this role will shape our go-to-market infrastructure through solution templates, demo assets, and mentoring, making it an ideal opportunity for impact and professional growth.

This is a US-based customer-facing role supporting primarily US customers and cross-functional teams operating within US business hours. Success in this role requires regular travel within the United States and the ability to work in alignment with US customer and internal stakeholder schedules.

description:
About GiveDirectly

What if the most effective way to fight poverty was also the simplest: give people money and trust them to decide what they need?

Since 2011, GiveDirectly has proven that idea at scale. We’ve delivered more than $1B in cash directly to 2+ million people living in poverty and crisis across 15 countries, and rigorous research shows the results: healthier kids, stronger businesses, sturdier homes, and more resilient families and local economies. Cash is now widely recognized as one of the most scalable, cost-effective, and dignified forms of aid.

Our ambition goes beyond our own programs. We want cash to become the benchmark for aid, much as the index fund became the benchmark for investing, so that every aid dollar is held to one question: is this doing more good than giving the money directly to people living in poverty?

We’re growing fast, and this is a rare and important moment to join.

We expect to hit $1B in revenue in 2026 with significant growth forecast for 2027. At the same time we are building a new technology stack and operating model designed for a roughly 10x change in scale, and we are actively pursuing partnerships with major funders to move even more money in bigger ways, to people who need it. We are known for our extensive integration of technology into field processes; our quantitative approach to performance measurement; and our commitment to rigorous, independent, experimental evaluation of our impact, with multiple Randomized Control Trials completed and others in progress.

Our team spans 20+ countries and 69 languages. Our culture is candid, analytical, and non-hierarchical. We expect high ownership and give people real responsibility early. Our values are central to how we hire, work, and grow, and they are deliberately opinionated:
