About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

The Role

Nebius is looking for a Senior Product Manager to own Commercial Agreements and Pricing Mechanics within the Billing Platform team.

Our billing platform is how Nebius turns AI infrastructure into a business. As the company grows, Sales and GTM teams need increasingly sophisticated commercial constructs: commitments, credits, custom terms, multi-tenant setups. Your mission is to make sure every deal the business needs is supported by the billing platform out of the box, with as few unsupported custom deals as possible, and to build pricing mechanics that help maximize revenue.

This is a role at the intersection of product, commerce, and engineering. You will translate commercial intent into billing capabilities: well-defined product mechanics with clear rules, data models, and self-service potential.

Responsibilities

  • Own the vision, roadmap, and backlog for commercial agreements and pricing mechanics in the Nebius billing platform
  • Design and ship billing support for commercial constructs
  • Develop pricing mechanics that drive revenue growth, such as dynamic pricing models
  • Systematically reduce the number of deals billing cannot support out of the box: identify recurring deal patterns and turn them into productized capabilities
  • Partner closely with Sales, GTM, Finance, Legal, and Operations on deal structures and contract mechanics; work with the billing engineering team on design and delivery
  • Own discovery, requirements, delivery, and success metrics for your domain, and keep documentation and internal enablement up to date

Who we are looking for

  • 5+ years of product management experience, including hands-on ownership of billing, monetization, or pricing products
  • Solid technical grounding: you are comfortable discussing APIs, data models, and billing pipelines with engineers and can reason about system design trade-offs, even if you do not write production code
  • Experience operating in an enterprise B2B

title: Software Engineer/C Developer-PGD
description:

EDB provides a data and AI platform that enables organizations to harness the full power of Postgres for transactional, analytical, and AI workloads across any cloud, anywhere. What will set you apart:

title: Senior Solution Engineer (Pre-Sales)
description:
About Zip

Zip is the AI platform for enterprise procurement — built for humans and agents working together. By orchestrating procurement across teams, tools, and suppliers with the help of AI agents, companies can secure the resources they need to innovate faster than ever before.

The world’s most influential enterprises trust Zip, including T-Mobile, OpenAI, AMD, Mars, Dollar Tree, and more. Together they’ve saved over $8 billion and processed over $500 billion in spend. Zip’s team includes product leaders from Apple, Airbnb, and Meta, as well as former procurement leaders from United Health, Sanofi, MGM Resorts, Discover, and NASA.

Backed by Adams Street, Alkeon, BOND, CRV, DST, Tiger Global, and Y Combinator, Zip has raised $371 million, most recently at a $2.2 billion valuation and has been recognized by Forbes Fintech 50, Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies, Inc. Best in Business, and LinkedIn Top Startups.

Your Role

As a Zip Solutions Engineer, you are the primary pre-sales technical point of contact for the Zip solution suite. Your role is to be a champion for Zip, helping our prospects understand how our application will deliver value to their organisation, and where Zip fits with their procurement and technical landscape. You are a partner in selling, fostering collaborative relationships with account executives and sales managers to drive deals to closure.

You are a trusted advisor to our prospective customers, giving them confidence that Zip can address their pain points, and helping translate their needs to our post-sales solutions consultants to ensure a successful deployment. You are a subject matter expert on our solution capabilities and our roadmap. You funnel customer feedback to influence our product development efforts and help our sales partners understand how our newly developed solutions or enhancements are most effectively communicated.

You will be an integral part of the success for both our customers and Sales Team by performing technical discovery qualification, delivering product demonstrations and Proof of Concepts, delivering technical workshops, and making architectural recommendations. As a hardworking technologist and customer advocate, you will connect the dots between the technical solution to the business outcomes for the customer.

You Will

  • Actively contribute to Zip’s sales efforts by supporting prospective customer-facing conversations, effectively conducting discovery, demonstrating our solutions, handling questions, and overcoming objections to help our prospects see the value in choosing Zip.

  • Own responsibility for responding to customer asks, including follow-up questions, demos, RFx and IT security questionnaires.

  • Build and develop custom demos that match customer requirements

About Pair Team

At Pair Team, we’re an innovative, mission-driven company reimagining how Medicaid and Medicare serves the most underserved populations. As a tech-enabled medical group, we deliver whole-person care—clinical, behavioral, and social—by partnering with organizations deeply connected to the communities we serve.

We’re building a care model that empowers clinicians and care teams to do what they do best: provide compassionate, high-impact care. At Pair Team, we leverage AI and automation to reduce administrative burden, streamline coordination, and ensure patients receive timely, personalized support.

Our work is powered by a deeply collaborative team of nurses, social workers, community health workers, and medical professionals working alongside product, technology, and operations to close care gaps and improve outcomes for high-need patients.

We’re one of the largest Enhanced Care Management providers in California and are on track to build the nation’s largest clinically integrated network supporting high-need patients. Our model has demonstrated real impact, including a 58% reduction in emergency department visits and a 29% reduction in hospital admissions.

At Pair Team, we’re not just delivering care—we’re building the future of more equitable, community-driven healthcare.

Our Values

  • Lead with integrity: We keep our commitments and take responsibility for our actions. We are dependable and choose authenticity over perfection.
  • Embrace challenges: We leave our egos at the door and step forward into discomfort instead of back into safety. We help each other to learn and provide feedback using candor and kindness.
  • Break through walls: We go the extra mile for our patients, partners and one another, and we run toward hard things. We are resilient in our push for consistent improvement and challenge the status quo.
  • Act beyond yourself: We build each other up and respect boundaries. We seek first to understand and assume positive intent.
  • Care comes first: We hold ourselves to the highest standards for our patients. We are relentless in the pursuit of our mission, and ensure that we are taking care of ourselves in order to care for others.

In the News

  • Forbes: For Pair Team, Accessibility Is About Delivering Healthcare To Those Who Need It

title: Manager, Technical Account Teams (Europe)
description:
About Us

Socket helps devs and security teams ship faster by cutting out security busywork. Thousands of orgs use Socket to safely find, audit, and manage open source code. Our customers - from Anthropic to xAI, and Figma to Vercel - love Socket (just check out their tweets to see for yourself!)

Founded by Feross Aboukhadijeh, a long-time open source maintainer with software downloaded over a billion times a month, Socket has raised $125M in funding from top angels, operators, and security leaders.

About the Role

Our customers are the most demanding buyers in software: security teams and engineers who can smell fluff from a mile away. Keeping them successful takes a technical post-sales team, and those teams need strong leaders driving them.

You'll lead a team of EMEA-based Technical Account Managers who own everything after the deal closes: onboarding, adoption, customer health, and the deep technical partnership that keeps engineers happy. Your team owns making sure there's never a product reason to walk away.

You have deep experience in post-sales, a track record of coaching team members to success, and have owned retention numbers that matter. You’ve been the person others go to for guidance, and you’re looking for the right opportunity to manage a small, dynamic team.

The Socket blueprints exist: segmentation, a health score model, role charters, and playbooks are drafted. Now we’re hiring a leadership layer to strengthen our operating muscle: automation, targets, cadences, team accountability and growth.

You'll inherit a strong team and a customer base that genuinely loves the product. Your job is to turn the blueprint into a retention engine that runs without heroics.

What You'll Do

  • Lead, coach, and grow a team of TAMs. Hire ahead of need as we scale.

  • Own adoption, customer health, and gross retention outcomes across the customer base, partnering with AEs who own the enterprise renewal

  • Influence and mature the post-sales operating system: our segmentation, health scoring, and lifecycle playbooks exist. Make them run, then make them better. QBRs should tell a real story with real data instead of a slide of vanity metrics.

  • Be the senior escalation point when an account is at risk. Run the deep dive, build the save plan, and see it through.

title: Frontend Engineer
description:
About Shiftbase

We build workforce software that helps people get work done. More than 10,000 companies use our platform every month to plan shifts and track time, with less admin in the way.

We work from our Zoetermeer office with over 80 people and we grow every year. The culture is open and informal. You can push back on an idea regardless of title, and we change how we work when someone makes the case in retro.

About the role

You build frontend features that customers use the day you release them. You sit in a product team with backend, QA, design and product, and you take a feature from a rough product idea to a screen a planner can use without a manual.

Your time is a balance between working on features, bugs and resolving technical debt.

Claude Code is how our engineers write software. Everyone here uses it daily, and whole features now go out with an agent doing most of the coding. You still own what you merge, so you read the diff, you know why it works, and you can defend it in review. The interesting part of the job is deciding what to hand to an agent, what to write yourself, and what context the agent needs to get it right the first time.

title: Solutions Architect
description:
About Plane

Plane's mission is to build the infrastructure the world's work runs on. Every organization runs on three things: the projects it's driving, the knowledge it keeps, and the requests it fields. Plane brings all three into one open, adaptable platform: simple enough for any team to adopt, dependable enough for organizations to build on. And we are building it for a future where humans and AI agents do that work together.

 

Plane began in public on GitHub at the end of 2022. Since then it has grown into a work management platform used by teams around the world: 55,000+ stars, 5,000+ forks, and a contributor community that reads our code and files our issues. Organizations run Plane as a managed Cloud service, on their own infrastructure, or inside fully isolated environments. Building in the open keeps us close to users and raises the standard for everything we ship.

 

Plane is the #1 work infrastructure in aerospace, defense, financial services, and other regulated industries: organizations whose requirements for control, auditability, and data residency rule most software out. When the strictest buyers pick a system of record, that choice means something. Adoption is growing fastest on Plane Cloud and in sovereign clouds, deployments that keep everything inside a country's own borders and rules.

 

Plane is backed by top investors and built across San Francisco, London, and Hyderabad. We work in tightly knit teams, stay close to users, and care about the visible product as much as the unglamorous details that make software dependable. People own problems end to end, and we add process only when it helps the work.

title: Senior Performance Creative Strategist (gn) @ Female Health Consumer Startup, London
description:
About DITTO

DITTO is a science-led brand redefining menstrual health. As a fast-growing, VC-backed business, we're scaling a new standard in menstrual wellbeing — empowering anyone with cycle symptoms to understand, support and optimise their health every day, not just during their period. Developed by female scientists and powered by biotechnology, the Cycle Supplement is backed by over 100 clinical trials and validated in its own clinical trial.

Beyond the capsule, DITTO is building a movement — combining credible science, thoughtful design, and inclusive storytelling to change how menstrual health is perceived and supported. As we grow, performance creative will be central to how we convert attention into action.

About the role

You will sit at the intersection of data and creativity — turning science into content that stops the scroll and drives sales. This is a hands-on, high-ownership role. You will define what makes a potential customer stop, engage, and convert — and then build the systems to do it at scale.

You are not just briefing others. You are embedded in the work from the first concept through to post-production feedback and the next iteration. If you are equally energised by diving into data and dreaming up ideas, this role was built for you.

Performance creative strategy

  • Own creative strategy across Meta, TikTok and YouTube with clear KPIs across ROAS, conversion and scalable growth.

  • Develop creative frameworks that harness DITTO's scientific credibility to build trust and drive purchase decisions.

  • Analyse performance data to surface winning signals, identify trends and shape the next generation of assets.

  • Build and own a structured testing roadmap — challenging creative hypotheses, running experiments and scaling what works.

We build companies from zero, putting capital, our own team, and hands-on operating time behind a founding team before there's a product or even a name. The studio's work spans wherever a market and the data or infrastructure underneath it are broken enough to justify building the fix from scratch.

General Data is the infrastructure for licensing proprietary data: The platform runs the whole deal from request to delivery, with privacy checks, rights evidence and contracts built in. The vision is to become the system of record between AI and the world’s private data, the data that has never been published but that the next generation of AI depends on. On one side are enterprises, AI labs and robotics teams that need real-world data, and on the other are companies whose operations generate it. General Data is the data infrastructure for the modern economy, connecting every party so that data can be licensed safely, transparently and at scale.

AI has absorbed the public internet, and its next gains will come from private, real-world data, yet today these deals still run on email, WhatsApp and brokers, with no visibility into what was checked, who holds the rights, or whether personal data was removed. title: 3D Chiplet Engineer

About Us : AI compute is hitting a hard physical wall, and memory bottlenecks are throttling the entire industry. Our underlying technology is validated, and we have successfully met our core technical milestones. Armed with a proven technical data package and ongoing system studies, we are now shifting from pure R&D to active engagement with global enterprise customers. This job sits at the intersection of SoC architecture (specifically the physical design) , package design, and 3D manufacturing processes.

title: Embedded Software Designer
description:
De uitdaging

Wij zoeken per direct een Embedded Software Designer voor ons zusterbedrijf Veynex in de regio Limburg / Brabant. Haal jij voldoening uit het ontwikkelen van slimme technische oplossingen en complexe softwarevraagstukken? Dan past deze rol bij je.

Als Embedded Software Designer werk je binnen multidisciplinaire ontwikkelomgevingen aan innovatieve projecten met hoge kwaliteitsnormen. Je bent betrokken bij het volledige ontwikkelproces: van requirements en architectuur tot implementatie en testing. Je werkt samen met ervaren engineers en krijgt volop ruimte om jouw technische kennis verder uit te bouwen.

Wat ga je doen?

Als Embedded Software Designer ben je verantwoordelijk voor het ontwerpen, bouwen en verbeteren van embedded softwareoplossingen. Je stelt technische architecturen op, ontwikkelt software in C en/of C++, en test de werking van systemen. Daarnaast integreer je verschillende softwaremodules en zorg je voor duidelijke documentatie.

Je werkt aan projecten binnen Embedded Linux, RTOS of OS-less omgevingen en schakelt regelmatig met collega’s uit andere disciplines.

Hoe je impact maakt

Je bent een belangrijke schakel binnen het ontwikkelteam en zorgt ervoor dat softwareoplossingen betrouwbaar, efficiënt en toekomstbestendig zijn. Door jouw inzet verlopen projecten soepel en worden technische uitdagingen succesvol opgelost. Je draagt bij aan innovatieve producten en de groei van het team.

Wat je van ons krijgt

  • Salaris: €3.750 - €5.500 bruto p/m, afhankelijk van ervaring

  • Goede begel

title: Test Engineer
description:
Analyseren, (functioneel) testen, debuggen… Waar houd jij je als test engineer bij ons eigenlijk niet mee bezig!?

Als test engineer is iedere werkdag anders. De complexe producten die wij maken voor onze klanten, maken gebruik van proces- en functionele testers. Uitval hiervan wordt geanalyseerd en testers worden gedebugged. Dit wordt in samenwerking met ons Test Development team gedaan, die onze testers hebben ontwikkeld, gebouwd én vrijgegeven. Het grootste gedeelte van je werkdag ben je bezig met praktische en analytische werkzaamheden.

Een greep uit je werkzaamheden als test engineer:

  • Testen van prototypes: in een losse testopstelling op je werkbank meten.

  • Debuggen/functioneel testen in Labview: bijvoorbeeld na uitval op de functionele tester.

  • Sustainable analyseren: uitzoeken wat er is gebeurd, waarom is dit gebeurd en hoe we dit in de toekomst kunnen voorkomen.

  • Reparatie van uitgevallen producten; uitval na o.a. AOI, Flying probe of functionele testers of retouren vanuit de klant.

  • Interne overleggen: bijvoorbeeld met je collega’s van de afdeling Quality, Engineering etc.

  • Technisch challengen: niet alleen bij Benchmark collega’s, maar soms ook bij de klant.

Jij zorgt in alles wat je doet voor de juiste analyses en verwerking hiervan. Hierdoor worden afwijkingen gefilterd en gesignaleerd, worden root-causes vastgesteld en opgelost en blijft het productieproces continu verbeteren.

description:

Als Senior Quality Engineer ben je een sleutelspeler in het naar een hoger volwassenheidsniveau brengen van onze kwaliteitsperformance. Je acteert proactief, signaleert risico’s vóórdat ze problemen worden en stuurt op duurzame oplossingen. Je bent geen volger van processen, maar mede‑vormgever van hoe kwaliteit wordt geborgd, verbeterd en beleefd wordt bij ons.

Een belangrijk onderdeel van je rol is het inhoudelijk en methodisch leiden van verbetertrajecten, waaronder het aanjagen en begeleiden van het Quality Improvement Team (QIT‑proces). Je fungeert daarbij als coach, challenger en inhoudelijk geweten.

Wat ga je, onder andere, doen?

  • Proactief analyseren van kwaliteitsafwijkingen, trends en risico’s om structurele, systeemgedreven oorzaken bloot te leggen.

  • Leiden van root cause analyses en borgen van effectieve, duurzame CAPA’s.

  • Initiëren, ontwikkelen en borgen van kwaliteitsstandaarden, procedures en werkinstructies.

  • Voorbereiden, uitvoeren en doelgericht benutten van interne en externe audits.

  • Analyseren en vertalen van kwaliteits‑KPI’s naar concrete verbeteracties en besluitvorming.

  • Regie voeren op kwaliteit binnen NPI‑projecten, inclusief kritische beoordeling van deliverables en klantspecificaties.

title: IAM Platform Engineer - PKI & Cloud Native
description:

Bouw jij hier aan mee?

In deze rol werk je aan de technische fundamenten onder veilige toegang en betrouwbare machine-to-machine communicatie. Je werkt op het snijvlak van identity, security en platformengineering.

title: wo-stage economie: Nowcasting Model voor BBP
description:
wo-praktijkstage,

start in overleg

Krijg jij energie van het bouwen van slimme datamodellen die economische groei voorspellen nog voordat alle cijfers binnen zijn? Duik jij graag in data, ontdek je nieuwe databronnen en wil je met jouw analyses échte impact maken op officiële bbp-ramingen?
Dan is deze stage in nowcasting en econometrie precies wat je zoekt.

Dit is jouw uitdaging

Bij het ramen van de kwartaalcijfers van het bbp (economische groei) gebruiken we voor een aantal bedrijfstakken momenteel een relatief eenvoudige methode: de ontwikkeling van het aantal banen dient als benadering voor de economische activiteit. Dit gebeurt omdat directe en tijdige broninformatie ontbreekt. Een belangrijk gevolg hiervan is dat we de eerste ramingen later vaak moeten bijstellen wanneer er meer volledige data beschikbaar komt bij de definitieve raming (ongeveer anderhalf jaar later).

Het is aan jou om deze methodiek te verbeteren.

Je gaat een geavanceerder model ontwikkelen waarmee we de economische activiteit van deze bedrijfstakken kort na afloop van de verslagperiode nauwkeuriger kunnen inschatten. Dit wordt ook wel “nowcasting” genoemd. Het doel is om dichter bij de uiteindelijke realisatie te zitten en daarmee het aantal en de omvang van latere bijstellingen te verkleinen.

title: wo-stage statistiek: data-analyse en weegmethoden
description:
wo-afstudeerstage, start in overleg

Op zoek naar een statistiekstage?
Analyseer bij het CBS weegmethoden en non-respons met R en draag bij aan betere statistieken voor Nederland.

Dit is jouw uitdaging

Het CBS trekt steekproeven onder de Nederlandse bevolking om diverse statistieken te maken. Hierbij is sprake van selectieve non-respons. Om voor deze non-respons te corrigeren, voeren we een zogenaamde weging uit, waarbij personen een gewicht krijgen op basis van hun onder- of oververtegenwoordiging in de respons. Personen met achtergrondkenmerken die ondervertegenwoordigd zijn in de respons, krijgen dan een groter gewicht dan personen met achtergrondkenmerken die oververtegenwoordigd zijn. Zie bijvoorbeeld [1] voor algemene informatie over wegen.

Bij het uitvoeren van een weging zijn er diverse zaken om rekening mee te houden. Zo kan niet voor alle achtergrondkenmerken worden gecorrigeerd voor scheefheid, omdat de gewichten dan te extreem zouden worden. Daarnaast is het vaak verstandig om überhaupt niet voor te veel achtergrondkenmerken te corrigeren, omdat dit een negatieve invloed heeft op de marges van de schattingen voor de doelvariabelen van een onderzoek. Ook is er een relatie met de doelvariabelen in het onderzoek: op het moment dat er een samenhang is tussen een achtergrondkenmerk en de doelvariabelen van een onderzoek, is het wenselijk om wél voor dat achtergrondkenmerk te corrigeren als dat kenmerk scheef in de respons zit. title: wo-stage statistiek: data-analyse kwaliteit van de respons
description:
wo-afstudeerstage, start in overleg

Ben jij die nieuwsgierige statistiekstudent die energie krijgt van data-analyse en complexe vraagstukken? Wil je onderzoeken hoe keuzes in het steekproefproces de respons en kwaliteit van statistieken beïnvloeden? Tijdens deze afstudeerstage bij het CBS duik je in echte data, werk je met R en draag je bij aan betere statistieken voor Nederland.

Dit is jouw uitdaging

Het CBS trekt steekproeven onder de Nederlandse bevolking om diverse statistieken te maken. Hierbij is sprake van selectieve nonrespons. We ondernemen diverse pogingen om de respons zo gelijkmatig mogelijk te laten zijn (naar diverse achtergrondkenmerken van personen). We proberen daarbij zo veel mogelijk respons binnen te krijgen, maar kijken tegelijkertijd ook naar de samenstelling van de respons. In het bijzonder kijken we daar bij diverse onderzoeken naar in de vorm van doelgroepgericht benaderen [1].

Omdat het verzenden van brieven steeds duurder wordt, wordt de afweging tussen kwaliteit en kosten ook voor onderzoeken die alleen via internetwaarneming plaatsvinden steeds relevanter. Bij dit soort onderzoeken worden meerdere brieven verstuurd als personen niet direct de vragenlijst invullen. Omdat deze brieven steeds duurder worden, lijkt het voor de hand te liggen om geen herinneringen te sturen naar personen die nog niet gerespondeerd hebben, maar tegelijkertijd ook tot groepen behoren die al voldoende gerespondeerd hebben. title: hbo-stage bedrijfseconomie: data-analyse & bedrijfsstatistieken
description:
hbo-praktijkstage, vanaf februari 2027

Ben jij die leergierige stagiair die graag met bedrijfsdata werkt en helpt om betrouwbare omzetcijfers over het Nederlandse bedrijfsleven te publiceren?
Krijg jij energie van het duiken in bedrijfscijfers, het ontdekken van trends en het nagaan of alles klopt?

Dit is jouw uitdaging

De sector Bedrijvenstatistieken van het CBS publiceert statistieken over het Nederlandse bedrijfsleven. Denk daarbij onder andere aan de omzetontwikkelingen per branche en de dienstenprijzenindex.
Tijdens jouw stage ga je aan de slag met het verwerken van de omzetgegevens (microdata) die bedrijven aanleveren. Je bekijkt grafieken en trends, signaleert opvallende patronen en onderzoekt of bedrijven hun gegevens correct hebben aangeleverd. Jouw analytisch inzicht en nauwkeurigheid zorgen ervoor dat de cijfers betrouwbaar zijn voordat we ze publiceren.
Je helpt ons bij het actualiseren van werkbeschrijvingen en procedures.
Je controleert of de jaargegevens correct worden verwerkt in de programmatuur voor het nieuwe jaar.
Je onderzoekt of er nieuwe (boekhoudkundige) regelingen zijn voor bedrijven en geef je advies over hoe we deze kunnen verwerken in de vragenlijsten die we uitzetten.

description:
About Cellsor

Cameras digitized vision. Microphones digitized sound. Smell is the one major sense we still can't capture, measure or transmit reliably. Cellsor is building the sensor that changes that.

We replicate the mammalian olfactory epithelium outside the body – living olfactory tissue on microelectrode arrays – and read it out with machine learning. The result is a sensor that detects chemicals the way a nose does, with the breadth and sensitivity that conventional gas sensors lack. Applications span flavor and fragrance, defense and security, medical diagnostics, food quality and industrial monitoring.

We are a VC-backed Tufts University spin-out with a working proof of principle and paid industry pilots, with teams in Boston (biology) and Munich (engineering).

About the role

As our first engineer in Munich, you develop the instrument that keeps our living sensor tissue alive and samples the air it analyzes. You take it from today's lab setup to a field-ready prototype at a customer site within 18 months.

What you will do:

  • Define the instrument architecture, then build prototypes across mechanics, fluidics and housing

  • Develop automated media exchange that keeps cells viable for weeks to months

  • Build the air path: sampling, filtration and controlled delivery of odorants to the sensor

  • Integrate sensors, pumps and controllers for monitoring and automation

  • Test and iterate with our Boston biology team<

Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). title: Sales Account Executive - Cybersecurity

Passionate about Cybersecurity, open-source or network effect products? Interested in Sales?

Join CrowdSec to build a safer internet for everyone.

What we do

We aim to deter opportunistic and organized cybercrime through an Internet-scale, real-time security network. This network is powered by hundreds of thousands of servers sharing the aggression they block with our open-source software. By coupling this local behavior analysis and sharing its findings within our community, we create a real-time map of IP addresses used by cybercriminals, a large-scale reputation system, and a Crowd-Sourced Cyber Threat Intelligence of unprecedented magnitude that will counter the vast majority of technical hacks.

Who We Are

CrowdSec is a human-sized team of cybersecurity experts. Most of the team has worked remotely since day 1. The CrowdSec solution is used in 180+ countries, it is a well-known, unique, collaborative, open-source security solution that protects hundreds thousands of users. We are animated by a mission: making the Internet a safer place, all together.

Role

As an Account Executive (AE), you will work with the Sales team to help them scale, create new opportunities, interact with them, convert them to Leads, and take the accounts to signature. This will be done in collaboration with the BDRs, presales, Marketing, and Support teams to ensure the most pleasant customer journey.


Must-have

  • A track record of success in selling Cybersecurity software solutions

  • A pre-existing customer/contact base to work on to kickstart your tenure

  • Knowledges of fundamental cybersecurity mechanism

title: ML Platform Engineer
description:
About us

Bleu Robotics is an AI company developing universal AI software for the deployment of advanced robots , humanoids, mobile manipulators, and industrial arms, in real factories. The convergence of humanoid robotics and modern AI is one of the most significant technical opportunities of the decade, and most of the work today still happens in research settings. We are building the software layer required to bring it into operational use.

We have a strong ambition to become the next Microsoft to run on every industrial humanoid. We have closed our pre-seed round with Top-tier fund to deploy our robot in Tier 1 manufacturing facilities.

We are looking for deeply passionate scientists who can help us push the frontier and build a major lab in physical AI.

Our vision

To enable a robot to learn a new industrial task from a few demonstrations and operate autonomously, with under one hour between the start of the demonstration and the start of deployment.

title: Senior Full-Stack Engineer (Web + Infrastructure)
description:
Searoutes makes the emissions data that shippers use to run and reduce their
logistics. It is an operational problem before it is an environmental one, and
in our hands it is mostly an engineering one.

We are hiring a senior engineer who works across our web frontend and our
infrastructure — the same two codebases, in the same week. Someone who ships a
product screen on Monday, changes an identity-provider flow on Wednesday, and
considers those the same job.

We are looking for a broad profile rather than a specialist. The next year is
mostly platform work with a user-facing edge — user management, API gateway
management, payments, SEO, and a great deal of compliance, GDPR and ISO 27001.

If you are passionate about the environment, proactive and pragmatic in getting
things done, and love to work in a complex but fascinating industry where you
learn every day — then this is the place for you.

The work in front of us

Some of the items on our tech roadmap for the coming year. Bets are picked a
cycle at a time and shared out, so you would take the ones that suit you and
grow into the rest.

  • Product and marketing UI in React — multi-brand, WCAG AA, strong on
    technical SEO, fast enough to hold a performance budget.
  • User management and identity — Keycloak realms, organisation hierarchies,
    partner brokering, and the entitlement model in the app.
  • API gateway work in APISIX — routes, plugins and auth policy as code.
  • Payments and billing.
  • ISO 27001 and GDPR — access control, change management, audit logging,
    observability and alerting, consent and retention.
  • The infrastructure underneath — Pulumi in TypeScri

title: Engineering Manager
description:
About Kernel

Agents are starting to sell, buy and operate on behalf of companies. But before an agent can close a deal, qualify an account, route a lead or assess risk, it has to answer a basic question: which company is this?

Today, that answer is messy, and no one answers it reliably. Business identity lives across CRMs, ERPs and third-party datasets full of duplicates, missing parent companies, stale addresses and incorrect enrichment. The cost shows up across the enterprise: sales teams miss revenue opportunities because they lack the right account context; operations teams take on avoidable exposure because risk signals are fragmented or wrong; and finance teams end up chasing, writing off, or defaulting on bad debt that should have been caught earlier.

Humans have worked around that mess for years. Agents cannot. They need a reliable business identity layer they can trust.

Kernel is building that layer: the business registry for agents. We issue a permanent KERN ID for every business, plus the context an agent needs to act on it. Ops, data and revenue teams at Gong, Legora, Mistral, Canva and Checkout already use Kernel on their own systems. Agents are next, and there will be far more of them.

We have raised $20M from top VCs and operators at Plaid, OpenAI, Slack and others, and we are growing 5x YoY.

The Role

You'll be a player-coach engineering leader with a spike in technical strategy, you'll own engineering delivery for your team end-to-end - from developing exceptional engineers to solving some of our most difficult engineering problems & setting technical direction

Fractile was founded in 2022 on the bet that, eventually, the world’s most capable AI systems would be limited in their impact by the time taken to produce useful outputs. We bet everything on the logical conclusion: that the only way to truly unlock this latent value, to make speed viable at scale, was to radically re-invent the hardware that we run our frontier AI models on. Ever since, we have been building chips and systems that tackle this problem: how to efficiently generate output at thousands of tokens per second, while handling the complexity and capacity challenges of operating large models at very long contexts.

 

The workloads that push to the limits of the current frontier are already transformational; it is the technical and economic limits on inference speed that are constraining progress. Basecamp Research is building frontier AI for therapeutic design. We believe the future of medicine lies in reprogramming the body to repair itself, and we design the models and the medicines to teach it how.

Our biologists, engineers, ML scientists and field explorers are united by a sense of adventure and the belief that AI, biology and data, will result in new medicines for patients who have few options today.

title: Senior PHP/Go Developer

We mainly use PHP and Go, but it doesn’t actually matter which language you use. As long as it works and is simple. Keep it simple, fail fast.

And we have hefty demands of our own work quality, so we have CI and CD fully set up. Code styling is automatically checked and corrected, security checks are performed and of course our unit tests and functional tests (Cypress and Codeception) run before we roll out. You put your changes into production yourself after a code review and functional test.

Start date: as soon as possible

Let’s be blunt: Kaizo doesn’t have a real marketing engine yet.

We’ve had marketers before, but the company we are today is a different company. Over the past 18 months we’ve signed enterprise customers like Canva, Instacart, UiPath and Indeed. We’ve also rebuilt our product around a new reality: support teams now run on a mix of human agents and AI agents, and someone has to check the quality of both. Kaizo is the independent Agentic QA layer for that hybrid workforce. We work across helpdesks and Customer Service platforms, and we don’t build AI agents of our own, so we have no reason to mark our own homework.

The problem is that the market doesn’t know this yet. We’re the customer service industry’s best-kept secret.

  • The website architecture has just been rebuilt, but the content is outdated and doesn’t tell today’s story.

  • We have strong enterprise customer stories that nobody has written up.

  • Inbound is no longer enough. AI search has changed how buyers find vendors, so pipeline now has to come from outbound, partners, events and reputation.

  • We’re going to the field and starting to attend international events.

  • Sales doesn’t have all the decks, battlecards and collateral it needs.

  • Outbound has started, and it needs content behind it.


That’s where you come in.

What this role really is

We need a senior marketer who wants to build from scratch, and who sees a blank page as an opportunity, not a threat. You’ll be the one who:

  • Brings the website to life so it reflects who we are today and gets found, by people and by AI search.

description: FICO (NYSE: FICO)  is a leading global analytics software company, helping businesses in 100+ countries make better decisions. Join our world-class team today and fulfill your career potential!   The Opportunity   As a Strategic Customer Success Manager at FICO, you'll be a trusted executive partner to some of our most important customers, driving transformational outcomes and sustainable growth across a portfolio of high-value accounts. This is a senior, commercially-oriented role for someone who operates naturally at the C-suite level — someone who can connect FICO's platform capabilities to a customer's most pressing strategic priorities, and turn those connections into long-term, expanding partnerships. You will own the full commercial health of your accounts, serving as the primary driver of retention, expansion, and executive alignment.  This position requires residence in Sydney or Melbourne. You'll be a credible strategic advisor who understands your customers' business models, competitive pressures, and board-level priorities — and can position FICO's solutions accordingly. You won't rely on solution consultants to bridge this gap; you'll be able to hold that conversation yourself.  Drive Transformational Value: Partner with customers to define and deliver against ambitious, measurable outcomes — moving beyond adoption metrics to demonstrate how FICO is materially impacting their business performance, risk posture, and competitive position. title: Account Manager, Large Enterprise Commercial
description: The Company  PayPal has been revolutionizing commerce globally for more than 25 years. Creating innovative experiences that make moving money, selling, and shopping simple, personalized, and secure, PayPal empowers consumers and businesses in approximately 200 markets to join and thrive in the global economy.  We operate a global, two-sided network at scale that connects hundreds of millions of merchants and consumers. We help merchants and consumers connect, transact, and complete payments, whether they are online or in person. PayPal is more than a connection to third-party payment networks. We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers.  We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. We enable consumers to exchange funds more safely with merchants using a variety of funding sources, which may include a bank account, a PayPal or Venmo account balance, PayPal and Venmo branded credit products, a credit card, a debit card, certain cryptocurrencies, or other stored value products such as gift cards, and eligible credit card rewards. Our PayPal, Venmo, and Xoom products also make it safer and simpler for friends and family to transfer funds to each other. We offer merchants an end-to-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We also help merchants connect with their customers, process exchanges and returns, and manage risk. We enable consumers to engage in cross-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross-border trade.  Our beliefs are the foundation for how we conduct business every day. We live each day guided by our core values of Inclusion, Innovation, Collaboration, and Wellness. Together, our values ensure that we work together as one global team with our customers at the center of everything we do – and they push us to ensure we take care of ourselves, each other, and our communities. Voldoe je niet aan alle eisen, maar denk je dat deze functie wel bij je past? Dan horen we nog steeds graag van je.  Wil jij deel uitmaken van een groeiend bedrijf waar je écht impact maakt?  Solliciteer nu en versterk ons team in Nieuwegein!

title: Senior Full Stack Developer (PHP & Vue.js)
description:
At Dyflexis, we help millions of employees worldwide with our workforce management software. From the bakery around the corner to international hotel and retail chains. The software is powerful, customer questions are diverse, and no two days are the same. You'll get to know the product inside out and contribute to something that's growing rapidly in more than 20 other countries.

How do we do it? We work in a fast-paced environment with short communication lines. There are no unnecessary meetings and no politics. Our Focus? Ownership, clear communication, and getting things done together. We move quickly, learn by doing, and continuously improve how we support our customers.  We're expanding the engineering team, and we need a Senior Full Stack developer who moves across the stack and unblocks whatever's stuck, frontend or backend.


This is what you'll do
You'll join a project squad, consisting out of a Product Owner, UX designer, and fellow engineers, and move across the stack as the work demands it. One day you're deep in a Vue.js3 component, the next you're in PHP8 and MySQL sorting out the backend logic that's blocking the Frontend team. Your job isn't to pick a lane; it's to keep features moving from idea to release for over a million users.

You'll start on tickets, get to know the codebase and how we work, then move onto full projects. We build in six-week cycles, followed by two weeks to reflect and reset. Join early, question assumptions, stay close to the team throughout.

title: Special Projects Lead - Category Expansion
description:
Can you help us fix the world's most broken supply chain?

The fashion industry produces over 100 billion garments a year. 60% end up in landfill, not because people don't want these clothes, but because the supply chain for getting secondhand fashion from donation to resale is completely offline, manual and broken.

Fleek is fixing this. Our mission is to make secondhand the first choice. We're building the infrastructure powering the global secondhand clothing trade, through a B2B marketplace and the AI systems digitising the supply chain behind it.

Through Fleek, vintage stores, online resellers and retail buyers source graded secondhand inventory directly from wholesalers and rag houses across multiple countries. Our key enabler is FleekSort, an AI model fine-tuned on secondhand fashion that can grade, price and categorise items with just a photo. The fashion industry produces over 100 billion garments a year. 60% end up in landfill, not because people don't want these clothes, but because the supply chain for getting secondhand fashion from donation to resale is completely offline, manual, and broken.

Fleek is fixing this. Our mission is to make secondhand the first choice. We're building the infrastructure powering the global secondhand clothing trade: a B2B marketplace and the AI systems digitising the supply chain behind it.

Our key enabler is FleekSort, an AI model fine-tuned on secondhand fashion, that can grade, price, and categorise items with just a photo, turning what has historically been an opaque and manual trade into a structured, searchable, and tradable global inventory layer.

title: Generative Media Engineer, AI Social - US
description:
Luxury Presence is building the AI growth platform for real estate. Backed by Bessemer Venture Partners and other top investors, we're a Series C company that has hit $100M in annual recurring revenue. More than 90,000 real estate professionals, including over 30% of the WSJ Real Trends top 100 agents in the United States, use us to run and grow their business.

The Opportunity

AI Social is one of the most ambitious products we've ever shipped. An AI agent that produces on-brand Instagram carousels and reels for every Luxury Presence customer, from raw input data to finished media. It isn't LLMs writing code. It's LLMs designing, choosing the photo, voicing the script, picking the cuts, and composing the final frame.

As the Generative Media Engineer on AI Social, you own the render pipeline, the prompts and agent loops that drive it, and the visual quality of what ships. Product and content strategy partners set the direction; engineering and design peers ship alongside you. This is an unusual role at the intersection of code, design, AI, and social media. You don't fit the normal engineering mold, that's the point.

Skills and experience

  • Solid working knowledge of TypeScript and Node.js. You're comfortable shipping production code and you're ready to grow into our stack.
  • Hands-on experience with LLM-driven systems. Prompts, structured outputs, tool-calling, agent loops, evals.
  • At least one shipped piece of generative media in image, video, voice, or music that someone other than you has seen and used.
  • A portfolio or body of work that demonstrates both technical depth and design sensibility.
  • Bonus: a personal creator practice somewhere. A feed, a portfolio, a side project, a YouTube channel, an Are.na. Public, ongoing, under your own name. You understand the medium because you've lived in it.
  • Formal or self-taught grounding in design, visual art, film, or motion.
  • Comfort moving between exploratory PoC work and shipped-to-customers polish, with judgment about which mode is appropriate when.

Technical fluency with AI tools

  • You're already using Claude Code, Cursor, or similar AI-assisted development tools in your daily workflow. We're a Claude Code shop and we expect you to be fluent.
  • Familiarity with MCPs and how tools like Figma, Notion, and Linear connect into AI-assisted workflows. You understand how these tools and integrations fit together and can help the team get more out of them.
  • Beyond fluency, you're a dabbler and experimenter. You try new prompts, push their limits, and share what you learn. You have opinions about where the medium is headed.

description:
Luxury Presence is building the AI growth platform for real estate. The Opportunity

We don't just use AI. We build with it, ship with it, and think with it. With a generous budget for tokens, our engineers use AI agents to write, review, and ship production code every day. We are building toward a world where humans design systems and AI builds them, and we are already far along that path.

We are hiring a hands-on Engineering Manager to lead Maps & Search. This team owns the home search experience across web and mobile. It's one of the most visible, highest-traffic surfaces–the search service alone handles a billion requests every month.

This is a role for a manager who leads from the front: someone who still lives in their terminal with AI, has strong opinions about how AI changes the SDLC, and wants to amplify what a small, senior, AI-augmented team can accomplish. You will set technical direction, stay close to the code, and help the team produce consistent impact.

What You'll Do

Lead and grow the Maps & Search team. Own hiring, onboarding, coaching, 1:1s, direct feedback, and career development. Treat management as a craft and build a healthy, high-performing team that ships impactful changes.

Stay hands-on. Contribute directly — code and design reviews, architecture, thorny debugging— and stay technical enough to make smart calls on trade-offs.

Own and scale a high-throughput search platform. Drive the architecture, relevance, latency, and reliability of a real estate search system handling ~1B monthly requests and hundreds of millions of listings.

Deliver a world-class home search experience. Own the core home discovery experience across web and mobile — improving engagement, lead conversion, and agent workflows while keeping interactions fast and responsive at scale.

Push forward AI-powered discovery. Partner across teams to bring LLMs and intelligent ranking into search and user workflows, improving how buyers and agents discover, filter, and engage with listings.

Shape the roadmap with product and design. Define what we build and why, not just focusing on the how. Translate user needs and business goals into a clear technical plan, and own delivery end to end — planning, quality, reliability, and incident response.

Do you enjoy connecting with new people, opening doors and turning opportunities into business? Do you get excited about exploring international markets, testing new ideas and shaping how a company grows? Are you ready to take ownership beyond traditional outbound sales?

As an International Sales Development Representative at Building Radar, you will play a key role in driving our international expansion. You'll be the first point of contact for potential customers, build high-quality sales pipeline and help shape our go-to-market strategy across new markets.

This role goes beyond traditional sales development. You'll combine hands-on outbound sales with market research, strategic experimentation and the freedom to turn your own ideas into measurable results.

If you already have some experience in SDR, BDR or go-to-market roles, enjoy taking initiative and want to make a real impact on international growth, we'd love to meet you.

Drive International Outbound Sales: Identify high-potential companies across international markets, find key decision-makers and engage them through personalized outreach via phone, email and LinkedIn.

Build & Qualify Pipeline: Understand prospects' challenges, business goals and buying signals. Turn meaningful conversations into qualified opportunities and high-quality meetings for our Account Executives.

Shape Our Go-to-Market Strategy: Explore new markets, customer segments and outreach approaches. Test messaging, analyze results and help build scalable outbound playbooks that accelerate international growth.

Own Your Initiatives: Take responsibility for your own campaigns and market development activities. Spot opportunities, experiment with new approaches and drive your ideas from concept to measurable pipeline impact.

title: IT-Leitung (m/w/d) für unsere Klinikkunden
description:
Du übernimmst die IT-Leitung bei einem unserer Klinikkunden und gestaltest sie langfristig. Vom ersten Tag an, mit voller Verantwortung.

Actura übernimmt operative Führungsfunktionen in Krankenhäusern und Reha-Kliniken. Unser Anspruch: Umsetzung statt Beratung. Dafür suchen wir erfahrene IT-Führungskräfte, die bei unseren Kunden die IT-Leitung übernehmen und dauerhaft Teil der Klinik werden.

Der Einstieg erfolgt oft in einer besonderen Lage: eine unbesetzte IT-Leitung, die Neuaufstellung nach einem Cyberangriff, die Vorbereitung auf NIS2- und KRITIS-Prüfungen, ein KIS-Wechsel oder die Integration nach einem Trägerwechsel. Du schaffst Klarheit, führst das Team und baust eine IT auf, die dauerhaft trägt.

Dein Job: Führen, wo es zählt.

  • Du übernimmst als IT-Leitung die Verantwortung für IT-Betrieb, Team, Budget und Dienstleister beim Kunden

  • Du verschaffst Dir in den ersten Wochen ein klares Lagebild und entwickelst mit der Geschäftsführung eine IT-Strategie mit belastbarem Maßnahmenplan

  • Du führst und entwickelst das interne IT-Team, steuerst externe Partner und ordnest Verträge und Leistungen neu, wo es nötig ist

  • Du verantwortest Informationssicherheit und Compliance: ISMS, NIS2, KRITIS und B3S, Meldewesen, Datenschutz und Prüfungen

  • Du treibst die großen Themen: KIS-Wechsel, Rechenzentrums- und Cloudmigration, Telematikinfrastruktur, Digitalisierung und KHZG

  • Du berichtest an Geschäftsführung und Gremien und arbeitest eng mit Betriebsrat, Datenschutz und den klinischen Bereichen zusammen

  • Du baust Strukturen, Prozesse und Dokumentation so auf, dass die IT dauerhaft stabil und prüfungssicher läuft

Dein Profil: Erfahrung, Haltung, Führung.

  • Du hast mehrjährige Führungserfahrung als IT-Leiter oder in vergleichbarer Verantwortung, idealerweise im Krankenhaus oder Gesundheitswesen

  • Du bringst breites IT-Fach

title: Orbital Analyst
description:
Orbital Analyst

About us

Foundational is building the most precise picture of Earth and orbit, using lasers fired from the ground. We call it ground truth for orbit.

We design and run low-cost, autonomous satellite laser ranging stations. They measure the distance to satellites with extreme precision, day and night. Our data platform turns those measurements into tracking data and orbit products for satellite operators, space agencies and governments. We also build our own flight-proven laser retroreflector arrays, so any satellite can be tracked.

Our station network is expanding across Europe, South America, Africa and Australia. The data supports resilient navigation, Earth observation and the safe, sustainable use of space.

We're a small, fast-moving team of engineers, scientists and operators in London. We're backed by venture investors and supported by ESA, the UK Space Agency, Innovate UK and the European Innovation Council.

Position Overview

You’ll be the operationally responsive member of the Astrodynamics team. You’ll take on a wide range of tasks, from producing analysis to demonstrate Foundational’s world leading capabilities, through customer facing discussions with the business development team to supporting customers with operational issues or special requirements. Expect to also be a key point of contact for our ground station teams to help ensure smooth functioning of our tracking network.

description:
Vous cherchez un environnement professionnel stimulant basé sur l'autonomie et la confiance ?

Pennylane vous offre l'opportunité de grandir au sein d'une entreprise en pleine croissance.

Ici, votre expertise contribuera directement à aider les entrepreneurs à reprendre le contrôle de leurs finances. Découvrez un lieu où vos compétences seront valorisées et où vous pourrez façonner l'avenir de la gestion financière.

 

Notre vision

Notre ambition est de devenir le logiciel de pilotage financier préféré des PMEs européennes.

Nous aidons les entrepreneurs à se débarrasser des tâches chronophages liées à la comptabilité et à la finance, tout en leur donnant accès à des informations financières clés pour les aider à prendre les meilleures décisions pour leur entreprise.

Parallèlement, nous aidons les cabinets d'expertise-comptable, en leur permettant de passer moins de temps sur des tâches redondantes et répétitives, et plus de temps sur la partie conseil et accompagnement de leurs clients.

 

À propos de Pennylane

Pennylane est une des FinTech à la plus forte croissance en France, et souhaite bientôt adresser le marché européen.

 

En 5 ans d'existence, nous sommes parvenus à :

💻 Nous positionner sur le marché comme un éditeur de solution de comptabilité et de gestion financière innovant

💰 Lever un total de 400 millions d'euros, auprès d'investis

title: Head of Product - H/F
description:
Vos missions

Vos missions

Rattaché(e) à la Direction Technique, vous pilotez l'ensemble de la fonction Produit. Vous définissez la stratégie produit, arbitrez les investissements, managez l'équipe et garantissez l'alignement des moyens engagés avec les objectifs de l'entreprise.

En binôme avec le Product Lead, vous portez la vision, fixez le cadre stratégique et représentez le produit auprès de la Direction Générale.

Principales responsabilités

* Définir la stratégie d'un portefeuille multi-produits : investissements, priorités, évolution et cycle de vie des produits.
* Appuyer chaque décision sur des données mesurables (revenus, usage, renouvellements, churn, coûts, risques).
* Manager l'équipe Produit (Product Lead, Product Owners, Business Analysts, Product Designers, QA Engineers) : recrutement, accompagnement, évaluation et développement des compétences.
* Fédérer les équipes autour d'objectifs clairs, stables et mesurables et faire vivre une culture produit orientée qualité et performance.
* Construire et piloter le budget de la fonction Produit ainsi que l'organisation des équipes et des squads.
* Garantir le respect des budgets et plannings, anticiper les risques et contribuer à la résolution des écarts.
* Piloter la veille concurrentielle afin d'alimenter les orientations stratégiques et les roadmaps.
* Développer l'innovation et l'usage de l'IA dans les pratiques produit (discovery, spécification, design, tests, documentation), dans un cadre sécurisé et conforme.
* Représenter le produit auprès des dirigeants et arbitrer les décisions majeures inter-équipes.

Environnement : Jira, Figma, Confluence, outils de data produit et solutions d'IA.

Diplômé(e) d'une école de commerce ou d'ingénieur (Bac+5), vous justifiez d'au moins 10 ans d'expérience en direction produit ou management d'équipes produit dans un environnement B2B / é

title: Applied AI Engineer, Digital Natives
description:

OpenAI’s Applied AI Engineering team helps organizations turn frontier AI capabilities into safe, reliable, and high-impact production systems. We work with customer executives, product and engineering teams, security leaders, and transformation teams to identify valuable opportunities, accelerate technical implementation, and scale what works.

Production-ready deployments are defined by complexity rather than any one industry: existing architectures, diverse data environments, security and governance requirements, multiple stakeholder groups, and organization-wide change. We turn lessons from these deployments into better products and reusable patterns for customers everywhere.

About the Role

As an Applied AI Engineer you will partner directly with leading organizations to design, build, and deploy AI systems that deliver measurable business outcomes. You will combine deep technical judgment, hands-on engineering, and customer leadership to take ambitious ideas from use-case selection and architecture through prototyping, evaluation, production launch, and scale.

You will write and debug code, build evaluation systems, resolve complex integrations, and guide decisions involving model behavior, reliability, latency, cost, safety, security, governance, and operational readiness. Success is measured by production systems, sustained adoption, and meaningful customer impact—not simply activity or successful demonstrations.

This is a rare opportunity to work on consequential real-world deployments at the frontier of AI while directly influencing how OpenAI’s products evolve.

location: Paris, France; Marseille, France; Bordeaux, France; Biarritz, France; Brussels, Belgium
description:
Health can’t wait.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

⭐️ The Data Team

  • Being part of Alan's data team means you'll have a positive impact on people's health and wellbeing.

  • We create insights to help our colleagues focus on what is most impactful.

  • We build features and tools powered by data that directly help our members.

title: General Manager
description: Hos Sauna85 skaber vi rum til en pause fra hverdagen. Bag hver saunagus står et hold af mennesker, praktiske opgaver, der skal løses, og små detaljer, der gør oplevelsen bedre.  Vi søger en General Manager, der vil tage ansvar for den daglige drift, koordineringen af vores gusmestre og vores kundeservice. En, der kan skabe overblik, følge ting til dørs og finde løsninger med både driften og gæsten for øje.      Din Rolle   Du bliver et centralt bindeled mellem vores gusmestre, gæster og lokationer. Du får stor selvstændighed i hverdagen og arbejder tæt sammen med Clara og Jonas, som du refererer til og sparrer med.  Dine opgaver omfatter:    Kundeservice:  Besvare henvendelser og håndtere spørgsmål, bookingproblemer og refunderinger.   Drift og vedligehold:  Følge op på lokationernes stand, koordinere vedligehold og selv løse praktiske opgaver.   Administration:  Lønadministration, kontoropgaver og løbende arbejde i vores bookingsystem Ferb og øvrige tekniske systemer.   Vagtplanlægning og koordinering:  Sikre, at vagtplanerne hænger sammen, og at gusmestrene har den information, de skal bruge.   Nye lokationer:  Undersøge muligheder og drive dialog, ansøgninger og opfølgning i forbindelse med nye lokationer.   Saunagus:  Afholde 12 faste gus om måneden som en del af din arbejdstid. Vi sørger for oplæring.   Opgaver undervejs:  Hjælpe med blandt andet events og andre opgaver, der opstår i en virksomhed i udvikling.       Om dig   Du tænker strategisk, arbejder organiseret og er hands-on. Du kan skabe overblik og holde driften kørende, samtidig med at du gerne tager fat – også når glemmekassen skal tømmes, panten skal afleveres, eller personalerummet trænger til at blive ryddet op.  Du har gerne erfaring med kundeservice, bookingsystemer, vagtplanlægning og koordinering af et team. Du er praktisk anlagt og trives med at finde løsninger, når noget ikke fungerer.  Vi forestiller os, at du:   Arbejder selvstændigt og følger opgaver til dørs.  Kan prioritere, når flere ting kræver din opmærksomhed.  Kommunikerer tydeligt og venligt med både gæster og gusmestre.  Har let ved at sætte dig ind i digitale systemer.  Trives med en hverdag, der både foregår ved computeren og ude på lokationerne.  Taler og skriver dansk og engelsk.   Du behøver ikke have erfaring som gusmester. Vi tilbyder uddannelse og oplæring, så du kan blive tryg i rollen.      Hos os får du   Du får stor indflydelse på den daglige drift og mulighed for at være med til at udvikle nye sauna-lokationer. Vi tilbyder gusmesteruddannelse, et stort socialt fællesskab, gratis saunagus og en plads på vores lille, hyggelige kontor i Nordvest.  Stillingen er på 37 timer om ugen, primært på hverdage i dagtimerne, med planlagte gus. De 12 månedlige gus er inkluderet i arbejdstiden, som fordeles mellem administration, koordinering og praktiske opgaver.      Søg stillingen   Send dit CV og en kort motivation til  clara@sauna85.dk . Fortæl os kort om dig selv, din erfaring og hvorfor du har lyst til

title: Customer Experience Team Lead (m/w/d)
description: Über Vintage.com     Bei Vintage.com bauen wir die vertrauenswürdigste Plattform für Second-Hand-Artikel auf. Wir helfen Menschen dabei, wertvollen Dingen ein neues Leben zu geben, und machen das Erlebnis einfach, transparent und lohnend.       Wir verbinden Fachwissen, durchdachte Technologie und echte Sorgfalt für unsere Kundschaft. Indem wir mehr Artikel im Umlauf halten, schaffen wir Mehrwert für Menschen und leisten gleichzeitig einen positiven Beitrag.        Über das Team     Unser Customer-Experience-Team betreut Kundschaft in ganz Europa von unseren Standorten in Leeds (Großbritannien), Arnheim (Niederlande) und Korneuburg (Österreich) aus.       Wir sind die menschliche Seite von Vintage.com und begleiten unsere Kundschaft per Telefon, E-Mail und über digitale Kanäle. Das kann bedeuten, jemandem zu erklären, wie unser Service funktioniert, über den Stand der Artikel zu informieren, eine Frage zu beantworten oder die richtige Lösung zu finden, wenn etwas nicht wie geplant gelaufen ist.       Wir arbeiten eng mit Operations, unserem Lager und Teams in ganz Vintage.com zusammen, damit jede Customer Journey so einfach und reibungslos wie möglich ist.        Warum diese Rolle wichtig ist      Warum es diese Rolle gibt     Wie gut wir unsere Kundschaft betreuen, hängt von den Menschen ab, die mit ihr sprechen, und davon, wie gut diese Menschen geführt und unterstützt werden.       Als Customer Experience Team Lead in Korneuburg führst und motivierst du das Team, das Willkommensanrufe, Angebotsanrufe, Rücksendungen und Beschwerden für unsere Kundschaft in Österreich übernimmt. Du bist für die tägliche Leistung, das Wohlbefinden und die Entwicklung deines Teams verantwortlich.       Das ist eine Führungsrolle mit viel Praxisbezug. Du planst Dienstpläne und Arbeitsaufkommen, coachst dein Team, triffst Entscheidungen auf Basis von Leistungsdaten und übernimmst komplexe Kundensituationen selbst. Du setzt klare Erwartungen, erkennst gute Arbeit an und sprichst Leistungsthemen fair an.       Außerdem gehörst du zu den ersten Führungskräften unseres neuen Teams in Österreich. Du stellst neue Teammitglieder ein, arbeitest sie ein und gestaltest mit, wie das Team arbeitet, während wir wachsen.        Woran wir Erfolg messen      Du erreichst oder übertriffst die vereinbarten Service-Levels, Qualitätsstandards und Kennzahlen zur Kundenzufriedenheit.    Du löst eskalierte Anrufe beim ersten Kontakt und arbeitest auf das vereinbarte Ziel des Teams hin.    Du baust ein engagiertes Team auf, entwickelst es weiter und bindest es langfristig, gemessen an Mitarbeiterbefragungen und Fluktuation.    Du stellst neue Teammitglieder ein und arbeitest sie so ein, dass sie bis zum Ende ihrer Probezeit sicher am Telefon sind.    Du planst das Arbeitsaufkommen so, dass Anrufe und Rückmeldungen in allen Kanälen abgedeckt sind.    Du etablierst klare Abläufe und Prozesse für das Team in Österreich.        Deine Führungskraft vereinbart konkrete Ziele für diese Kennz

KPI Management and Optimization: Monitor and optimize key call center KPIs, including call connection rate, call answer rate, average handling time (AHT), first contact resolution (FCR), complaint rate, and customer satisfaction (CSAT). Use data analysis to improve service efficiency and quality.  Complaint and Compensation Management: Establish standardized processes for handling customer complaints, compensation claims, and shipment exceptions, ensuring timely resolution and proper follow-up.  Compliance Management: Ensure customer service operations comply with GDPR and applicable local regulations. Maintain appropriate customer data protection practices and business records to ensure traceability.  System Management: Oversee the daily operation of customer service ticketing systems, call center systems, and online customer service platforms, and identify opportunities for system improvements.  Complaint Analysis and Cross-functional Collaboration: Regularly analyze the root causes of customer complaints, prepare complaint analysis reports, and work with sorting centers, line-haul transportation teams, and last-mile delivery stations to implement corrective actions. title: Account Manager till Synos Medical!
description: Nu har du möjlighet att ta ditt nästa karriärkliv inom B2B-försäljning och bli en del av Synos Medical i Linköping! Här jobbar du med försäljning av världsledande premiumutrustning i en roll med stora utvecklingsmöjligheter. Välkommen med din ansökan idag!       Om tjänsten   Synos Medical är en ledande leverantör av medicinteknisk utrustning i absolut världsklass till estetiska och medicinska kliniker. Företagets filosofi bygger på ett äkta win-win-koncept: när klinikerna lyckas, lyckas Synos. Därför erbjuder de inte bara marknadens bästa lasermaskiner, utan en helhetslösning med utbildning, affärsutveckling, marknadsföring och livstids rådgivning till kunderna.     Som Account Manager blir du en del av ett tight team på 7 personer med stark gemenskap där dina åsikter och idéer värdesätts högt. Du kliver in i en mycket viktig tillväxtroll där du steg för steg bygger upp din egen kundportfölj och i praktiken driver ditt eget "bolag i bolaget". Din roll som Account Manager innebär ansvar för hela försäljningscykeln - från första kontakt till avslutad affär samt ett långsiktigt relationsbyggande. Du kommer in till en bransch med enorm potential och du kommer arbeta aktivt med att bearbeta nya och befintliga kunder över hela Sverige. För att ge dig de bästa förutsättningarna erbjuder Synos Medical en trygg onboarding och en kontinuerlig, fördjupad säljträning som löper under dina två första år.     För att passa i rollen hos Synos tror vi att du är nyfiken, har en förmåga att jobba ihärdigt och har god affärsmässighet. Du är också kommunikativ och har ett stort resultatfokus. I rollen förekommer även en del resande till kunder runtom i landet.      Arbetsuppgifter   Rollen innebär att driva hela säljprocessen från första kontakt till avslut genom hög aktivitet, relationsbyggande och demonstrationer av Synos lasermaskiner runt om i Sverige. Dina arbetsuppgifter kommer bland annat vara att:   Boka och genomföra kundmöten och aktivt arbeta för att identifiera nya affärsmöjligheter, både hos nya och befintliga kunder.  Bygga långsiktiga relationer och hjälpa kliniker med deras affärsutveckling  På sikt genomföra presentationer och produktdemonstrationer  Arbeta strukturerat med dokumentation och CRM-verktyg       Vi söker dig som    Har grundläggande erfarenhet av försäljning eller B2B-försäljning  Goda kunskaper i svenska i både tal och skrift  Innehav av B-körkort  Starkt personligt driv, ihärdighet och vilja att ständigt lära sig       Det är meriterande om du har    Erfarenhet från skönhets- eller klinikbranschen       För att lyckas i rollen har du följande personliga egenskaper:    Optimistisk  Målmedveten  Social  Ansvarstagande  Respektfull       Vår rekryteringsprocess   Denna rekryteringsprocess hanteras av Academic Work och vår kunds önskemål är att alla frågor rörande tjänsten skickas till Academic Work.     Vi tillämpar löpande urval och kommer plocka ner annonsen när tillräckligt många kandidater har nått slutskedet i rekryteringsproce

Et stærkt fagligt miljø med dygtige kolleger på tværs af salg og drift.  Attraktive ansættelsesvilkår og gode muligheder for personlig og faglig udvikling.  En central rolle i en markedsledende virksomhed med høje ambitioner. Toimit luontevasti asiakkaan, oman organisaation ja eri yksiköiden kanssa ja viet sovitut asiat käytäntöön. Tehtävä edellyttää sujuvaa suomen ja englannin kielen taitoa.Tehtävässä tarvitset kokemusta tiimien johtamisesta, henkilöstön innostamisesta ja yhteistyöstä yli organisaatiorajojen. Osaat johtaa toimintaa tavoitteellisesti sekä tukea esihenkilöitä ja henkilöstöä muuttuvissa tilanteissa. Arvostamme pitkää esihenkilökokemusta siivousalalta ja siivousalan erikoisammattitutkintoa.Tunnet siivouksen operatiivisen toiminnan, asiakkuuksien hoidon ja palvelusopimusten vaatimukset. Hallitset työssä tarvittavat järjestelmät ja hyödynnät tietoa toiminnan seurannassa, raportoinnissa, päätöksenteossa ja kehittämisessä. Varmistat palvelun laadun, sovittujen tavoitteiden toteutumisen ja arjen sujuvuuden yli yksikkörajojen. Tarvittaessa osallistut myös käytännön työhön kentällä.Kehität omaa työtäsi, palvelutuotantoa ja asiakkuutta pitkäjänteisesti yhdessä asiakkaan ja organisaation eri toimijoiden kanssa. Etsit käytännön ratkaisuja, joilla parannetaan laatua, tehokkuutta ja asiakaskokemusta. Työsi tueksi saat koko yrityksen tuen, ja työtä tehdään oikeasti yhdessä yli yksikkörajojen.   Tarjoamme Pääset osaksi motivoitunutta ja yhteistyökykyistä tiimiä, jossa arvostetaan jokaisen panosta. Yhteisömme ilmapiiri on avoin ja kannustava, mikä luo parhaat mahdolliset edellytykset onnistumiseesi.Pidämme huolta henkilöstömme osaamisen kehittämisestä sekä työhyvinvoinnista. Pyrimme siihen, että työntekijämme työskentelevät meillä tyytyväisinä ja pitkään.Panostamme työturvallisuuteen vahvasti – tarjoamme esimerkiksi työturvallisuuskorttikoulutuksia sitä tarvitseville, ja kehitämme turvallisia työskentelytapoja jatkuvasti.Tarjoamme monipuolisia henkilöstöetuja, jotka tukevat hyvinvointiasi sekä arkeasi – etuihimme kuuluu lounasedun lisäksi muun muassa matkailuun, hyvinvointiin ja autoiluun liittyviä etuja. title: Customer Success Manager
description: Are you driven, results-oriented and a team player?   With 17,000+ retailers and restaurants in over 15 countries, StoreHub is on a mission to enable everyone, big or small, to build successful businesses.     At StoreHub, we're building a dream team whereby all of your colleagues are extraordinary at what they do and are highly effective collaborators.     It is in such a team that you learn the most, perform your best work, improve the fastest, and have the most fun.      If this is a journey you’d like to embark on, keep reading!      The  Customer Success Manager (CSM)  is a commercial leader responsible for managing and growing a portfolio of live merchant accounts. This includes executing contract renewals, driving account expansion (upsells, add-ons), and building long-term customer partnerships. CSMs are trusted merchant advisors and revenue owners, ensuring that merchants achieve their goals while maximizing financial outcomes for StoreHub.     You will collaborate cross-functionally with Sales, Onboarding, Product, and Support to resolve key merchant issues, identify opportunities, and close high-impact commercial decisions. Develop and execute win/win negotiation strategies that maximize contract value while protecting and enhancing customer trust.  Partner with the Sales and Onboarding team to fully understand and develop a clear renewal strategy for each customer.  Confidently lead commercial conversations with merchant decision-makers, including pricing, feature packaging, and contractual terms.  Maximize account growth opportunities by playing a collaborative role in the account team and helping to drive incremental revenue.  Identify customer requirements, uncover roadblocks, and proactively drive on-time renewal closures.  Collaborate with internal resources such as Finance, Product, Marketing, and Business Intelligence teams to develop comprehensive win strategies.  Provide executive visibility into renewals and solicit leadership involvement where needed to close high-risk or high-value deals. Excellent verbal and written communication skills with decision-makers.  Strategic mindset, process discipline, and data-driven decision making.  Strong customer management, including ability to navigate renewal resistance and product gaps

title: Supply Chain Manager
description:
About pplwise

pplwise is a recruiting consultancy for fast-growing technology companies across Europe. Through Recruiting as a Service and Executive Search, we fill key roles for our clients, from start-ups to publicly listed companies. We are filling this position for our client Filics.

About our client: Filics

Filics is reinventing intralogistics with autonomous mobile robots (AMRs) that change how material moves. Its double-runner system makes Filics the first and only AMR that can drive through load carriers such as Euro pallets. This breaks with forklift logic and sets a new standard for efficiency. Filics is a small, hands-on team that solves hard problems with engineering excellence. Leadership goes to those who take initiative and consistently deliver. As Supply Chain Manager (m/f/d) at Filics, you will build the supply chain that takes the robots into series production.

About the role

This is an on-site/hybrid role in Munich, close to engineering and assembly.
Filics robots are built from hundreds of components. Many come from a single source, and most aren’t under contract yet. Moving from prototypes to series production, one missing part can stop the whole line. Your job is to build a robust supply chain from scratch. It needs to know exactly what Filics depends on, secure those parts before they become a risk, and hold up as volumes grow, all while production is already running. You take full ownership of how every component is sourced, secured and managed.
You’ll work closely with Engineering, which owns the technical specs and qualifies suppliers and alternative components. Assembly depends on reliable supply to plan builds. Leadership sets volume commitments
