title: Pricing & Deal Desk Manager (m/f/d)
description:
At Moss, we give finance professionals the power to automate their day-to-day and make forward-thinking decisions.

Our culture is what makes that possible: we play to win, we obsess over quality, and we win as One Moss, and it works. Moss closed a €35 million Series C in August 2026, crossing a €1 billion valuation, and became one of Europe's fintech unicorns. Join us for what's next.

We're hiring a Pricing & Deal Desk Manager within the Revenue Operations team. You'd take ownership of one of Moss's highest-leverage commercial functions: the pricing deal desk. It's already delivered real results, and it matters more every quarter as deal volume grows and Moss moves into bigger, more complex deals.

What makes the role unusual is that the desk already runs on AI. An agent picks up each request, pulls the deal's scoring and call history, calculates margin, and drafts a reasoned reply; you approve, correct, or overrule it. So the job is two things at once: the reviewer who decides live deals, and the person who builds & improves the AI-based deal desk agent

Your responsibilities

  • Own the day-to-day approval flow for non-standard pricing, discounts, and commercial terms, acting as the fast, consistent escalation point for reps without slowing deals down.

  • Build and evolve pricing governance, including discount rules, approval thresholds, and playbooks, converting recurring exceptions into documented policy.

  • Drive deal health across the funnel: discount discipline, price realization, deal structure, and win rate by segment, diagnosing where deals leak value and fixing it.

High blood pressure is the world's most common disease, causing 18M deaths each year. At Hilo by Aktiia, we're building a world where no lives are lost to its effects — with technology that helps people take control of their health. 

We're a venture-backed scale-up with $96M raised from investors in Europe and the US. You connect that work to measurable business outcomes, improving conversion and return on investment while making sure every health claim is accurate and approved.

Reporting to the Head of Performance Marketing, you will play a key role in our performance marketing team, working with internal teams and external partners to drive growth.

  • Months 1–12 — the internship: CHF 2,500/month, full-time, paid, and inside that year up to 10% of the profit of the project/company you work on.

Für ein SAP-S/4HANA-Transformations- und Rollout-Projekt bei einem Unternehmen aus dem technischen Handel mit eigenen Fertigungsprozessen suchen wir einen erfahrenen SAP PP Consultant (m/w/d) auf freiberuflicher Basis.

Im Mittelpunkt steht die Harmonisierung und Weiterentwicklung der Fertigungsprozesse innerhalb einer einheitlichen SAP-S/4HANA-Systemlandschaft. Ein wesentlicher Bestandteil ist die Einführung von SAP PP im Rahmen eines Schweizer Rollouts, bei dem ein bestehendes ERP-System abgelöst wird.

Gesucht wird ein praxisorientierter SAP-PP-Berater, der Fertigungsprozesse versteht, Anforderungen strukturiert aufnimmt und diese möglichst standardnah in SAP S/4HANA umsetzt.

Projektrahmen

  • Start: 11/2026

  • Laufzeit: 09/2027

  • Auslastung: Vollzeit

  • Einsatzort: Remote

  • Projektregion: DACH, bevorzugt Deutschland

  • Sprachen: Sehr gutes Deutsch, gutes Englisch

Aufgaben

  • Analyse bestehender Fertigungsprozesse und Aufnahme fachlicher Anforderungen gemeinsam mit den Key Usern

  • Konzeption und Customizing von SAP-PP-Prozessen in SAP S/4HANA

  • Unterstützung beim Schweizer SAP-Rollout und bei der Ablösung eines bestehenden ERP-Systems

  • Durchführung von Fit-Gap-Analysen und Abstimmung von Anforderungen mit dem bestehenden SAP-Template

  • Abbildung und Optimierung von Stücklisten, Arbeitsplänen, Arbeitsplätzen, Fertigungsaufträgen und Rückmeldungen

  • Unterstützung bei der Integration von SAP PP mit angrenzenden Modulen wie MM, SD und CO

  • Fachliche Begleitung der Datenmigration sowie Abstimmung notwendiger Anpassungen mit dem Entwicklungsteam

  • Unterstützung bei Tests, Anwenderabnahmen, Go-live und anschließender Stabilisierung

Anforderungen

  • Mehrjährige praktische Erfahrung als SAP PP Consultant, idealerweise mit SAP S/4HANA

Ninox ist eine Berliner Low-Code-Plattform, mit der Teams genau die Geschäftsanwendungen bauen, die sie brauchen. Rund 80 Mitarbeitende, tausende Kundinnen und Kunden in ganz Europa, vom kleinen Team bis zum Großunternehmen. Ein Produkt, an dem Menschen wirklich hängen. Wir sind seit 12 Jahren am Markt, etabliert, wachsen und sind solide mit Wagniskapital finanziert.

Worum es geht

Du machst Outbound. Zu 100 %, und vor allem am Telefon.

Du arbeitest auf Deutsch und auf Englisch, jeden Tag. Deutschland und Großbritannien sind unsere Kernmärkte, weitere europäische Länder kommen situativ dazu.

Dazu kommt eine Kollegin bzw. ein Kollege mit ebenfalls reinem Outbound-Fokus, allerdings auf Kooperationen, Webinare und Partner. Du bist damit die erste Person bei uns, die ausschließlich und direkt auf Neukunden-Erstgespräche geht. title: Deployment Lead - ERP Solutions
description:
What We Do

Rillet serves accounting and finance teams, the financial brains of their companies. Our job is to help them run the numbers with impossible speed, accuracy, and insight.

Rillet is the Agentic ERP built for modern finance teams. We help companies automate the most critical parts of finance, from closing the books and recognizing revenue to consolidating entities and reporting to investors. More than 600 companies run on Rillet, including Mercor, Scribe, and Function Health, and we partner with leading accounting firms including EY and KPMG.

We’re building in one of the largest software markets in the world, with the momentum to match. Rillet has raised more than $200M, is valued at $1B, and is backed by Sequoia, a16z, ICONIQ, Bain Capital Ventures, Oak HC/FT, and other leading investors. We’re using that backing to build the financial infrastructure for the next generation of companies and help every business run its numbers at the speed of AI.

Who We Are

Rillet’s pace is not for everyone. Intelligence is table stakes. To succeed here, you need extreme speed, agency, and flexibility.

The people who thrive at Rillet do not wait for assignments. They internalize the mission, design a strategy, and bring back results that are better, faster, and more creative than a manager could have asked for.

Our work revolves around our customers. The people who succeed here are energized by delivering what matters most, even when it was not part of the original plan.

Rillet is built on deep accounting expertise, and it takes people from many disciplines to build a category-defining company. You do not need to be an accountant to thrive here. You do need to care deeply about the problems we solve

title: Research Engineer, Latency & Throughput
description:
About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

The Role

As a Research Engineer on the Latency & Throughput team, you will push the frontier of LLM inference by researching and prototyping techniques that reduce latency and increase throughput — from speculative decoding and quantization to KV compression and new attention variants. The team sits at the intersection of research and production: you will take ideas from recent literature, form hypotheses, run experiments, and ship the techniques that prove out into our serving stack.

This role sits between our inference engineers, who own the production serving stack, and our research scientists, who focus on paper-level contributions. You will be more science-focused than a pure engineer: you are expected to generate new ideas, keep up with the state of the art, and implement proof-of-concepts that bridge the gap between academic results and production impact. Some techniques you explore will be lossy or require integration into training — retraining models, tuning architectures, or training auxiliary models to improve inference.

You will work closely with the Inferenc

Firstwork exists so that every frontline worker gets the same personal, 24/7 support in starting and staying in a job that a senior professional gets from a dedicated recruiter, made affordable by AI.

Our software does the work that sits today with recruiters, compliance teams and outsourced back offices, from a worker's first application into the job itself. The role

Help UK and European recruitment agencies get workers into shifts faster and keep them working as rules change, with AI that does the work their back-office and compliance teams carry today. You'll join our UK sales team early and help build Firstwork's European business from the ground floor.

You'll sell to Managing Directors, CEOs, Operations Directors and Heads of Compliance, Onboarding or Vetting at UK agencies across industrial, driving and logistics, healthcare and care, and hospitality, then into major European markets. They care about time from offer to first shift, right-to-work and vetting compliance (Home Office checks, DBS for care), the cost of compliance teams, and audits and fines.

Neko is redefining what prevention means, from treating illness when it arrives, to sustaining health before it's ever at risk. Our mission: make data-driven, preventative care accessible to more people, before symptoms appear.

You will own Neko’s day-to-day health and safety management so that our members and staff are in a safe environment, select and implement the systems to run it at scale, and put in place the training, audits and people needed to sustain high standards as we grow.

title: Strategic Customer Success Manager - French Speaker
description:

You’ll work across executive relationships, technical delivery and commercial expansion, partnering closely with Sales, Product, Engineering and Support to bring clarity and momentum to complex environments.

title: Principal Software Engineer
description:
Life at UiPath

The people at UiPath believe in the transformative power of automation to change how the world works. We’re committed to creating category-leading enterprise software that unleashes that power.

To make that happen, we need people who are curious, self-propelled, generous, and genuine. People who love being part of a fast-moving, fast-thinking growth company. And people who care—about each other, about UiPath, and about our larger purpose.

Could that be you?

Your mission

UiPath’s Intelligence Document Processing drives understanding of the documents and messages on which a business runs: invoices, claims, contracts, customer emails. We use frontier LLMs to turn all of that into structured data that automations and AI agents can act on. You'll be building the product that does it: the ingestion and extraction pipelines, the APIs customers build their operations on top of, and the systems that make those models useful, fast and trustworthy at enterprise scale.

Increasingly that work is agentic. What you build is what lets AI agents ingest, understand, retrieve and reason over enterprise documents at volume, without giving up accuracy, security or governance.

It's a product engineering role with complex systems and LLM-in-production problems underneath it. The same service handles a customer's first ten documents and another's ten million, runs in our cloud and inside a bank's own air-gapped datacentre, and has to be good enough that a business will act on its output. Knowing how well the models are actually doing, and what to do when the answer is "not well enough", is a large part of the job.

You'll write in several languages here, and pick up new ones as the pro

title: People Operations Manager
description: About Us   Glitch Productions is an independent animation studio based in Australia making original, long form animated shows distributed on YouTube. Our channel has over 23 million subscribers, tens of millions of views per episode and is still growing strong. Our studio is filled with incredibly talented and passionate artists that are determined to change the way animation is produced and treated in the industry. Our biggest IP; The Amazing Digital Circus, has amassed over 350 million views on the pilot alone and we have a lot more still to come. We are growing quickly, with team members across Australia, the US, Canada and beyond.   Role Information   Glitch Productions is looking for a People Operations Manager to build the systems, data, and automation that let our People team scale with the company. This role suits someone who is highly detail oriented, comfortable owning HR technology end to end, and energised by turning manual processes into clean, reliable workflows.  Your first big priority will be leading our implementation of Deel as our global HRIS: configuring it, migrating our employee data, connecting it with payroll, Ashby and Airtable, and getting every employee and manager confidently using it.  You will report to the Global Head of People and Culture and act as the operational backbone of the People function, from HRIS ownership to employee lifecycle processes to workforce data and reporting. You will work closely with our People Partners. They focus on managers, employee relations and team needs; you make sure the systems, processes and data behind them work.  What success looks like in your first 6 months    Deel is live and adopted as our single source of truth for employee data, with clean, accurate records  Onboarding and offboarding run as consistent, largely automated workflows in every country we employ in  Team members move smoothly onto our own employing entities as we establish them in new countries  Leadership relies on regular, accurate people reporting (headcount, turnover, hiring progress) to make decisions  Our core People processes are documented so they do not rely on any one person     Your Duties Will Include    Employee Lifecycle and Experience     Own the end to end employee lifecycle processes (onboarding, transfers, promotions, off-boarding) so every employee has a consistent experience wherever they are based   Act as a first point of contact for employee queries related to systems, policies, and processes, and know when to bring in the relevant People Partner  Continuously improve the employee experience by identifying friction points and fixing them     Data & Systems     Own the implementation, configuration, and ongoing administration of Deel as our HRIS, including its LMS and headcount planning modules  Build and maintain automated workflows across HR systems and Airtable to reduce manual admin and improve data accuracy, and find recurring manual tasks to automate  Maintain workforce data

title: Senior implementation manager
description: Senior launch manager   Hybrid role based in our Dublin office, with occasional travel to our UK offices as needed   About Us   Seccl is the Octopus-owned embedded investment platform, on a mission to help more people invest, and invest well.  We’re building the infrastructure behind the next generation of investing. Our technology already powers some of the UK’s most ambitious fintechs, banks, financial advisers and wealth firms, with close to a million investors relying on Seccl-powered platforms. And we’re now expanding into Europe.  We’ve got a proven product, strong momentum and big ambitions for what comes next: helping more household-name brands launch and scale investment propositions, entering new markets and replacing outdated investment infrastructure with technology that’s faster, simpler and built for scale.  We’re proud to be part of Octopus, one of the UK’s most successful privately held investment and technology groups. That gives us the backing and long-term perspective to build something substantial, while keeping the pace and energy of a high-growth business. Seccl and Octopus are both B Corp certified and share a belief that profit and purpose should go hand in hand.  We’re now expanding into Europe, starting in Ireland. As we build Seccl Ireland, we’re looking for a senior launch manager to play a key role in turning new customer opportunities into successful launches.  Check out the Seccl website to see what we’re building and read more about our mission to shape the future of investments.  The role  As senior launch manager, you’ll own the journey from the early stages of a customer conversation through to onboarding, implementation and migration.  You’ll work with fintechs, advice firms, adviser aggregators and larger enterprise businesses, getting under the skin of what they’re trying to build and helping them work out how Seccl can make it happen.  This is a hands-on, customer-facing role. You’ll lead workshops, get into the detail of technical integrations, help firms navigate our APIs and operational processes, and keep complex launches moving at pace.  You’ll also have plenty of opportunity to shape how we do things. As we build our presence in Ireland, you’ll help identify product and technical gaps, improve our onboarding approach and make each launch better than the last.  You’ll be part of our launch team, reporting to our head of strategic delivery.  What you’ll own    Lead deep-dive workshops with prospective and onboarding firms to understand their business, pain points and what they’re trying to build  Turn those conversations into clear proposition designs, project summaries and launch plans with agreed milestones, responsibilities and timelines  Own onboarding and migration projects from kick-off through to successful launch, balancing multiple customer firms at the same time  Support technical integrations with Seccl’s API across both standard and more complex customer and user journeys  Run training and

Dan wacht er een mooie kans bij onze relatie Euro-Sportring. Zij staan aan de vooravond van impactvolle IT investeringen en willen dit gepaard laten gaan met het versterken van het eigen team. Daarom zijn we op zoek naar een IT management-professional die zich makkelijk beweegt in een klein bedrijf (in opzet een reisbureau / touroperator), waarbij je externe teams / leveranciers aanstuurt en innovatie nastreeft vanuit een ondernemende drijfveer. Euro-Sportring werkt nu twintig jaar met een op maat ontwikkelde CRM/ERP applicatie wat momenteel onvoldoende ondersteunend is in business. Daarom is de tijd nu rijp om een professional toe te voegen aan het interne team die in staat is om voorspelbaar, kritisch en slagvaardig de functionaliteiten toe te voegen en de CRM/ERP Applicatie toekomstbestendig te maken in samenwerking met de externe partner. Euro-Sportring richt zich tot voetbal- en handbalverenigingen en bijna 135.000 amateur-sporters beleven in teamverband sportieve en sociale hoogtepunten tijdens de toernooien van Euro-Sportring die ‘full serviced’ en meerdaags zijn. title: Grafikdesigner / Mediengestalter (m/w/d) – Print & Digital - Ab sofort · Unbefristet · Vollzeit
description:
Über den Kopp Verlag

Der Kopp Verlag ist ein unabhängiges Medien- und E-Commerce-Unternehmen mit über 30 Jahren Erfahrung am Markt und einem eigenständigen publizistischen Ansatz. Unser Sortiment reicht von Büchern und Zeitschriften über Nahrungsergänzungsmittel, Lebensmittel und Drogerie bis hin zu Outdoor & Survival sowie Haus & Garten.

Von unserem monatlichen Produktkatalog über Anzeigen und Beilagen bis hin zu Newslettern und digitalen Werbemitteln: Unsere Grafik sorgt dafür, dass unsere Produkte und Angebote visuell überzeugend präsentiert werden – gedruckt und digital.

Dich erwartet ein ambitioniertes Umfeld mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen, viel Eigenverantwortung und echtem Gestaltungsspielraum. Wenn du Ideen hast, kannst du sie bei uns nicht nur präsentieren, sondern auch umsetzen.

Deine Aufgaben

Du hast ein gutes Gespür für Gestaltung, arbeitest präzise und nutzt moderne KI-Tools selbstverständlich als Teil deines kreativen Workflows? Du willst nicht nur einzelne Motive gestalten, sondern unterschiedlichste Werbemittel von der Idee bis zur fertigen Datei begleiten? Dann bist du bei uns richtig.

Dein Job

· Du gestaltest und realisierst unseren monatlich erscheinenden Produktkatalog

· Du übernimmst Reinzeichnung und Druckvorlagenherstellung und sorgst für technisch saubere Produktionsdaten

· Du bearbeitest, retuschierst und montierst Bilder für Print- und Digitalmedien

· Du konzipierst und gestaltest Newsletter und Werbebanner

· Du gestaltest Print-Werbemittel wie Anzeigen, Selfmailer, Broschüren und Beilagen

· Du entwickelst bestehende Gestaltungskonzepte weiter und sorgst für einen konsistenten visuellen Auftritt

· Du bereitest unterschiedliche Medienformate für die jeweiligen Kanäle und technischen Anforderungen auf

· Du setzt verschiedene KI

title: Financial- & Projektcontroller (m/w/d)
description:
Über unseren Kunden

Unser Kunde steht für Innovation, Dynamik und technologischen Fortschritt. Am Standort im Norden von Frankfurt entwickelt und vertreibt das Unternehmen zukunftsweisende Roboterlösungen, die Branchen weltweit revolutionieren.

Ihre Aufgaben

Sie sind seit einigen Jahren im Business- und Projektcontrolling tätig und möchten Ihre Expertise nun bei einem innovativen Marktführer im Bereich Robotik einbringen? Dann lassen Sie uns ins Gespräch kommen! In Ihrer neuen Rolle sind Sie nicht nur Zahlenverwalter, sondern strategischer Mitgestalter. Als Sparringspartner treiben Sie die wirtschaftliche Performance voran und sind maßgeblich an der Weiterentwicklung des Geschäftsbereiches beteiligt.

Das bringen Sie mit

  • Abgeschlossenes Studium in Rechnungswesen, Finanzen, BWL oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung

  • Mindestens fünf Jahre Erfahrung im Projekt- und Unternehmenscontrolling sowie fundierte Kenntnisse im Risikomanagement

  • Fundiertes Know-how im Projektgeschäft und nachweisbare Erfolge in der Steuerung komplexer Kostenstrukturen, der Produktivitätssteigerung und der Kapitalausstattung

  • Hohe Eigeninitiative und Verantwortungsbewusstsein sowie eine selbstständige, ergebnisorientierte und strukturierte Arbeitsweise

  • Analytische und klare Kommunikation, auch in dynamischen Situationen, sowie verhandlungssichere Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse

Ihre Perspektive

Wenn Sie einen Großteil der Anforderungen erfüllen und Freude an einer eigenverantwortlichen Schnittstellenposition haben, freuen wir uns auf Ihre Bewerbung über die Plattform. Sie steigen in einem unbefristeten Arbeitsverhältnis mit 40 Wochenstunden und 30 Tagen Urlaub pro Jahr ein.

Wir freuen uns auf Ihre Bewerbung! Bei Fragen steht Ihnen Herr Marcus Heinrich, unter der Rufnummer 0179 / 12 92 419 gerne zur Verfügung.

title: Senior Product Marketing & Exhibitions Specialist
description:
Sécheron Hasler Group is a global leader in railway and industrial electrification systems, offering cutting-edge solutions to enhance transportation and decarbonize industrial processes. With a rich heritage of over a century and a commitment to innovation, Sécheron Hasler Group is growing worldwide.

For the Electrical Safety Solutions (ESS) Business Unit, we are looking for an experienced marketing professional with a strong interest in technical products and industrial markets. The Senior Product Marketing & Exhibitions Specialist will translate ESS business priorities and product value propositions into clear marketing communications, sales tools, product training and customer-facing materials. The candidate will work closely with the Business Development Manager, Product Line Managers, Sales and the Sécheron Hasler Group Marketing Team.

Global objectives:

  • Drive the execution of the ESS marketing plan and business growth priorities, in cooperation with the Business Development Manager, Product Line Managers and Sales.
  • Develop and maintain marketing and sales materials for existing and new products and applications.
  • Develop product marketing communication using various communication channels to promote ESS and its respective products.
  • Work with the Sécheron Hasler Group Marketing Team for trade shows/fairs and manage the required preparation and coordination with the respective Business Unit teams.
  • Provide marketing inputs and product communication materials to support Product Line Managers and Sales.

Key responsibilities:

  • Develop and deliver marketing communication plans based on ESS business priorities agreed with the Business Development Manager.
  • Contribute to product launch plans defined with the Business Development Manager and Product Line Managers; coordinate the preparation and delivery of marketing materials, training and communication activiti

title: Technical Consultant (m/w/d)
description:
Verwandle Visionen zügig in funktionierende Softwarelösungen und revolutioniere die Abbildung von individuellen Geschäftsprozessen – effizient und ohne Programmierung.

Unsere innovative No-Code-Plattform bietet speziell auf unsere Branchen abgestimmte, vorgefertigte Komponenten und integrierte Lösungen. Du kannst zwischen den Schwerpunkten Bau, Logistik, Finanzen und Human Resources wählen.

Hast du Spaß an der Analyse komplexer Prozesse und eine Affinität zu IT-Systemen? Dann bist du als Technical Consultant (m/w/d) bei uns genau richtig.

Aufgaben

  • Entwicklung auf einer No-Code-Plattform: Entwickle Anwendungen auf unserer No-Code-Plattform und begleite Ideen von der Konzeption bis zur Implementierung.
  • Analyse der Kundenanforderungen & direkter Austausch: Ergänze Kundenanforderungen durch gezielte Analyse und finde die besten technischen Lösungen. Pflege direkten Austausch mit Kunden und internen Stakeholdern, um Anforderungen zu klären und Implementierungen zu planen.
  • Erarbeitung & Erweiterung von Lösungen: Forsche, plane und konfiguriere Lösungen, die unsere Kunden begeistern und erweitere und verbessere bestehende Lösungen. Mit Dir sind unsere Lösungen fehlerfrei und einsatzbereit.
  • Entwicklung von Prototypen: Entwickle Prototypen, um Ideen und Konzepte schnell und effektiv zu visualisieren und zu testen.

Qualifikation

  • Ausbildung / Studium: Du hast eine Ausbildung als Fachinformatiker (z.B. für Anwendungsentwicklung), bist Wirtschaftsinformatiker oder verfügst über einen vergleichbaren Abschluss im IT-Bereich.
  • SQL-Kenntnisse: Du nutzt Deine SQL-Kenntnisse, um Daten effizient zu verarbeiten.
  • Analytische und technische Fähigkeiten: Du „tüftelst“ gern, bist versiert im Umgang mit komplexen Problemen und der Ableitung technischer Konzepte.

title: Senior IT Consultant / Senior Business Analyst (m/w/d)
description:
Wir sind ein ambitioniertes Team von 100 Consultants und Engineers in Deutschland, Portugal und Großbritannien. Unser Antrieb: Die Prozesse und IT-Systeme unserer Kunden nicht nur zu verbessern, sondern auf ein neues Level zu heben. Wir zeigen Unternehmen, was in ihnen steckt, und setzen dieses Potenzial in die Tat um. Was uns jeden Tag motiviert? Zu sehen, wie unsere Arbeit das Leben tausender Menschen erleichtert.

Unsere Vision ist klar: "NO more boring tasks!"

Aufgaben

  • Eigenständige Umsetzung von Kundenprojekten
  • Treibe die Digitalisierung voran, optimiere und gestalte Unternehmensprozesse & -strategien
  • Leite Workshops, Trainings & Pitches für unsere Kunden
  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit unserem Entwicklungsteam und Steuerung des Entwicklungsprozesses
  • Verantworte mehrere spannende Projekte gleichzeitig
  • Wachse über dich hinaus und entwickle dich zum Teamleiter oder Experte
  • Übernimm das Mentoring für Junior Consultants

Qualifikation

  • Bachelor- oder Masterabschluss in Wirtschaftsinformatik, Informatik, Betriebswirtschaft oder einem vergleichbaren Fachbereich
  • 4+ Jahre Erfahrung in einer ERP-Beratung; gerne auch Industry-Quereinsteiger
  • Sehr schnelle Auffassungsgabe, analytisches Denken und hohe Eigenmotivation
  • Teamgeist mit einer Leidenschaft für herausfordernde Aufgaben und komplexe Problemlösung
  • Eine Can-Do-Einstellung gepaart mit dem Blick fürs große Ganze
  • Verhandlungssichere Sprachkenntnisse (mind. C1) in Deutsch & Englisch

Benefits

  • Spannende & herausfordernde Aufgaben: Du bist zu klug für einfache PowerPoint-Arbeiten – bei uns übernimmst du Verantwortung ab Tag 1
  • Steile Lernkurve: Unser strukturiertes Onboarding ermöglicht dir einen schnellen, selbstständigen Einstieg in spannende Projekte
  • Attraktive Vergütung<

title: Senior Backend-Entwickler – Agents (100% Remote in Deutschland)
description:
Wir suchen Senior Developer, die in unserem vollständig remoten Team an unseren Agenten arbeiten. Wenn du Komplexität magst und willst, dass deine Arbeit wirklich etwas bewegt, passt du zu uns.

Über uns
Hausverwalter.ai ist eine All-in-One-Plattform für Hausverwaltungen, mit Funktionen wie Inbox, CRM, Dokumenten, Telefonie, Video Calls, Team Chat und KI-Agenten. Unsere Mission ist es, alles zu automatisieren, was ein Hausverwalter tut.

Über die Rolle
Unsere Plattform ist von Tag eins an agentisch gedacht. Bevor wir überhaupt die UI geplant haben, haben wir geplant, wie Agenten mit der Software arbeiten. Denk dran – unser Ziel ist, die ganze Branche zu automatisieren, und das meinen wir ernst.
Heute gibt es für fast alles, was der Nutzer in der UI machen kann, ein Agenten-Tool, und der Co-Pilot (der tägliche Assistent des Nutzers) kann alles für ihn übernehmen, sogar den Dark Mode an- und ausschalten.
Aber der Co-Pilot ist erst der Anfang. Die eigentliche Herausforderung sind die autonomen Agenten. Dazu unten mehr.

Woran du arbeiten wirst

  • Inbox-Agents: Autonome Agenten, die anspringen, sobald in einem Ticket etwas Neues passiert. Kunden trainieren sie selbst ODER nehmen einfach eine der Vorlagen, die du für sie baust. Diese Agenten können heute schon komplette komplexe Abläufe allein übernehmen und sind einer der Hauptgründe, warum sich Kunden für unsere Software interessieren. Aber wann sollte ein Agent an einen Menschen abgeben, statt selbst zu Ende zu machen? Wie stellen wir sicher, dass er sich an den Prozess hält? Das sind deine Fragen.

Dans son prolongement, Sézane prend vie en 2013 : la première marque de mode française née en ligne. Puis sont venus enrichir cet univers : Octobre Éditions pour les hommes, Les Composantes, dédiée cette fois à l’art de vivre, et Petit Sézane pour les enfants.

Tout s’est construit comme on avance dans la vie : par élans, par gestes spontanés avec cette manière d’apprendre en faisant. Une autre relation au détail, au service et au lien. Une autre manière d’habiller le réel, d’abord en ligne, puis à travers nos Appartements.

Nous recherchons aujourd’hui des talents créatifs, structurés et agiles qui partagent l’envie d’améliorer sans cesse tout ce qui peut l’être. Des talents passionnés, autonomes qui conçoivent le travail dans le respect des autres et pour qui rien n'est hors d'atteinte, pour peu qu'on s'en donne les moyens.

Nous recherchons les talents d’un(e) Assistant(e) Campaign Manager pour rejoindre notre équipe CRM à l’occasion d’un stage d’une durée de 6 mois à partir de Janvier 2027. Ce poste est basé à Paris (75).

Rattaché(e) à l’équipe CRM, vos principales responsabilités seront :

  • La création et la gestion de nos campagnes CRM omnicanales (Newsletters, SMS, Push notifications, communications in-app et WhatsApp) ;
  • L’analyse, le monitoring et l’optimisation des KPIs CRM au global ;
  • Le benchmark et la veille concurrentielle des meilleures pratiques du marché ;
  • L’excellence opérationnelle, notamment dans la coordination intra et inter-équipes.

Détail des missions: 

1. Gestion du Run & des campagnes automatisées

title: Data Analist
description:
Zie jij snel welke data nodig is om een businessvraag te beantwoorden? Als Data Analist binnen het Data & AI Office analyseer je data, vertaal je vraagstukken uit de business naar concrete inzichten en help je collega’s om die inzichten te gebruiken voor betere beslissingen. Ook onderzoek je waar AI waarde kan toevoegen en werk je mee aan praktische toepassingen die de manier van werken verbeteren. 

Je bent de schakel tussen de business en de specialisten binnen Data & AI. Daarmee zorg je ervoor dat goede ideeën niet blijven hangen in analyses of experimenten, maar leiden tot oplossingen die medewerkers daadwerkelijk gebruiken en die waarde opleveren voor onze leden.

Wie ben jij

Jij bent analytisch sterk en oprecht nieuwsgierig naar wat er binnen de business speelt. Je neemt geen genoegen met de eerste vraag, maar onderzoekt welk probleem er werkelijk moet worden opgelost en welke informatie nodig is om een goede beslissing te nemen.

Je kunt schakelen tussen verschillende werelden. Je begrijpt de taal van de business, werkt zelf ook graag met data en kan goed samenwerken met technische dataspecialisten. Je hoeft niet zelf ieder model of datapipeline te bouwen, maar je begrijpt voldoende van data en AI om mogelijkheden te herkennen, inhoudelijke vragen te stellen en resultaten kritisch te beoordelen.

Je communiceert helder en overtuigend. Je kunt complexe analyses eenvoudig uitleggen en helpt collega’s om inzichten en AI-oplossingen op een goede manier toe te passen. Daarbij ben je organisatiesensitief, verbindend en resultaatgericht. Je neemt eigenaarschap en blijft betrokken totdat een oplossing daadwerkelijk wordt gebruikt en waarde toevoegt.

title: Data Engineer
description:
Wil jij bouwen aan betrouwbare dataproducten die door heel Univé worden gebruikt? Binnen het Data & AI Office werk je met Snowflake, dbt, Azure, Git en CI/CD. Je maakt van beschikbare brondata goed gemodelleerde, geteste en beheersbare dataproducten voor analyses, rapportages, self-service en AI-toepassingen.

We zoeken een Data Engineer die data engineering combineert met software-engineering. Iemand die verantwoordelijkheid neemt voor wat hij of zij bouwt, nieuwe technologie praktisch inzet en samen met collega’s het dataplatform en onze werkwijze verder ontwikkelt.

Wie ben jij

Jij bent een Data Engineer die technische kwaliteit belangrijk vindt en verantwoordelijkheid neemt voor wat je bouwt. Je zoekt actief naar manieren om ontwikkeling slimmer, beter en beter beheersbaar te maken en gebruikt nieuwe technologie wanneer die aantoonbaar waarde toevoegt.

Je schrijft begrijpelijke en onderhoudbare code en automatiseert waar dat helpt. Voor jou is een dataproduct pas klaar wanneer het betrouwbaar, getest, gedocumenteerd en beheersbaar in productie staat.

Je werkt graag samen en kunt technische keuzes helder uitleggen. Je deelt kennis, staat open voor feedback en begrijpt dat een goede technische oplossing ook bruikbaar en begrijpelijk moet zijn voor de organisatie.

Wat neem je mee?

  • hbo- of wo-werk- en denkniveau, bij voorkeur met een opleiding in Informatica, Data Engineering, Software Engineering of een vergelijkbare richting;

  • meerdere jaren relevante ervaring als Data Engineer, Analytics Engineer, BI Developer of in een vergelijkbare technische datafunctie;

  • sterke kennis van SQL en datamodellering;

  • ervaring met Snowflake en dbt of vergelijkbare cloud- en transformatietechnologie;

  • ervaring met Microsoft Azure

title: Environmental Compliance Manager (m/w/d) – PFAS & Kreislaufwirtschaft
description:
PFASuiki setzt den globalen Standard für die sichere und nachhaltige Zerstörung von PFAS. Mit elektrochemischer Oxidation (ECO) verwandeln wir belastete Wasserströme in ungefährliches Abwasser und helfen, eine der großen Umweltherausforderungen unserer Zeit zu lösen.

Wir suchen eine Entsorgungsfachkraft (m/w/d), die PFASuiki zum zertifizierten Entsorgungsfachbetrieb nach § 56 KrWG macht und diesen Status dauerhaft sichert. Als verantwortliche Person nach EfbV leitest und beaufsichtigst Du unsere Entsorgungstätigkeiten, erledigst alle Formalitäten mit Prüfstelle und Behörden und berätst unser Team in allen Abfall- und Entsorgungsfragen.

Aufgaben

  • Zertifizierung als Entsorgungsfachbetrieb verantworten: Umfang festlegen (Tätigkeiten, Standorte, Abfallarten), Prüfstelle auswählen, Überwachungsvertrag abschließen, Erst- und Jahresprüfungen begleiten

  • Betriebsorganisation nach EfbV aufbauen und pflegen: Organisationsplan, Arbeitsanweisungen, Betriebstagebuch, Versicherungs-, Zuverlässigkeits- und Fachkundenachweise

  • Alle behördlichen Formalitäten erledigen: Anzeigen und Erlaubnisse nach KrWG, Anträge, Fragenkataloge und Fristen

  • Geschäftsführung, Operations, Technik und Vertrieb in Abfall- und Entsorgungsfragen beraten, von der AVV-Einstufung bis zur Wahl der Entsorgungsroute

  • Abfallströme aus unseren mobilen Einsätzen, Labor und Technikum einstufen, Analytik veranlassen und Entsorgungspartner qualifizieren

  • Entsorgungsnachweise, Begleitscheine, eANV und Register führen und Kunden belastbare Nachweise über den Verbleib liefern

  • Genehmigungsbedarf neuer Geschäftsmodelle bewerten

  • Mitarbeitende unterweisen, interne Audits durchführen und Änderungen im Abfall- und PFAS-Recht verfolgen

Anforderungen

  • Abgeschlossenes Studium, Fachschul- oder Berufsausbildung oder Meister in Chemie, Verfahrens-, Umwelt- oder Entsorgungst

About Upstart

At Upstart, we’re united by a mission that matters: to radically reduce the cost and complexity of borrowing for all Americans. Every day, we bring creativity, experimentation, and advanced AI to reshape access to credit, helping millions move forward financially with clarity and confidence.

As the leading AI lending marketplace, we partner with banks and credit unions to expand access to affordable credit through technology that’s both radically intelligent and deeply human. title: Billing Subject Matter Expert- Support
description:
Elation Health is deeply committed to helping independent primary care practices take better care of their patients. Since 2010, we've built a clinical-first, collaborative EHR platform — and with the addition of Elation Billing, we're bringing that same clinical-first philosophy to the revenue side of the practice, so billing works with the chart instead of around it.

Elation Health is searching for a Support Subject Matter Expert in Elation Billing — someone who has already done real medical billing and revenue cycle management work, not someone learning it on the job. This is a hands-on, case-based role embedded directly in our support queue: you'll bring practitioner-level RCM judgment to the billing cases our Technical Support Specialists can't fully resolve through process or AI-assisted troubleshooting alone, and you'll help the rest of the team get sharper at spotting those cases in the first place.

This isn't a back-office consulting role. You'll be working live cases day to day alongside our support team, diagnosing whether an issue is a product bug, a payer-specific quirk, or a mismatch between how a practice actually operates and how they've configured their billing workflow — then resolving it with the kind of judgment that only comes from having sat inside a claims lifecycle before.

  • Serve as the Elation Billing product line's embedded RCM expert, owning complex billing and revenue cycle cases that require practitioner-level judgment — claims lifecycle issues, CPT/ICD-10 coding logic, payer adjudication and denial patterns, A/R and collections workflows.
  • Act as the go-to resource for case swarms and escalations within Elation Billing whenever a Technical Support Specialist's investigation surfaces a billing nuance beyond scripted troubleshooting.
  • Diagnose a practice's underlying billing context — payment model (insurance-taking vs. DPC), staffing structure, and prior workflow choices — to distinguish genuine product issues from configuration or workflow mismatches, rather than treating every case as a symptom in isolation.
  • Partner with Product and Prod Dev, turning recurring billing edge cases, payer-specific patterns, and denial trends into structured feedback that can inform the roadmap.
  • Contribute to and maintain the team's billing-related knowledge base, SOPs, and macros, and help calibrate the AI Case Assistant's billing-related suggestions so resolutions compound across the team rather than living only in your own case history.
  • Help build the broader team's baseline RCM literacy — sharing real-world billing context so Specialists can better anticipate the issues different practice types are prone to.
  • Track and report on billing-case quality and resolution metrics within your scope, and flag systemic patterns

title: Billing SME - Product
description:
Elation is building the technology platform that powers the new era of primary care. Our Clinical-First® EHR is beloved by physicians and is enabling the transition to value-based care. We're a mission-driven team committed to empowering independent primary care physicians and improving the quality of care for patients.

We're looking for a Billing SME to join Elation's Billing Team’s and accelerate our AI-powered billing capabilities. As AI takes on more of the revenue cycle, this role will serve as the billing expert who ensures our AI features deliver accurate, trustworthy billing outcomes that practices can rely on.

You'll be the connective tissue between our product team and the real world of primary care billing — bringing hands-on RCM expertise to help us build AI that billing professionals actually trust.

Why This Role Exists

Accelerate Agentic Billing velocity. Your hands-on primary care coding and RCM expertise (e.g., AdvancedMD, Athena, or similar billing solutions) lets our team iterate on AI billing features with fast, credible domain feedback instead of waiting on live-customer validation for every coding or claims decision.

Manage billing risk and trust as AI takes on more of the revenue cycle. Coding and billing correctness carries real financial and compliance consequences — denials, CPT/ICD accuracy, payer rules. As AI authorship of billing decisions grows, you'll evaluate and safeguard accuracy and practice trust. You're the billing analog to the clinical-safety role our Clinical SMEs play for clinical AI.

What You'll Do

User Zero Testing — Feedback & Insight

Test new AI billing capabilities (coding suggestions, Auto-Queue, Worklist, ERA/payment posting) before wider release, evaluating them against real coding and billing judgment. You'll be the first eyes on every billing feature, providing the credible feedback that shapes the product.

Front-line Context & Grounding

Bring firsthand experience of how competitor and adjacent billing systems handle the same workflows, so our billing teams build with the broader RCM landscape in view — not just Elation's current implementation. Help us understand what "best in class" looks like.

Billing Evaluation & Success Criteria

Define what "correct" means for coding and billing outputs — a billing-specific subset of user success criteria — and pressure-test AI-generated billing outputs before they reach practices. Your judgment protects practices from billing mistakes.

Design Partner

Sit alongside Product Design as a billing co-designer, providing billing and coding context and success criteria directly into the design process. Help architect workflows for process excellence by providing a high-level view of industry standards and differentiators.

title: Standortentwickler (m/w/d)
description:
„Jeden Tag einen Menschen in eine sinnstiftende Tätigkeit bringen.“

Eine Stadt. Ein leeres Blatt. Dein Name drunter.

Berlin hat rund 3,9 Millionen Menschen, zwölf Bezirke, zwölf Jobcenter, eine Agentur für Arbeit mit mehreren Standorten – und einen Arbeitsmarkt, der dringend Menschen braucht, die qualifiziert, gecoacht und vermittelt werden. Wir sind in NRW, Schleswig-Holstein und Hamburg gewachsen. Jetzt wollen wir in Berlin Fuß fassen. Richtig.

Dafür suchen wir keinen Verwalter und keinen Vertriebler, der nach Feierabend abschaltet. Wir suchen jemanden, der Berlin kennt, in Berlin vernetzt ist und Lust hat, aus dem Nichts einen Standort aufzubauen, der in drei Jahren ein Name im Berliner Bildungsmarkt ist. Du bekommst dafür die Rückendeckung einer etablierten Gruppe – und du wirst am Gewinn beteiligt, den du selbst erwirtschaftest.

Kurz gesagt: Du gründest unser Berliner Geschäft – mit uns im Rücken und mit Anteil am Ergebnis.

Wer wir sind

Die EuBiA (Europäische Bildungsakademie) ist als operative Tochtergesellschaft der IWQ Holding ein Bildungsträger mit Standorten in NRW, Schleswig-Holstein und Hamburg sowie in Marokko. Seit über 15 Jahren konzipieren und realisieren wir geförderte Bildungsmaßnahmen, Coachings, Sprach- und Integrationskurse und Weiterbildungen – AZAV-zertifiziert, für Kostenträger, Firmenkunden und Selbstzahler, national und international.

Was uns ausmacht: Herzlichkeit, Kompetenz und Engagement. Wir entscheiden schnell, arbeiten nah am Markt und nah an den Menschen. Bei uns arbeiten Kolleginnen und Kollegen unterschiedlichster Herkunft zusammen, wir beraten und unterrichten in mehreren Sprachen. Diversity is für uns kein Schlagwort, sondern gelebter Alltag.

Du baust das gesamte Geschäft der EuBiA in Berlin auf – vom ersten Gespräch mit einem Kostenträger bis zum laufenden Standort mit Team, Teilnehmenden und schwarzen Zahlen. In dieser Reihenfolge, ungefähr:

title: Engineering Manager, Billing & Monetization
description:
About the role

Every customer's path through DataSnipper, from first sign-up to first agent run to renewal, runs on systems your team owns. We are hiring an Engineering Manager in our Amsterdam office to lead Billing & Monetization: how customers get in, what they are entitled to, and how AI usage turns into revenue.

Why DataSnipper?

The hardest AI problems aren't about getting an answer fast. They're about getting one people can trust.

We believe trust is essential to how society works. Every day, we rely on information that's been independently verified, from financial statements to the products we buy, to the sustainability claims companies make. Behind that trust are audit and finance professionals who examine evidence, verify information and hold organizations accountable.

At DataSnipper, we build AI solutions that empowers those professionals. By making evidence easier to trace and verify, we help them focus on the judgment and expertise that make their work so important.


For our product and engineering team, this is where things get exciting. In audit, a plausible answer isn't good enough. Every output must be explainable and traceable back to its source. As Reliability & Maintenance Engineer DSL-01, you are responsible for building and continuously improving the facility's maintenance, reliability, and asset integrity framework. Reporting to the Engineering Manager, you help ensure the plant operates safely, reliably, and efficiently.

The role starts with a strong Maintenance Engineering focus. Your priority will be to help establish the maintenance and reliability foundation of DSL-01 by answering a fundamental question: "how do we maintain our assets safely, reliably, and efficiently throughout their lifecycle?"

You will translate reliability studies, equipment criticality assessments, and integrity requirements into practical maintenance plans, inspection programmes, spare parts strategies, and asset management processes.

As the facility moves into stable operations, the focus gradually shifts towards Reliability Engineering, where you will use asset health monitoring, root cause analysis, and continuous improvement to prevent failures and improve long-term asset performance.

Working closely with operations, maintenance, engineering, and external specialists, you will help reduce technical risk and improve asset reliability from day one.

You will:

  • Develop and continuously improve maintenance, inspection, and asset integrity strategies

  • Translate reliability studies, FMECA analyses, and engineering data into practical maintenance plans within the CMMS/EAM system

  • Act as owner of the asset

We're a stealth startup in AI and bio, building infrastructure for data generation. The team is small and elite, the problems are hard, and the foundations are being laid right now. You'd help write them from the first line, with real ownership and a direct line to the founders.

This role covers the cell side of our protein characterisation work. You would keep the cell lines healthy and run the assays that show how a designed protein behaves on a living cell, week after week, to the same standard.

AI for biology has a data problem. The data that matters most doesn't exist yet, so we're building the infrastructure to produce it, with quality and traceability built in from day one.

We're in stealth and heads-down on execution. We'll share more about what we're building once you've spoken with the team.

You will run cell culture and the cell-based assays for our protein characterisation work. That means the mammalian lines the assays depend on, from thaw through routine passage to a banked and documented stock, and the weekly rhythm of seeding, treating, reading and reporting plates.

Most of it runs in 384-well plates with imaging-based or flow cytometry readouts. You will run those assays as designed, with the controls and replicates that make a curve defensible, and you will be the person who notices when a plate, a line or a reagent lot has started to drift.

description:

The opportunity

We're a stealth startup in AI and bio, building infrastructure for data generation. The team is small and elite, the problems are hard, and the foundations are being laid right now. You'd help write them from the first line, with real ownership and a direct line to the founders.

This role sits at the start of our protein work. Every measurement we make depends on the protein in the well being the right one, made the same way every time, and you would be one of the people making it.

About us

AI for biology has a data problem. The data that matters most doesn't exist yet, so we're

building the infrastructure to produce it, with quality and traceability built in from day one.

We're in stealth and heads-down on execution. We'll share more about what we're building once you've spoken with the team.

The role

You will make proteins, many of them at once. The work runs from DNA through to purified, quality-checked protein in 96-well format, ready for the binding and biophysical assays downstream of you.

On the DNA side you will prepare expression templates from synthetic gene fragments, by PCR and by Golden Gate or Gibson assembly, and check them before they go forward. You will express proteins in cell-free systems first, with E. coli and mammalian (HEK293) expression following as the menu grows. You will purify them by affinity capture, mostly on magnetic beads in plates, and confirm what you made with quantification, CE-SDS and SEC.

Kraken powers some of the most innovative global developments in energy.

We create the technology that redefines utilities and unlocks a new energy system of the future. Kraken’s technology is written and maintained by a multi-discipline engineering team of around 1,400 people globally, which includes server-side, client-side, and mobile engineers. We follow an agile way of working, where individual teams are given the freedom to choose the tools that are most appropriate for managing their work.

Kraken is a great place to learn, work with talented engineers and level-up your skills. Some of our coding conventions are open-source.

 

Our technology

Our backend developers use Python. Most of our websites are powered by Django and GraphQL (Graphene). Our CircleCI CI/CD pipeline runs tens of thousands of tests, deploying into AWS EKS defined by Terraform over 100 times per day and observed with tools like Sentry and Datadog. This allows us to move fast and at scale, without compromising reliability. Teams work differently but the commitment to quality is the same.

About Andercore

Andercore is the AI-native supplier of industrial materials and goods for energy and infrastructure. We execute trade and distribution end-to-end, on our own account, at the speed of compute - and we are becoming the supplier of record for the entire industry.

Industrial procurement is a €900B market in Europe alone and the largest manual market on earth. 95% of customers have no direct access to global supply chains. Materials pass through four or five intermediaries before they reach a site, and 40% of the margin evaporates on the way. For decades, the operating system of this industry was people: people to source, negotiate, finance, ship, and sell.

We built the alternative from scratch. We are the supplier. We buy from global sources and sell to European customers on our own account. Our AI runs the full trade: sourcing, quality, pricing, sales, logistics, credit, and financing. One request. A firm quote in minutes. Delivered on time. For the customer, it feels like buying from their preferred local supplier. No warehouses. No fleet. No inventory risk. Every trade is pre-sold before it is bought.

We are also the credit counterparty. Customers are scored and insured in minutes and get up to 60 days of payment terms priced into the quote itself. The working capital behind every trade is bank-funded, not equity-funded.

title: AI Builder — Working Student
description:

Designing lifecycle evaluation for nondeterministic domain-specific AI systems.

EggAI Labs

We're opening the EggAI Labs in Tübingen. The Labs purpose is to test new AI capabilities, identify what works, how they'd improve delivery, and then build assets to support teams and clients. EggAI's mission cannot be achieved through one-off client projects alone and the Labs is the way to adapt and scale.

As part of the first cohort, you will join a small peer group and work directly with EggAI's CAIO, a Tübingen alumnus. You will also collaborate with our engineering, product, and project leads, who will bring you insights from client problems, help you understand their context and challenge your solutions for them. Your fellow AI Builders will be deliberately chosen to span different passions and strenghts. You will have room to explore and be expected to turn that exploration into something useful. This is not a client-facing role.

The problem: EvalOps

How do we prove an AI system acts as expected under various conditions?

We will explore EvalOps: the methods and tools used to check whether domain-specific AI systems meet their behavioral requirements. Among the key challenges for operating AI systems are nondeterminism, ground-truth curation, evaluation metric-design, latency and costs. EvalOps need to overcome all of them in a disciplined way.

FDSEs deploy ground breaking technical solutions to solve our customers’ hardest problems. Projects often start with a nebulous question like “Why are we losing customers?” or “How can we more effectively identify instances of money laundering?” FDSEs lead the way in developing a solution, from high-level system design and prototyping to application development and data integration. As an FDSE, you leverage everything around you: Palantir products, open source technologies, and anything you and your team can build to drive real impact.
 
You work with customers around the globe, where you gain rare insight into the world’s most important industries and institutions. We help our customers detect insider trading, improve disaster relief, fight healthcare fraud, and more. Each mission presents different challenges, from the regulatory environment to the nature of the data to the user population. You will work to accommodate all aspects of an environment to drive real technical outcomes for our customers.

MoonPay Enterprise is for builders with something to prove.

This isn't a "work on cool crypto stuff" company. It's a high-standards, high-velocity, high-accountability company building the operating system for value movement. If the internet moves information, we move value: crypto, stablecoins, tokenized assets, and whatever comes next. Four offerings make that real: fund, tokenize, trade, and spend.

MoonPay Enterprise is the fund layer built for businesses. We power how stablecoins move through real financial operations: enterprises, fintechs, PSPs, wallets, and marketplaces running their treasuries, their cross-border flows, and their stablecoin operations on us. The goal is to make moving real money at scale as predictable as any other piece of financial infrastructure, with the compliance and controls CFOs need to say yes.

AI is the default operating mode here. It's woven into every role, and we expect you to use it daily. It handles the manual work so you can deliver on what actually matters.

You'll thrive here if outcomes excite you more than process, if impact motivates you more than titles, and if you want hard problems, real ownership, and teammates who love winning, building, and doing it together.

AI is growing faster than any technology in history and the explosion in demand has created a massive infrastructure gap; we can no longer build chips or power stations fast enough to keep up. The industry is still leaning on a ten-year-old hardware blueprint that has reached its limit. A new paradigm that is faster and more efficient will be the biggest economic opportunity of the next century and create the most important company of the next decade. The OLIX Decode Accelerator 1 (DX-1) is the first accelerator architected specifically for decode. The Role

As a Staff Embedded Software Engineer, you will be the design authority for a major area of the DX-1 platform firmware, within the overall platform architecture. This is the software that makes a rack of custom silicon bootable, manageable and observable, from pre-silicon simulation and FPGA prototypes through first silicon into production.

The kind of work you would own: bare-metal and real-time firmware on resource-constrained cores, embedded Linux on the platform processors, the BMC and management plane, and register-level control of the ASIC over its management link. You will report to the Platform Architect who leads the Embedded team and work closely with the FPGA, ASIC and Systems Software teams.

You bring exceptional depth on both sides of the hardware-software boundary, the judgment to identify what matters most and why, and the ability to influence and align engineering teams without relying on formal authority. About Kernel

Agents are starting to sell, buy and operate on behalf of companies. But before an agent can close a deal, qualify an account, route a lead or assess risk, it has to answer a basic question: which company is this?

Today, that answer is messy, and no one answers it reliably. Business identity lives across CRMs, ERPs and third-party datasets full of duplicates, missing parent companies, stale addresses and incorrect enrichment. The cost shows up across the enterprise: sales teams miss revenue opportunities because they lack the right account context; operations teams take on avoidable exposure because risk signals are fragmented or wrong; and finance teams end up chasing, writing off, or defaulting on bad debt that should have been caught earlier.

Humans have worked around that mess for years. Agents cannot. They need a reliable business identity layer they can trust.

Kernel is building that layer: the business registry for agents. We issue a permanent KERN ID for every business, plus the context an agent needs to act on it. Ops, data and revenue teams at Gong, Legora, Mistral, Canva and Checkout already use Kernel on their own systems. Agents are next, and there will be far more of them.

We have raised $14M from top VCs and operators at Plaid, OpenAI, Slack and others, and we are growing 5x YoY.

About Niantic Spatial

AI has learned from almost everything online, but it still struggles with the physical world, where 99.5% of economic activity happens. It doesn’t know where things are, how spaces fit together, or what changes over time.

That’s one of the biggest unsolved problems in AI, and it’s the one we’re solving at Niantic Spatial. We build spatial AI models and services so people and machines can reason, learn and act safely in the physical world. We turn camera imagery, video, sensor data and archives into accurate, AI-readable representations of real places that robots can train in and machines can use to know exactly where they are.

In physical AI, mistakes have real consequences. That’s why we build AI grounded in measured reality, not guesswork, so the people and machines relying on it can trust it to get things right.

Our team built some of the world’s most widely used maps. Now we’re building something bigger: a living, measured record of the real world that machines can query, learn from and use to understand how places change over time. If you want to help AI understand the world we actually live in, come build with us.

About Calibre

AI systems are moving from proof of concepts into the infrastructure of everyday life. That creates a fundamental technical problem: how do you know an increasingly autonomous AI system is secure, reliable and behaving as intended? And who do you trust to answer that question?

title: Junior Transformation Strategist (UK Based)
description:
About Duvo

Before Duvo, our founders built and ran a $2 billion retailer. They saw how much critical work still depended on spreadsheets, inboxes, supplier portals and the memory of experienced operators. The real process rarely lived in one system. People held the last mile together.

Duvo is building the Enterprise Execution OS: the shared layer that understands how work really runs, carries it across existing systems and measures the business result.

Our agents do the work, not just suggest the next step. They gather evidence, make decisions within agreed rules, route exceptions to the right person and update the source system. People keep control wherever judgment or approval is needed. Every action leaves an audit trail.

We start with one recurring process and a clear outcome. Every solution carries a contracted 5x ROI guarantee.

The role

As a Junior Transformation Strategist, you are the insight and output engine beside our Transformation Strategists on our largest accounts.

On bigger engagements we need more than technical delivery. We need someone who can take a messy process, find the critical question, get to a clear insight fast, and put it into materials a customer team will act on. Today that work often lands on Forward Deployed Engineers. That is the wrong use of a scarce technical resource. This role exists so that insight work has a dedicated owner.

You will work alongside Transformation Strategists (who own day-to-day account presence and workstream direction) and Forward Deployed Engineers (who own the technical solution). You do not own the executive relationship or the commercial outcome. You own the speed and quality of the analytical and written work that makes those conversations possible.

title: Partner Account Manager
description: Vil du være med å forme fremtidens sikkerhetsløsninger og samtidig styrke RCOs posisjon på Østlandet?      RCO Security er en ledende nordisk leverandør av adgangskontroll, innbruddsalarm og integrerte sikkerhetsløsninger. I Norge har vi vært etablert siden 2014 og opplever sterk vekst. Nå søker vi en ny  Partner Account Manager  som skal bidra til å videreutvikle vår posisjon i regionen bestående av  Oslo, Akershus, Innlandet og Østfold .     I regionen ser vi et betydelig potensial for videre vekst. Som  Partner Account Manager  får du ansvaret for å utvikle markedet i  Oslo, Akershus, Innlandet og Østfold . Arbeidshverdagen foregår i stor grad ute hos kunder, samarbeidspartnere og i prosjekter hvor relasjoner og tillit bygges over tid.     Du vil rapportere til daglig leder i RCO Security AS. Arbeidssted er våre lokaler på Bryn i Oslo. Reiseaktivitet i Oslo, Akershus, Innlandet og Østfold må påregnes.  Vi tilbyr firmabil.       Ansvar og arbeidsoppgaver   Som  Partner Account Manager  får du et selvstendig ansvar for ditt distrikt og blir en sentral representant for RCO i markedet. Du vil arbeide tett med sluttkunder, installatører, rådgivere, konsulenter og distributører for å skape etterspørsel etter RCOs løsninger og sikre at vi blir spesifisert og valgt i kommende prosjekter.     Salgssyklusene er ofte lange og komplekse, og rollen handler i stor grad om å påvirke prosjekter tidlig i prosessen, bygge sterke relasjoner og følge muligheter over tid. Dette er rollen for deg som ønsker å kombinere teknisk forståelse, forretningsutvikling og relasjonsbygging i en bransje med store prosjekter og betydelig vekstpotensial.      Dine viktigste arbeidsoppgaver vil være å    identifisere og følge opp nye prosjektmuligheter.  bygge og videreutvikle relasjoner med installatører, rådgivere og sluttkunder.  drive markedsbearbeiding og forretningsutvikling i eget distrikt.  gjennomføre kunde- og partnerbesøk.  holde presentasjoner, produktdemonstrasjoner og opplæring.  bidra med markedsinnsikt, konkurranseanalyser og kundeinnspill.  samarbeide tett med kollegaer innen salg, support og produktutvikling.       Din profil   Vi er åpne for ulike bakgrunner, men det viktigste er at du har erfaring fra  sikkerhetsbransjen  eller nærliggende tekniske fagområder og motiveres av å skape resultater gjennom relasjoner og langsiktig påvirkningsarbeid. title: Front Office Manager - Conrad Kuala Lumpur

description: Job Description    Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You   Picture yourself brightening someone’s day. When you join our Hotels team, that’s exactly what you’ll do every time you come to work! You will oversee the daily operations of the front office and guest services teams, ensuring that all guests receive outstanding service. You will manage check-in and check-out processes, resolve guest concerns, and lead a team of front desk agents and guest service representatives to meet the hotel’s service standards. As a  Front Office Manager , you’re not just overseeing daily front office operations – you’re spreading the light and warmth of hospitality by delivering memorable experiences that make the stay for every guest. Acting with  Integrity  and always doing the right thing. Inspiring others through  Leadership . A belief that  Teamwork  drives the best outcomes. A sense of  Ownership  and accountability. And a focus on the  Now , bringing urgency and discipline to every moment, knowing it can make a lasting impact.   In Addition, This Role Requires The Following Minimum Qualifications     Proven experience in a front office or guest service management role within the hospitality industry.  Strong leadership and team management skills, with the ability to inspire and motivate staff.  Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with a guest-centric approach.  Strong problem-solving abilities and attention to detail, with the ability to handle high-pressure situations.  Proficiency in hotel property management systems (PMS) and front office operations. title: Customer Success Team Lead
description: Be part of a movement that moves the world    At ASICS, we’re more than just a brand; we're a movement. A movement of movement, propelled by the belief that motion strengthens the body and uplifts the mind. Our name itself, an acronym for "Anima Sana in Corpore Sano" (a Sound Mind in a Sound Body), encapsulates this commitment. Since taking our first step in Japan in 1949, our journey has been about more than just reaching the finish lines or clocking the fastest times. It's about the joy of moving and it's open to all.  If you're inspired to move yourself and the world toward a brighter, more inclusive future, we're looking for you.  Here at ASICS, we welcome diversity in our people, their backgrounds and life experiences. So, you could be the right person for this role regardless of your age, nationality, religious beliefs, or gender identification.    Your role in our shared journey    As  Customer Success Team Lead  located at our Nordic ASICS Head Office in Gothenburg, Sweden, you’ll lead and drive strategic customer success initiatives across wholesale operations, serving as the primary liaison between ASICS and key wholesale accounts.  This leadership position is responsible for maximizing revenue growth, optimizing Order-to-Cash (O2C) processes, and developing high-performing teams while fostering strategic partnerships that drive long-term business success across the Nordic market.  Your role will be instrumental in weaving the fabric of our movement, bringing unique perspectives and driving innovation with every step. In the role, you’ll be reporting into our Head of Order to Cash North.    Can you move minds?    We’re looking for a candidate who can proactively drive growth and operational excellence by leading cross-functional customer success and customer service initiatives, developing high-performing teams, and fostering transformational partnerships that position ASICS as the preferred brand partner while delivering sustainable competitive advantage in the Nordic market.    Reporting to the Head of Order to Cash North, as part of the role you’ll:       Define and implement the local Customer Success vision in the Nordic market fully aligned with the company goals and the Commercial and Operational strategies    Drive transformation from an operational to a revenue-& contribution margin oriented and customer focused Customer Service culture    Translate company operational and commercial strategy into customer-specific value propositions    Lead, coach and develop the Customer Success team unlocking performance, confidence and potential    Own team hiring, performance management, team engagement initiatives and strategic enablement    Collaborate cross-functionally with Commercial, Merchandising, Finance and logistic teams to advocate for the customer and increase operational efficiency    Develop and implement Standard Operating Procedures to increase local efficiency strictly in-line with the O2C policies and guidelines

title: Receptionschef
description: Vi söker en Receptionschef som älskar människor, service och att få saker att hända! Du är med och skapar både glada gäster och ett team som trivs och utvecklas.     Vi tror att du är en erfaren trygg och motiverande ledare, trivs i en verksamhet med mycket energi och har lätt för att skapa struktur och engagemang. Du ser möjligheter, vågar agera och trivs bäst när du får vara nära både gäster och medarbetare. Tjänsten är en tillsvidareanställning på 100%.     Älskar du mötet med människor och drivs av att skapa riktigt bra upplevelser? Då är det här tjänsten för dig.  Vi intervjuar löpande så vänta inte med din ansökan!     Har du frågor inför en ansökan, är du varmt välkommen att kontakta:  Linnea Söderqvist, Försäljningschef linnea@dafto.se  Mia Kempe, HR chef mia@dafto.se:

title: Palvelupäällikkö
description: Haluatko johtaa ihmisiä, luoda toimivia rakenteita ja edistää korkeaa laatua arjessa?   Etsimme motivoitunutta ja ratkaisukeskeistä  palvelupäällikköä  vastaamaan siivouspalveluidemme päivittäisestä toiminnasta Suupohjan rannikkoseudulla. Tehtävässä yhdistyvät operatiivinen työnjohto, suunnittelu, laadunvarmistus sekä asiakasyhteistyö. Saat keskeisen roolin henkilöstön ja asiakkaiden onnistumisen mahdollistamisessa läsnäolevan ja selkeän johtamisen avulla.   Tehtävänkuva   Palvelupäällikkönä vastaat oman alueesi päivittäisestä toiminnasta. Suunnittelet, johdat ja seuraat toimintaa varmistaaksesi tehokkaan toiminnan, korkean laadun ja hyvän palvelun.  Keskeisiä työtehtäviäsi ovat muun muassa:    Työntekijöiden päivittäinen työnjohto ja tukeminen  Henkilöstöresurssien suunnittelu ja työvuorolistojen laatiminen  Sijaisten hankinta ja uusien työntekijöiden perehdyttäminen  Työajan ja resurssienkäytön seuranta  Laadunvalvonta  Työturvallisuudesta ja työhyvinvoinnista huolehtiminen  Materiaalien ja työvälineiden tilaaminen ja hankinta  Lakien, työehtosopimusten, asiakassopimusten ja sisäisten ohjeiden noudattamisen varmistaminen  Yhteistyö asiakkaiden, työntekijöiden ja muiden sidosryhmien kanssa  Toimintatapojen, työmenetelmien ja laadun kehittäminen    Osallistut tarvittaessa myös käytännön siivoustyöhön.   Etsimme sinua, joka     Olet varma ja selkeä johtaja sekä osaat motivoida ja innostaa muita  Omaat hyvät organisointi- ja suunnittelutaidot  Työskentelet itsenäisesti, aloitteellisesti ja ratkaisukeskeisesti  Osaat priorisoida ja tehdä päätöksiä muuttuvissakin tilanteissa  Omaat hyvät yhteistyö- ja viestintätaidot  Hallitset perustason IT-taidot ja sinulla on hyvät hallinnolliset valmiudet  Ymmärrät taloudellisen toiminnan perusteet ja resurssien tehokkaan käytön  Siivousalan kokemus ja eri siivousmenetelmien tuntemus katsotaan eduksi     Tarjoamme   Tarjoamme monipuolisen ja vastuullisen tehtävän, jossa pääset vaikuttamaan ja kehittämään toimintaa. Liityt osaksi sitoutunutta työyhteisöä, jossa yhteistyö, laatu ja asiakaspalvelu ovat keskiössä.  Työsuhde on vakituinen ja kokoaikainen. Edellytämme hyvää ruotsin kielen suullista ja kirjallista taitoa sekä tyydyttävää suomen ja englannin kielen taitoa.  Toimipaikka sijaitsee pääasiassa Närpiössä, mutta vastuualueena on koko Suupohjan rannikkoalue, mikä edellyttää säännöllisiä työmatkoja. Oman auton käyttömahdollisuus on välttämätön.  Lisätietoja antaa toimitusjohtaja Marjo Österdahl  marjo.osterdahl@stodbotniatuki.fi ja  040 189 6349   Lähetäthän hakemuksesi viimeistään 31.10.2026!    Haastattelemme hakijoita jo hakuaikana.

title: Myymäläpäällikkö 35h/vko, Mikkeli
description: Myymäläpäällikkö Mikkeli Graanin Mustiin ja Mirriin   Musti Group on Pohjoismaiden johtava lemmikkieläinhoidon asiantuntija, joka toimii Suomessa, Ruotsissa ja Norjassa, sekä vuodesta 2024 lähtien myös Baltiassa. Missiomme on tehdä lemmikkien ja lemmikkivanhempien elämästä hauskempaa, turvallisempaa ja vaivattomampaa läpi lemmikin elämän. Haluamme olla asiakkaillemme täyden palvelun tuotetarjoaja ja toimija – sekä fyysisesti että digitaalisesti. Uskomme, että täyden palvelun ekosysteemi tarjoaa ainutlaatuisen arvolupauksen, joka parantaa ja vahvistaa hyviä asiakassuhteita ja erottaa meidät kilpailijoista.    Musti-konsernin liikevaihto oli 561 miljoonaa euroa tilikaudella 2024 (15 kk). Yhtiöllä oli  tilikauden 2024 lopussa 2 178 työntekijää, 1,9 miljoonaa asiakasta ja 415 myymälää.    Nyt etsimme laumanjäseneksi uutta myymäläpäällikköä!   Myymäläpäällikkönä toimit tulosvastuullisena myymälänvetäjänä, vastaten myymälästä ja myymälän tiimin arjen sujuvuudesta. Omalla esimerkilläsi kehität myymälän myönteistä, asiakaslähtöistä ilmapiiriä, palveluasennetta ja johdat myymälää määriteltyjen tavoitteiden mukaisesti. Olet myös mukana päivittäisessä myyntityössä. Vastuu ketjukonseptin toteutumisesta myymälässäsi ja yhteisten toimintatapojen noudattamisesta: Huolehdit, että myymäläsi ja sen henkilökunta toimivat linjassa yrityksen toimintaohjeiden mukaisesti  Huolehdit myymäläsi päivittäisestä sisäisestä viestinnästä: Henkilökunta on tietoinen ketjun, alueen ja myymälän tärkeistä ajankohtaisista asioista ja tavoitteista      Odotamme sinulta     Aikaisempaa kokemusta myynti- ja asiakaspalvelutyöstä: Kokemus erityisesti kaupan –tai palvelualan tehtävistä katsotaan eduksi.  Tahtoa ja rohkeutta työskennellä esihenkilötehtävissä: Esihenkilötyö kiinnostaa sinua aidosti ja haluat tukea ja ohjata tiimiläisiä yhä parempiin suorituksiin ja johtaa tiimiäsi. Arvostammekin aiempaa kokemusta esihenkilötehtävistä.  Kommunikointitaitoja sekä innostunutta asennetta: Olet selkeä ja tehokas viestimään sekä johdat omalla esimerkilläsi myönteistä ilmapiiriä  Sitoutuneisuutta ja vastuunkantoa omasta myymälästäsi ja sen tuloksista: Huolehdit toiminnallasi, että myymäläsi pääsee asetettuihin tavoitteisiin ja olet oma-aloitteisesti valmis jatkuvasti kehittämään myymälän toimintaa  Järjestelmällisyyttä, oma-aloitteisuutta sekä ratkaisukeskeisyyttä: Myymälän organisointi ja tiimin johtaminen edellyttää päivittäisten tilanteiden ratkomista sekä pitkän

title: Assistant Store Manager, Calvin Klein - Helsinki Outlet
description: Be part of an iconic story.    At Calvin Klein, we believe in fostering an inclusive and collaborative culture by celebrating different perspectives, backgrounds and beliefs to truly connect with our associates and consumers. Join us and have a meaningful impact on the world – and – endless opportunities to design your future. Immerse yourself in Calvin Klein here! (YouTube, Instagram, TikTok)    About PVH    With a history going back over 130 years, PVH has excelled at growing brands and businesses with rich American heritages, becoming one of the largest global apparel companies.
