Tule mukaan rakentamaan vastuullista tulevaisuutta tekstiilipalveluiden parissa – innovatiivisessa ja kansainvälisessä ympäristössä, jossa jokainen saa loistaa.      Nyt on tarjolla mielenkiintoinen paikka meidän tiimissämme!       Etsimme myyntihenkistä Key Account Manageria Pirkanmaalle.       Tässä roolissa toimit Etelä-Suomen alueella ja asemapaikkasi on Lempäälä. Olet avainroolissa toteuttamassa erinomaista asiakaskokemusta sekä liiketoiminnan kasvua strategiamme ja visiomme mukaisesti.      Roolissasi Key Account Managerina vastaat nimettyjen asiakkuuksien kannattavasta kehityksestä, asiakkaiden ohjausryhmien vetämisestä sekä asiakasprojektien ja myyntisuunnitelmien johtamisesta ja toteutumisesta. Johdat asiakkuuksiasi suunnitelmallisesti, tunnistat uutta liiketoimintapotentiaalia ja kokoat asiakkaan tarpeiden ympärille oikeat Lindströmin asiantuntijat.      Tehtävän keskeisin tavoite on salkun arvon kasvattaminen, joka koostuu mm. henkilökohtaisesta myynnistä, kannattavuuden kehittämisestä ja erinomaisen asiakaskokemuksen varmistamisesta. Työ edellyttää matkustusta asiakkaiden luokse eri paikkakunnille sekä oman auton käyttömahdollisuutta. Tehtävän palkkaus koostuu kiinteästä kuukausipalkasta sekä myyntiin perustuvasta tulospalkkiosta.       Menestyt tehtävässä, jos sinulla on:        Kokemusta B2B-asiakkuuksien kehittämisestä, palvelumyynnistä ja tavoitteellisesta asiakkuusjohtamisesta   Tuloshakuinen, oma-aloitteinen ja ratkaisukeskeinen työote   Näyttöjä liiketoimintamahdollisuuksien tunnistamisesta ja kasvun rakentamisesta asiakkaiden kanssa   Kyky johtaa yhteistyötä, vaikuttaa sidosryhmiin ja viedä asioita eteenpäin ilman esihenkilöasemaa   Erinomainen suomen ja englannin kielen taito   Hyvät digitaaliset työelämätaidot sekä kyky hyödyntää moderneja työvälineitä   Vahvat tiimi- ja työyhteisötaidot       Arvostamme soveltuvaa koulutusta sekä näyttöjä pitkäjänteisten asiakas- ja kumppanuussuhteiden kehittämisestä. Olet itsevarma, asiakaslähtöinen ja kaupallisesti ajatteleva ammattilainen, joka tunnistaa mahdollisuuksia ja rakentaa pitkäaikaista arvoa asiakkaille. Kokemus kiinteistö- tai FM-toimialalta sekä toimialaverkostot ovat tehtävässä selkeä etu.       Tarjoamme sinulle:        Vaikuttavan ja itsenäisen KAM-roolin, jossa pääset kehittämään strategisia asiakkuuksia, rakentamaan kasvua ja vaikuttamaan oman asiakassalkkusi menestykseen   Todistetusti toimivat palvelut ja myyntikonseptit   Ammattitaitoisen työyhteisön ja laajan sisäisen verkoston, jonka kanssa rakennat asiakkaillesi arvoa tuottavia ratkaisuja   Esihenkilön tuen ja sparrauksen sekä tilaa ottaa vastuuta ja kehittää omaa tapaasi onnistua   Kilpailukykyisen kokonaispalkitsemisen sekä kattavat henkilöstöedut, kuten laajan työterveyshuollon ja hyvinvointiedut ePassin kautta       Tehtävä on vakituinen ja kokoaikainen. title: CX Team Lead
description: [아임웹 소개]   아임웹은  브랜드 빌더 입니다. 브랜드의 시작과 성장, 그 모든 과정에 필요한 것을 제공함으로써 더욱 다채로운 브랜드들이 만들어지는 세상을 꿈꿉니다. 웹 빌더로 시작해 주문관리, CRM, 결제·정산, AI 기반 기능까지, 지금은 누적 110만 사이트, 7조 원이 넘는 거래를 지원하는 서비스가 됐습니다. 🚀     하지만 아직 풀어야 할 문제는 많아요. 사이트를 만들고, 고객을 모으고, 주문을 처리하고, 데이터를 분석하는 모든 과정에서 수많은 기술적 허들이 생깁니다. 아임웹은 이 허들을 없애주는 역할이고, 그 말은 고객이 겪는 어려움을 우리가 대신 풀어야 한다는 뜻이에요. 100만 개 사이트 뒤에는 각자의 꿈을 가진 고객들이 있고, 여러분의 하나의 결정이 그들의 성장에 직접 닿아 있습니다.  이렇게 어려운 문제를 풀려면, 적당히 해서는 안 됩니다. 아임웹에는  욕심 이 필요해요. 더 많이 가지려는 욕망이 아니라, 기준을 낮추지 않으려는 선택. 더 나은 답을 찾기 위해 한 번 더 고민하고, 어렵더라도 끝까지 해내려는 태도입니다. 그리고 그 욕심이 발휘될 수 있도록, 누가 시킨 일을 하는 게 아니라 스스로 제안하고 결정하는 자율이 있고, 구성원이 실행에 온전히 몰입할 수 있는 환경을 제공하고 있어요.     아임웹은 '착하고 좋은 사람들'로만 이루어진 팀이 아닙니다. 전문성과 책임을 바탕으로 서로에게 기대하고, 요구하고, 피드백하는, 건강한 충돌과 논의를 망설이지 않는 동료가 있어요. 정의되지 않은 영역에서 스스로 길을 만들어가는 분, "이 정도면 됐다"에서 멈추지 않는 분, 솔직한 대화가 팀을 더 강하게 만든다고 믿는 분이라면, 아임웹에서의 시간은 "내가 또 이렇게까지 치열하게 일할 수 있을까?" 싶을 만큼 밀도 높은 경험이 될 거예요. 반대로, 안정적이고 예측 가능한 환경을 선호하시거나, 명확한 지시를 받고 일하는 방식이 편하시거나, 적당한 결과에 만족하시는 분이라면 아임웹의 속도와 문화가 맞지 않을 수 있어요. 아임웹은 더 위대한 일을 하기 위해 불편하더라도 필요한 의견을 명확하게 개진하는 팀입니다.     아임웹만의 속도와 문화 속에서 이 문제를 함께 풀어갈 분을 찾고 있습니다.      [아임웹 팀 소개]    이렇게 일하고 있어요   아임웹 Customer Division의 CX Team은 고객과 가장 가까운 접점에서 소통하며 고객 경험 전반을 책임져요. 실시간 채팅을 통해 고객의 니즈와 문제를 신속하게 파악하고, 이를 내부 유관 부서와 긴밀히 공유하여 서비스 개선으로 즉각 연결해요.  "고객의 성장이 곧 아임웹의 성장"이라는 미션을 바탕으로 단순한 문의 응대를 넘어, 고객 맞춤형 컨설팅과 실질적인 문제 해결을 통해 고객 비즈니스의 성장을 지원하고 있어요.     또한 AI 상담 서비스도 지속적으로 고도화하며, 고객이 필요로 하는 순간 언제든지 최적의 지원을 받을 수 있는 환경을 구축해요. 아임웹 CX Team은 AX(AI Experience)에 관한 아이디어를 적극적으로 제안하고 실행하며 고객 경험 혁신을 이끄는 핵심 팀이에요.  상담 대응과 개선을 넘어, 발견한 문제를 제품·기능 개선으로 직접 연결하고 AI 툴을 실제 업무에 도입해 운영을 폭발적으로 고도화하는 것을 목표로 삼고 있어요.      함께 해결하고 싶어요    어떤 시간이든 고객이 스스로 빠르고 편하게 문의를 해결할 수 있는 최고의 고객 경험을 드리고 싶어요.  고객 문의를 빠르게 해결하는 것을 넘어 브랜드의 완전한 성공을 돕고 싶어요.  팀원 개개인의 역량에 의존하지 않도록 팀 단위로 재현 가능한 성장 구조를 만들고 싶어요.       [주요 업무] 이런 역할을 기대하고 있어요    실시간 채팅 및 고객 문의 전반을 관리 및 지원하고, 상담 품질 및 응대 프로세스를 지속적으로 개선해요.  AI 상담 플로우를 설계하고 AI 툴을 운영 업무에 활용해, 고객이 스스로 문제를 해결하는 퍼널로 고도화해요.  상담 데이터와 VOC를 분석하여 반복 이슈를 구조화하고, 개선 활동의 성과를 정량 지표로 설계하고 검증해요.  고객 이슈 원인을 파악해 유관부서(제품, 개발, 마케팅 등)와의 협업을 통해 신속하게 해결하고 재발 방지 체계를 마련해요.  제품 배포 시 사전 리스크 감지, 2차 상담 대응을 하며 전사 리스크를 관리하고, 핵심 고객 리텐션에 기여해요.  CX 조직의 미션과 KPI를 설계하고 팀원별 목표 수립을 지원하며, 채용과 성과 평가를 통해 팀의 성장을 이끌어요.       ※ CX Team Lead 포지션 근무 시간은 원활한 상담 관리를 위해 상담 운영 시간에 맞춰 진행됩니다.    (상세 스케줄은 팀 내 협의를 통해 조율합니다.)       [자격 요건] 이런 분을 찾고 있어요    CX/CS 및 상담 운영 분야에서 7년 이상 근무한 경험이 있으신 분  3년 이상의 팀 리딩 경험을 통해 팀 빌딩/세팅 및 리더로의 성장 경험을 쌓아오신 분  채널톡 등 상담 채널 기반 AI 상담 플로우를 직접 설계하거나 고도화해 본 경험이 있으신 분  AI 툴을 실제 상담/운영 업무에 도입해 성과를 낸 경험이 있으신 분  데이터를 기반으로 반복 이슈를 구조화하고, 개선 성과를 정량 지표로 검증해본 경험이 있으신 분  전사 리스크 관리, 2차 상담 대응 또는 핵심 고객 리텐션 관리 경험이 있으신 분  고객, 유관부서와 협업하여 복합적인 이슈를 조율하고 합리적인 해결 방안을 도출해보신 분       [우대 사항] 이런 경험이 있다면 더 좋아요    B2B 또는 리스크/정책 관리가 중요한 환경에서 고객 운영 프로세스를 개선해본 경험이 있으신 분  대외/수사기관 등과의 커뮤니케이션 및 대응 경험이 있으신 분  제품 업데이트 안내, 웨비나 등 고객 대상 커뮤니케이션을 직접 기획하거나 제안해본 경험이 있으신 분       [합류 과정]     전형 프로세스  : 서류 전형 > 1차 직무 인터뷰 > 2차 컬처 애드 (Culture Add) 인터뷰 > 최종 합격   서류 전형  : 생년월일, 사진, 연봉 정보 등 업무와 관계없는 내용보다, 어떤 경험을 해오셨는지 알 수 있는 경력 위주로 지원

title: Sales Support Manager- Paraparaumu
description: Company Description   At The Warehouse, we’re passionate about helping Kiwis live better every day. From supporting local communities to making a positive impact on our planet, we’re about so much more than retail.  When you join us, you’ll be part of a supportive, fast-paced environment where no two days are the same. Alongside competitive pay and great benefits, you’ll have plenty of opportunities to grow your career with one of New Zealand’s most iconic retail brands.   Job Description   As our Sales Support Manager, you’ll play a key role in leading the front-end operations of the store and delivering an exceptional customer experience.  From overseeing checkouts and customer service to supporting loss prevention and operational processes, you’ll help ensure the store runs smoothly day in and day out.  You’ll lead and inspire a team of passionate individuals, creating a positive team culture where people feel motivated, supported, and empowered to do their best work.  This is a hands-on leadership role where your energy, organisation, and people skills will make a real difference — both to your team and to the wider community.   Qualifications   To succeed in this role, you’ll be a confident and motivated leader with a passion for retail and customer service.   You’ll Also Bring     Proven experience leading and developing teams  Strong communication and organisational skills  A good understanding of cash handling and checkout processes  The ability to interpret plans and execute them effectively  A positive, can-do attitude and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment    Most importantly, you’ll bring enthusiasm, resilience, and a genuine passion for creating great customer experiences.   Additional Information   Join us at The Warehouse – where every day is an opportunity to make a difference.  Apply now and kickstart your journey in retail management with us!   Benefits   You will be exposed to the latest technology, work in a diverse and energetic team while taking advantage of our company benefits such as:    Career opportunities that come with a company our size!  Take your birthday off - paid!  Staff discounts across all of our brands!  Long Service leave!  26 weeks fully paid parental leave or 10 days additional leave to support your partner.   Fully paid Jury Service  Lifestyle Leave - spend more time doing the things you love!

title: Guest Experience Manager
description: About Four Seasons   Four Seasons is powered by our people. We are a collective of individuals who crave to become better, to push ourselves to new heights and to treat each other as we wish to be treated in return. Our team members around the world create amazing experiences for our guests, residents, and partners through a commitment to luxury with genuine heart. We know that the best way to enable our people to deliver these exceptional guest experiences is through a world-class employee experience and company culture.  At Four Seasons, we believe in recognizing a familiar face, welcoming a new one and treating everyone we meet the way we would want to be treated ourselves. Whether you work with us, stay with us, live with us or discover with us, we believe our purpose is to create impressions that will stay with you for a lifetime. It comes from our belief that life is richer when we truly connect to the people and the world around us.   About the location:   An urban retreat steeped in historic beauty. Stroll the city’s biggest private garden – a tranquil haven of statues, fountains and centuries-old trees – or retire to your suite where frescoes line the walls amid original architectural features. Our historic Hotel, with its Michelin-starred Italian restaurant and a locally inspired Spa where you can spend afternoons in pure indulgence, is just steps away from the cultural heart of Florence.   About The Role   At Four Seasons Hotel Firenze, we are seeking a passionate and service-driven Guest Experience Manager to lead our Guest Experience Team. In this role, you will be responsible for creating personalized and memorable experiences for our guests, ensuring every stay reflects the exceptional standards of luxury, care, and hospitality that define the Four Seasons brand.  This position is offered as a full-time maternity cover contract for a minimum of 12 months.   What You Will Do     Lead, motivate, and coordinate the Guest Experience Team, fostering a culture of service excellence, accountability, and continuous improvement.  Ensure all local and corporate policies, procedures, and Four Seasons standards are consistently applied and maintained.  Oversee guest recognition programs and ensure guest preferences, profiles, and special requests are accurately captured, maintained, and acted upon.  Utilize company systems and Front Desk operational platforms to maintain accurate guest history records and maximize guest satisfaction, recognition, and loyalty.  Coordinate VIP arrivals, room assignments, amenities, and personalized experiences in collaboration with Front Office, In-Room Dining, Housekeeping, and other departments.  Conduct regular inspections of VIP rooms to ensure the highest standards of quality and presentation.  Build meaningful relationships with guests, proactively seeking feedback and identifying opportunities to enhance their experience. title: Air Logistics Strategic Customer Development Manager
description: Mer enn en jobb   Logistikk har innflytelse på vår hverdag - fra varene vi forbruker til helsetjenestene vi er avhengige av. Hos Kuehne+Nagel er arbeidet ditt mer enn bare logistikk, det har betydning for hverdagsbegivenheter og livets spesielle øyeblikk for mennesker over hele verden.  ‎‎  Vil du være med å bygge, utvikle og skape nye forretningsmuligheter innen flyfrakt i et av verdens ledende logistikkselskaper?  Som  Air Logistics Strategic Customer Development Manager  får du en sentral rolle i å utvikle nye forretningsmuligheter, bygge kunderelasjoner og skape vekst. Du vil arbeide med mellomstore kunder, identifisere nye muligheter og utvikle potensielle kunder til langsiktige og verdifulle samarbeidspartnere.   Hvordan du gjør en forskjell     Skape nye kundemuligheter. Aktivt identifisere og utvikle nye kunder gjennom prospektering, møtebooking, nettverksbygging og anbefalinger.  Utvikle kunderelasjoner. Bygge og videreutvikle langsiktige kunderelasjoner gjennom god forståelse av kundens virksomhet og behov, skreddersydde løsninger og høy kundetilfredshet.  Drive lønnsom salgsvekst. Utvikle og bygge videre på gode kunderelasjoner, identifisere nye behov og skape vekst  Samarbeide på tvers av organisasjonen. Jobbe tett med relevante interne interessenter for å utvikle gode kundeløsninger, sikre høy kvalitet på kundedata og bidra aktivt i salgs- og porteføljearbeidet.  Drive og støtte salgsprosesser.  Bidra aktivt i kundeforespørsler og anbud, følge etablerte salgsprosesser og sikre fremdrift og måloppnåelse mot definerte KPI-er.  Ta eierskap til resultater  Følge opp egen salgsaktivitet og kundeportefølje systematisk, omsette muligheter til konkrete resultater og bidra til selskapets samlede vekst og lønnsomhet. title: CRM & Automation Manager
description: Job Description    Veikkaus is a gaming company for every Finn, striving to be better in every aspect. Our passion is to drive better gaming so that our customers can enjoy every moment. Caring, teamwork, and courage are the values that guide everything we do. Responsibility is at the core of our operations. Our goal is to be a respected and successful international money gaming group that continuously improves while always putting both customers and employees first. For a better game — and working life.    Manager, CRM & Marketing Automation    Are you passionate about making CRM smarter, more effective and more automated?  Do you enjoy exploring what data, technology and AI can make possible, turning ideas into practical solutions and helping others get more out of the tools they use?  At Veikkaus, we're looking for an experienced CRM and marketing automation professional who is excited to take ownership of our automation development and help shape the future of how we engage with our customers.   About The Role   As  Manager, CRM & Marketing Automation , you'll join our Customer & Loyalty team within the  Lottery & Land-based Games  business unit in a senior, hands-on role combining technical CRM expertise, analytical thinking and business understanding.  You'll  own and shape the direction of our CRM automation development , bringing fresh perspectives and best practices, setting priorities and driving our roadmap forward. title: Senior Lifecycle & Retention Manager
description: About us    Pete Tong DJ Academy (MAT Academy in Italy) is an online school for DJs and electronic music producers, with members in 150 countries. Our courses are taught by artists such as Pete Tong, Carl Cox, Jamie Jones, Adam Beyer and Diplo, inside a digital campus with community, live sessions, a grading path and real career outlets: our Talent Pool, theFuture Talent Awards and our DISCOVR label.     We moved to a subscription model in 2025, closed a funding round in 2026, and are now scaling. Our HQ is in Rome.       The role    You own the member lifecycle from first login onward, and your first priority is the start:turning a new member into someone who studies every week, beginning with a firstlesson in their very first days. From there, you grow the value of each membership, movingmembers to annual and higher plans at the right moment and keeping those we are aboutto lose. And you bring order to how we talk to members, so every message lands at theright time and nobody hears from us too often. You report directly to our Chief Product &Technology Officer.  This is a senior seat in a new team. You will set up how lifecycle works here, run it hands-on, and grow the team around it: lifecycle is a fairly new function here and we plan toexpand it. In the early phase, while our design capacity ramps up, you will also enjoygetting hands-on with the craft yourself: shaping email and in-app templates, offer pagesand small UI touches inside our tools. You are also the custodian of our CRM system: theautomations, segments, rules and calendar every team uses to talk to members.  What you'll own     Activation:  the first 30 days of every member. Onboarding by persona, the first lessonin the first days, and the nudges that turn a signup into a study habit.      Senior Growth Lifecycle Manager, Pete Tong DJ Academy Page 1 of 4        Upsell and expansion:  moving members to annual plans and higher tiers at the rightmoment, with offers tied to their progress and to our big moments (contests, releases,events). When our sales team reaches out to existing members, you decide who theycall and what they offer.      Retention and win back:  the cancellation flow, save offers, win-back campaigns, andfailed-payment recovery together with Administration.      The CRM system:  automations, segments, frequency caps, priority rules and theshared member calendar. You run ActiveCampaign and set the rules other teamspublish within. You also put together the weekly campus newsletter from each team'scontributions.      Experiments:  a steady test pipeline across onboarding, pricing moments andmessaging, read on revenue and retention, not just clicks.      Voice of the member:  bringing cancellation reasons and lifecycle insight to themonthly product review, so product fixes the causes, not just the symptoms. title: CyberCX - Service Delivery Manager
description: The work we do matters    CyberCX, part of Accenture, protects and defends our customers and communities by providing the most comprehensive range of cyber security professional services in the region.  With more than 1,400 team members across Australia, New Zealand, the UK and US, we are a leading force in cyber security, offering services from strategy, GRC, managed security services, cloud security, digital forensics and cyber education.  If you’re ready to work with teammates that get you, a leader that supports you and customers that need you, then you’re ready for CyberCX.   How You Will Make An Impact   Reporting to the Regional Lead Service Governance, the Service Delivery Manager – MSS will focus on the successful delivery of Managed Security Services to CyberCX customers. title: Member of Scientific Staff, Protein Production
description:
LOCATION: King's Cross, London · PATTERN: Lab-based, full-time

The opportunity

We're a stealth startup in AI and bio, building infrastructure for data generation. The team is small and elite, the problems are hard, and the foundations are being laid right now. You'd help write them from the first line, with real ownership and a direct line to the founders.

This role sits at the start of our protein work. Every measurement we make depends on the protein in the well being the right one, made the same way every time, and you would be one of the people making it.

About us

AI for biology has a data problem. The data that matters most doesn't exist yet, so we're

building the infrastructure to produce it, with quality and traceability built in from day one.

We're in stealth and heads-down on execution. We'll share more about what we're building once you've spoken with the team.

The role

You will make proteins, many of them at once. The work runs from DNA through to purified, quality-checked protein in 96-well format, ready for the binding and biophysical assays downstream of you.

On the DNA side you will prepare expression templates from synthetic gene fragments, by PCR and by Golden Gate or Gibson assembly, and check them before they go forward. You will express proteins in cell-free systems first, with E. coli and mammalian (HEK293) expression following as the menu grows. You will purify them by affinity capture, mostly on magnetic beads in plates, and confirm what you made with quantification, CE-SDS and SEC.

Every step is recorded as you go: what went in, which lot, which conditio

Established in Australia in 2002, Quantium is a global team of more than 1,200 people across 14 locations with a unique blend of capabilities across product and consulting services to help businesses unlock value from data and analytics. Quantium partners with the world's largest corporations to forge a better, more intelligent world. Our flagship property decision intelligence platform, Centre iQ, gives retail property clients a powerful view of real consumer behaviour to inform leasing, marketing, asset management and portfolio decisions. The focus is on lasting partnerships and helping clients get consistent value from Centre iQ, not transactional selling. Portfolio size and complexity will reflect your experience. Together you’ll scope solutions and turn our data and analytics into insights clients can act on.   How will you make an impact? title: Site Reliability Engineer
description:
MaintainX is a leading mobile-first work execution platform for industrial and frontline teams. More than 13,000 customers, including Duracell, McDonald's, Shell, DHL and Volvo, use MaintainX to cut unplanned downtime and run better operations, across 13.9 million managed assets and 79.5 million completed work orders.

In August 2026 MaintainX became part of Autodesk, joining Autodesk Operations Solutions, the organization unifying Autodesk's operations platform alongside Tandem, FlexSim and Fusion Operations. Autodesk's strategy is to converge design, make and operate into one continuous lifecycle: design an asset, build it, run it, then feed what you learn running it back into the next design. Autodesk had design and make. Operate is the phase that tells you what actually happened, and it is ours.

We’re looking for a Site Reliability Engineer to help advance MaintainX’s reliability, observability, and developer autonomy as we scale our platform.

In this role, you’ll partner closely with product and platform development teams to improve the stability, resilience, and operational readiness of our services. You’ll work alongside teams to design for reliability from the start, establish clear ownership and standards, and build shared tooling that enables teams to operate their services with confidence.

You’ll also contribute to company-wide initiatives that define how MaintainX approaches reliability software development, including observability standards, incident response practices, and service health metrics, helping the organization adopt proven industry practices at scale.

This role is well-suited for an developer who enjoys working across teams, influencing technical direction through strong development practices, and turning reliability principles into practical, scalable systems.

What You'll Do:

  • Assess service maturity and provide insights to development teams

  • Partner with development teams to implement observability best practices

  • Enable development teams to become autonomous with their service deployment, support, and infrastructure

  • Mentor developers on reliability practices, focusing on making them self-sufficient

  • Act as the bridge, ear and eyes of the Platform Division teams to drive tooling and practice adoption across development teams

About You:

  • Deep understanding of observability practices in a distributed system environment and how it influences system design and team behaviour
